vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.lightbulb.enabled.on: tampilkan the code action menu when the cursor is on lines dengan code atau on empty lines.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.lightbulb.enabled.onCode: tampilkan the code action menu when the cursor is on lines dengan code.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.stickyScroll.defaultModel: Defines the model to use untuk determining which lines to stick. If the outline model does not exist, it will fall back on the folding provider model which falls back on the indentation model. This order is respected in all three cases.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.stickyScroll.enabled: Shows the nested saat ini scopes during the scroll at the top of the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.stickyScroll.maxLineCount: Defines the maximum number of sticky lines to tampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.stickyScroll.scrollWithEditor: Aktifkan scrolling of gulir lengket dengan the editor's horizontal scrollbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.suggest.matchOnWordStartOnly: Saat diaktifkan IntelliSense filtering requires that the first character matches on a word mulai. untuk example, `c` on `Console` atau `WebContext` but _not_ on `description`. When dinonaktifkan IntelliSense will tampilkan more results but still sorts them oleh match quality.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.emptySelectionClipboard: Mengontrol apakah menyalin tanpa a selection copies the saat ini line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.enabled: Mengaktifkan the Code Action lightbulb in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalGpuAcceleration: Mengontrol apakah to use the experimental GPU acceleration to render the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalWhitespaceRendering: Mengontrol apakah whitespace is rendered dengan a new, experimental method.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalWhitespaceRendering.font: Use a new rendering method dengan font characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalWhitespaceRendering.svg: Use a new rendering method dengan svgs.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.addExtraSpaceOnTop: Mengontrol apakah the cari Widget should add extra lines on top of the editor. When true, you can scroll beyond the first line when the cari Widget is visible.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.autoFindInSelection: Mengontrol condition untuk turning on cari in Selection automatically.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.closeOnResult: Mengontrol apakah the cari Widget closes after an explicit cari navigation command lands on a result.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.cursorMoveOnType: Mengontrol apakah the cursor should jump to cari matches while typing.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.findOnType: Mengontrol apakah the cari Widget should cari as you type.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.globalFindClipboard: Mengontrol apakah the cari Widget should read atau modify the shared cari clipboard on macOS.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.history: Mengontrol bagaimana the cari widget riwayat should be stored
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.loop: Mengontrol apakah the cari automatically restarts dari the beginning (atau the end) when no further matches can be found.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.replaceHistory: Mengontrol bagaimana the ganti widget riwayat should be stored
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.find.seedSearchStringFromSelection: Mengontrol apakah the cari string in the cari Widget is seeded dari the editor selection.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.folding: Mengontrol apakah the editor has code folding diaktifkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingHighlight: Mengontrol apakah the editor should highlight folded ranges.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingImportsByDefault: Mengontrol apakah the editor automatically collapses import ranges.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingMaximumRegions: The maximum number of foldable regions. Increasing this value may result in the editor becoming less responsive when the saat ini source has a large number of foldable regions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingStrategy: Mengontrol strategy untuk computing folding ranges.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingStrategy.auto: Use a language-specific folding strategy if available, else the indentation-based one.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontFeatureSettings: Explicit 'font-feature-pengaturan' CSS property. A boolean can be passed instead if one only needs to turn on/off ligatures.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontLigatures: Enables/Disables font ligatures ('calt' dan 'liga' font features). Change this to a string untuk fine-grained control of the 'font-feature-pengaturan' CSS property.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontLigaturesGeneral: Mengonfigurasi font ligatures atau font features. Can be either a boolean to aktifkan/nonaktifkan ligatures atau a string untuk the value of the CSS 'font-feature-pengaturan' property.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontVariations: Enables/Disables the translation dari font-weight to font-variation-pengaturan. Change this to a string untuk fine-grained control of the 'font-variation-pengaturan' CSS property.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontVariationSettings: Explicit 'font-variation-pengaturan' CSS property. A boolean can be passed instead if one only needs to translate font-weight to font-variation-pengaturan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontVariationsGeneral: Mengonfigurasi font variations. Can be either a boolean to aktifkan/nonaktifkan the translation dari font-weight to font-variation-pengaturan atau a string untuk the value of the CSS 'font-variation-pengaturan' property.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontWeight: Mengontrol font weight. Accepts "normal" dan "bold" keywords atau numbers between 1 dan 1000.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fontWeightErrorMessage: Only "normal" dan "bold" keywords atau numbers between 1 dan 1000 are allowed.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.formatOnPaste: Mengontrol apakah the editor should automatically format the ditempelkan content. A formatter must be available dan the formatter should be able to format a range in a document.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.formatOnType: Mengontrol apakah the editor should automatically format the line after typing.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fullwidthCharacterWidth: Mengontrol width used to render full-width characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fullwidthCharacterWidth.font: Render full-width characters using the width defined oleh the font.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.fullwidthCharacterWidth.twoCells: Render full-width characters centered in exactly two character cells. Only applies to monospace fonts when font ligatures are dinonaktifkan. Does not terapkan to multi codepoint full-width characters atau to GPU rendering. This has a performance impact on line rendering.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.glyphMargin: Mengontrol apakah the editor should render the vertical glyph margin. Glyph margin is mostly used untuk debugging.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hideCursorInOverviewRuler: Mengontrol apakah the cursor should be tersembunyi in the overview ruler.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.above: Prefer menampilkan hovers above the line, if there's space.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.delay: Mengontrol delay in milliseconds after which the hover is ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.enabled: Mengontrol apakah the hover is ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.enabled.onKeyboardModifier: Hover is ditampilkan when holding `__TOK_0__` atau `Alt` (the opposite modifier of `#editor.multiCursorModifier#`)
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.hidingDelay: Mengontrol delay in milliseconds after which the hover is tersembunyi. Requires `#editor.hover.sticky#` to be diaktifkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.showLongLineWarning: Mengontrol apakah long line warning hovers are ditampilkan, such as when tokenization is skipped atau rendering is paused.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hover.sticky: Mengontrol apakah the hover should remain visible when mouse is moved over it.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inertialScroll: Make scrolling inertial - mostly useful dengan touchpad on linux.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlayHints.enable: Mengaktifkan the inlay hints in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlayHints.fontFamily: Mengontrol font family of inlay hints in the editor. When set to empty, the {0} is used.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlayHints.fontSize: Mengontrol font size of inlay hints in the editor. As bawaan the {0} is used when the dikonfigurasi value is less than {1} atau greater than the editor font size.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlayHints.maximumLength: Maximum overall length of inlay hints, untuk a single line, before they get truncated oleh the editor. Set to `0` to never truncate
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlayHints.padding: Mengaktifkan the padding around the inlay hints in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inline: Quick suggestions tampilkan as ghost text
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVerbose: Mengontrol apakah the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.allowCodeShifting: Mengontrol apakah menampilkan a suggestion will shift the code to make space untuk the suggestion inline.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.longDistanceHintCont: Mengontrol bagaimana many lines of surrounding context are ditampilkan above dan below the target line in the long distance inline suggestion preview. Set to 0 to only tampilkan the target line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.renderSideBySide: Mengontrol apakah larger suggestions can be ditampilkan side oleh side.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.showCollapsed: Mengontrol apakah the suggestion will tampilkan as diciutkan until jumping to it.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.showLongDistanceHint: Mengontrol apakah long distance inline suggestions are ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.emptyResponseInformation: Mengontrol apakah to send request information dari the inline suggestion provider.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.enabled: Mengontrol apakah to automatically tampilkan inline suggestions in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.fontFamily: Mengontrol font family of the inline suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.minShowDelay: Mengontrol minimal delay in milliseconds after which inline suggestions are ditampilkan after typing.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showOnSuggestConflict: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan inline suggestions when there is a suggest conflict.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showToolbar: Mengontrol when to tampilkan the inline suggestion toolbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showToolbar.always: tampilkan the inline suggestion toolbar whenever an inline suggestion is ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showToolbar.never: Never tampilkan the inline suggestion toolbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showToolbar.onHover: tampilkan the inline suggestion toolbar when hovering over an inline suggestion.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.suppressInlineSuggestions: Suppresses inline completions untuk specified ekstensi IDs -- comma separated.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.suppressInSnippetMode: Mengontrol apakah inline suggestions are suppressed when in snippet mode.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.suppressSuggestions: Mengontrol bagaimana inline suggestions interact dengan the suggest widget. If diaktifkan, the suggest widget is not ditampilkan automatically when inline suggestions are available.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.syntaxHighlightingEnabled: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan syntax highlighting untuk inline suggestions in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.triggerCommandOnProviderCh: Mengontrol apakah to trigger a command when the inline suggestion provider changes.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.lineHeight:
Mengontrol line height. 
 - Use 0 to automatically compute the line height dari the font size.
 - Values between 0 dan 8 will be used as a multiplier dengan the font size.
 - Values greater than atau equal to 8 will be used as effective values.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.lineNumbers.interval: Line numbers are rendered every 10 lines.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.lineNumbers.on: Line numbers are rendered as absolute number.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.lineNumbers.relative: Line numbers are rendered as distance in lines to cursor position.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.linkedEditing: Mengontrol apakah the editor has linked editing diaktifkan. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags, are diperbarui while editing.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.links: Mengontrol apakah the editor should detect links dan make them clickable.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.autohide: Mengontrol apakah the peta mini is tersembunyi automatically.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.autohide.mouseover: The peta mini is tersembunyi when mouse is not over the peta mini dan ditampilkan when mouse is over the peta mini.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.autohide.none: The peta mini is always ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.autohide.scroll: The peta mini is only ditampilkan when the editor is scrolled
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.enabled: Mengontrol apakah the peta mini is ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.markSectionHeaderRegex: Defines the regular expression used to cari section headers in comments. The regex must contain a named match grup `label` (written as `(?<label>.+)`) that encapsulates the section header, otherwise it will not work. Optionally you can include another match grup named `separator`. Use \n in the pattern to match multi-line headers.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.maxColumn: Limit the width of the peta mini to render at most a certain number of columns.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.renderCharacters: Render the actual characters on a line as opposed to color blocks.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.scale: Scale of content drawn in the peta mini: 1, 2 atau 3.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.sectionHeaderFontSize: Mengontrol font size of section headers in the peta mini.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.sectionHeaderLetterSpacing: Mengontrol amount of space (in pixels) between characters of section header. This helps the readability of the header in small font sizes.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.showMarkSectionHeaders: Mengontrol apakah MARK: comments are ditampilkan as section headers in the peta mini.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.showRegionSectionHeaders: Mengontrol apakah named regions are ditampilkan as section headers in the peta mini.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.showSlider: Mengontrol when the peta mini slider is ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.side: Mengontrol side where to render the peta mini.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.size: Mengontrol size of the peta mini.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.size.fill: The peta mini will stretch atau shrink as necessary to fill the height of the editor (no scrolling).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.size.fit: The peta mini will shrink as necessary to never be larger than the editor (no scrolling).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.minimap.size.proportional: The peta mini has the same size as the editor contents (dan might scroll).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseMiddleClickAction: Mengontrol what happens when middle mouse button is clicked in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` dan `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseWheelZoom: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel dan holding `Ctrl`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseWheelZoom.mac: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel dan holding `Cmd`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorLimit: Mengontrol max number of cursors that can be in an aktif editor at once.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorMergeOverlapping: Merge multiple cursors when they are overlapping.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorModifier: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors dengan the mouse. The Go to Definition dan buka Link mouse gestures will adapt such that they do not conflict dengan the [multicursor modifier](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_multicursor-modifier).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorModifier.alt: Maps to `Alt` on jendela dan Linux dan to `Option` on macOS.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorModifier.ctrlCmd: Maps to `Control` on jendela dan Linux dan to `Command` on macOS.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorPaste: Mengontrol menempelkan when the line count of the ditempelkan text matches the cursor count, atau when menempelkan column selections ke a single cursor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorPaste.full: Each cursor pastes the full text.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorPaste.spread: Each cursor pastes a single line of the text. When menempelkan column selections ke a single cursor, each disalin line is ditempelkan on a successive destination line dan padded dengan spaces to form a rectangle.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlight: Mengontrol apakah occurrences should be highlighted across buka berkas.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlight.multiFile: Experimental: Highlights occurrences across all valid buka berkas.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlight.singleFile: Highlights occurrences only in the saat ini berkas.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlightDelay: Mengontrol delay in milliseconds after which occurrences are highlighted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlightFromAllProviders: Mengontrol apakah single-document highlights dari all matching providers are merged. When diaktifkan, basic word-based highlighting is only used if no other provider matches.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.offWhenInlineCompletions: Quick suggestions are dinonaktifkan when inline completions are menampilkan
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.on: Quick suggestions tampilkan inside the suggest widget
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.overtypeCursorStyle: Mengontrol cursor style in overtype input mode.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.overviewRulerBorder: Mengontrol apakah a border should be drawn around the overview ruler.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.padding.bottom: Mengontrol amount of space between the bottom edge of the editor dan the last line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.padding.top: Mengontrol amount of space between the top edge of the editor dan the first line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.parameterHints.cycle: Mengontrol apakah the parameter hints menu cycles atau closes when reaching the end of the list.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.parameterHints.enabled: Mengaktifkan a pop-up that shows parameter documentation dan type information as you type.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.enabled: Mengontrol apakah you can tempel content in different ways.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.showPasteSelector: Mengontrol jika a widget is ditampilkan when menempelkan content in to the editor. This widget lets you control how the berkas is ditempelkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.showPasteSelector.afterPaste: tampilkan the tempel selector widget after content is ditempelkan ke the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.showPasteSelector.never: Never tampilkan the tempel selector widget. Instead the bawaan menempelkan behavior is always used.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.peekWidgetDefaultFocus: Mengontrol apakah to focus the inline editor atau the tree in the peek widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.peekWidgetDefaultFocus.editor: Focus the editor when membuka peek
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.peekWidgetDefaultFocus.tree: Focus the tree when membuka peek
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestions: Mengontrol apakah suggestions should automatically tampilkan up while typing. This can be controlled untuk typing in comments, strings, dan other code. Quick suggestion can be dikonfigurasi to tampilkan as ghost text atau dengan the suggest widget. Also be aware of the {0}-pengaturan which controls if suggestions are triggered oleh special characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestions.other: Aktifkan quick suggestions outside of strings dan comments.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestions.topLevel.inline: Quick suggestions tampilkan as ghost text untuk all token types
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestions.topLevel.off: Quick suggestions are dinonaktifkan untuk all token types
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestions.topLevel.offWhenInlineC: Quick suggestions are dinonaktifkan untuk all token types when inline completions are menampilkan
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestions.topLevel.on: Quick suggestions are diaktifkan untuk all token types
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestionsDelay: Mengontrol delay in milliseconds after which quick suggestions will tampilkan up.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renameOnType: Mengontrol apakah the editor auto renames on type.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderControlCharacters: Mengontrol apakah the editor should render control characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderFinalNewline: Render last line number when the berkas ends dengan a newline.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderLineHighlight: Mengontrol bagaimana the editor should render the saat ini line highlight.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderLineHighlight.all: Highlights both the gutter dan the saat ini line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus: Mengontrol jika the editor should render the saat ini line highlight only when the editor is focused.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderRichScreenReaderContent: Apakah akan render rich screen reader content when the `#editor.editContext#` pengaturan is diaktifkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace: Mengontrol bagaimana the editor should render whitespace characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace.boundary: Render whitespace characters except untuk single spaces between words.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace.selection: Render whitespace characters only on terpilih text.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.roundedSelection: Mengontrol apakah selections should have rounded corners.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.rulers: Render vertical rulers after a certain number of monospace characters. Use multiple values untuk multiple rulers. No rulers are drawn if array is empty.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.rulers.size: Number of monospace characters at which this editor ruler will render.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggestion: Control whether inline suggestions are announced oleh a screen reader.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.horizontal: Mengontrol visibility of the horizontal scrollbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.horizontal.auto: The horizontal scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.horizontal.fit: The horizontal scrollbar will always be tersembunyi.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.horizontal.visible: The horizontal scrollbar will always be visible.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.horizontalScrollbarSize: The height of the horizontal scrollbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.ignoreHorizontalScrollbarInCon: Saat set, the horizontal scrollbar will not increase the size of the editor's content.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.scrollByPage: Mengontrol apakah clicks scroll oleh page atau jump to click position.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.vertical: Mengontrol visibility of the vertical scrollbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.vertical.auto: The vertical scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.vertical.fit: The vertical scrollbar will always be tersembunyi.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.vertical.visible: The vertical scrollbar will always be visible.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize: The width of the vertical scrollbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollBeyondLastColumn: Mengontrol number of extra characters beyond which the editor will scroll horizontally.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollBeyondLastLine: Mengontrol apakah the editor will scroll beyond the last line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollOnMiddleClick: Mengontrol apakah the editor will scroll when the middle button is pressed.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollPredominantAxis: Scroll only along the predominant axis when scrolling both vertically dan horizontally at the same time. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectedTextMatchMode: Mengontrol bagaimana occurrences of terpilih text are matched when memilih the next, previous, atau all occurrences dan when highlighting selection matches. `caseSensitive` dan `caseInsensitive` match substrings independently of the cari widget. An empty selection always starts a whole-word, case-sensitive cari.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectedTextMatchMode.caseInsensitive: Match occurrences case-insensitively dan independently of the cari widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectedTextMatchMode.caseSensitive: Match occurrences case-sensitively dan independently of the cari widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectedTextMatchMode.findOptions: Use the cari widget's match case dan whole word pengaturan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectionClipboard: Mengontrol apakah the Linux primary clipboard should be supported.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectionHighlight: Mengontrol apakah the editor should highlight matches similar to the selection.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectionHighlightMaxLength: Mengontrol bagaimana many characters can be in the selection before similar matches are not highlighted. Set to zero untuk unlimited.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectionHighlightMultiline: Mengontrol apakah the editor should highlight selection matches that span multiple lines.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace: Apakah leading dan trailing whitespace should always be terpilih.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectSubwords: Apakah subwords (like 'foo' in 'fooBar' atau 'foo_bar') should be terpilih.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showFoldingControls: Mengontrol when the folding controls on the gutter are ditampilkan.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showFoldingControls.mouseover: Only tampilkan the folding controls when the mouse is over the gutter.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showFoldingControls.never: Never tampilkan the folding controls dan reduce the gutter size.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showUnused: Mengontrol fading out of unused code.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.smoothScrolling: Mengontrol apakah the editor will scroll using an animation.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions: Mengontrol apakah snippets are ditampilkan dengan other suggestions dan how they are sorted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions.bottom: tampilkan snippet suggestions below other suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions.inline: tampilkan snippets suggestions dengan other suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions.top: tampilkan snippet suggestions on top of other suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.stickyTabStops: Emulate selection behavior of tab characters when using spaces untuk indentation. Selection will stick to tab stops.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.filterGraceful: Mengontrol apakah filtering dan sorting suggestions accounts untuk small typos.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode: Mengontrol apakah words are overwritten when accepting completions. Note that this depends on ekstensi opting ke this feature.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.always: Always pilih a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.insert: Insert suggestion tanpa overwriting text right of the cursor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.never: Never pilih a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.replace: Insert suggestion dan overwrite text right of the cursor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.whenQuickSuggestion: pilih a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense as you type.

vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostCu.agentHost.config.defaultShell.descriptio: Absolute path to the shell executable used oleh host-dikelola terminals. Normally pushed oleh the connected VS Code client dari `terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.<os>` (falling back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.<os>`); when unset, the agen host falls back to the system shell. Only the path is supported; `args` dan `env` dari the workbench profile are not piped through yet. The workbench only pushes this untuk the local agen host — remote agen host operators should set this directly in the remote machine's `agent-host-config.json`.

When set, the agen host authenticates dan makes GitHub API calls against this instance instead of github.com. Normally pushed oleh the connected VS Code client dari the terpilih enterprise account's authorization server; remote agen host operators can set it directly in the remote `agent-host-config.json`.

vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.agentMode: agen Host sesi targets can remain available in the editor even when agen mode is dinonaktifkan oleh policy.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.customizations: The workbench filters synchronized kustomisasi, but runtime discovery dan standalone instruksi do not have equivalent coverage across policy sources.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.hooks: The Local-only kait switch does not nonaktifkan runtime-discovered agen Host kait.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.managedHooks: Shared prompt discovery filters kait, but the VS Code-only requirement is not delivered to runtime berkas kait. Runtime-native dikelola-kait dan SDK callback behavior needs separate verification.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.marketplaces: Shared marketplace discovery dan installation honor additional marketplaces. Runtime-owned marketplace operations do not receive VS Code-only values dan need separate verification.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.mcpAccess: The workbench filters forwarded MCP collections, but agen Host can independently discover dan jalankan server MCP despite the VS Code MCP access restriction.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.mcpAuth: Forwarded MCP authentication does not use Local's enterprise-dikelola identity-provider lookup. Enterprise single sign-on may be unavailable; runtime-owned authentication paths are not certified oleh this check.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.mcpLists: VS Code-only server restrictions are not delivered to all agen Host discovery paths. Runtime dikelola pengaturan have separate enforcement; this report does not assume the two sources are equivalent.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.network: Shared browser alat dan custom terminal sandboxing honor domain lists, but native SDK sandboxing does not terapkan those lists. The bridge covers only supported runtime URL denies. Access may be allowed atau blocked differently dari Local.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.otelHeaders: VS Code-only exporter headers do not reach agen Host. Export requiring those headers may fail; runtime-dikelola telemetry does not establish coverage of the host's own exporter.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.otelIdentity: The agen Host pipeline honors identity capture dan suppression. Authenticated runtime account attribution still requires a runtime perbarui dan end-to-end verification; direct runtime exports use their own identity controls.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.otelProtocol: untuk this local Copilot/VS Code policy diagnostic, inherited OTLP protocol configuration can still override an aktif collector exporter. It does not certify remote hosts atau independently fetched runtime policy.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.plugins: The workbench filters synchronized plugin, but runtime discovery dan more specific kustomisasi decisions do not have equivalent policy coverage.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.terminalApproval: Native shell commands require approval through the bridge. Custom terminal alat do not have equivalent dikelola-ask coverage in every approval mode.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.toolApproval: Allow All is dinonaktifkan sesi-wide, but alat excluded oleh policy can still be approved automatically through other approval paths.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostPo.policyGap.unknown: agen Host does not fully enforce this dikonfigurasi requirement. Review its policy support before migrating.

vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.agentOrchestrationLimits: Mengontrol per-sesi limits, over a sliding one-hour jendela, on sesi dan chats dibuat dan messages sent, dan the depth of recursive sesi spawning, oleh agen Host sesi alat. Confirmation requirements dan input validation are unchanged.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.ahpJsonlLogging: Saat diaktifkan, captures AHP transport messages once: in the jendela untuk local dan remote connections, atau on the host untuk Mission Control connections. diaktifkan secara bawaan only in Insiders. Each logging process stops capture after writing 500 MiB across all connections, including reconnects. Existing per-connection rotation still applies. mulai ulang the jendela atau host process to atur ulang its budget. Mission Control host capture follows the host's owning jendela pengaturan, including live changes.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, ekstensi-provided BYOK ('bring your own key') models can jalankan in agen-host sesi. Changes are synchronized to the berjalan agen host dan do not require a mulai ulang.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.claudeAgent.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, the agen host registers the Claude provider, subject to the Claude SDK being reachable. The agen host process must be dimulai ulang untuk changes to take effect.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.claudeAgent.enabled.polic: Aktifkan Claude agen sesi in VS Code. mulai dan resume agentic coding sesi powered oleh Anthropic Claude agen SDK directly in the editor. Uses your existing Copilot subscription.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.codexAgent.binaryArgs: Additional command-line arguments passed to `codex app-server`. Primarily useful untuk debugging (untuk example, `--log-level=debug`).
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.codexAgent.codexHome: Optional override untuk `$CODEX_HOME`. Controls where the codex binary reads config dan writes rollouts. When empty, codex uses its bawaan (`~/.codex`).
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, the agen host registers the Codex provider (subject to the Codex SDK being reachable). mengaktifkan takes effect tanpa memulai ulang the agen host.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled.policy: Aktifkan Codex agen sesi in VS Code. mulai dan resume agentic coding sesi powered oleh OpenAI Codex. Usage can be routed through GitHub Copilot atau authenticated directly dengan an OpenAI account.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.codexAgent.sdkRoot: Experimental, untuk local SDK development only. Absolute path to a direktori containing `node_modules/@openai/codex`. When set, the agen host spawns the Codex binary dari this tree instead of downloading the SDK. Empty (the bawaan) falls through to the SDK distribution shipped dengan this build. The agen host process must be dimulai ulang untuk changes to take effect.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.computerUse.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, local Copilot agen sesi on macOS dan jendela offer GitHub's Computer Use plugin, which can operate desktop applications. The plugin is downloaded on first use. Turn it on dengan `/computer on` in a Copilot chat, atau when the agen asks. Each application still requires your approval. Changes take effect after a mulai ulang.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.experimental.autoAttachPu: Mengontrol apakah the agen Host automatically discovers dan associates a pull request untuk the currently checked-out branch. When dinonaktifkan, only pull requests recorded oleh the agen as artifacts atau explicitly terpilih atau dibuat through sesi actions are considered.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.experimental.markdownPlan: Saat diaktifkan, agen receive guidance untuk using rich links to issues, pull requests, commits, sesi, dan chats, plus berjalan task markers, when membuat atau editing Markdown plan documents.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.experimental.mcpToolRouti: Saat diaktifkan dan alat cari is available, agen-host sesi use cached MCP alat metadata to route requests dan only prompt untuk MCP authentication when a server is relevant. Routing alat wait untuk the terpilih server's alat to become available. Servers tanpa routing alat retain proactive sign-in hints. Newly dibuat sesi pick up changes to this pengaturan.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.experimental.overlapProvi: Saat diaktifkan, agen prepare their sesi untuk a new turn, such as memulai the runtime sesi, while the turn-mulai checkpoint is captured instead of after it. This can shorten the time to the first response, especially on the first turn of a sesi.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.experimental.prewarmSessi: Saat diaktifkan, new agen Host Copilot chats mulai their runtime dan server MCP before the first message is sent, so connectors are ready sooner. Changes terapkan to new chats.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.githubMcpServer.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, agen-host sesi include the GitHub server MCP.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.captureContent: Saat diaktifkan, includes prompt dan response content in OTel span attributes. Configurable in user pengaturan only. Sets `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT`. Privacy-sensitive: do not aktifkan in environments that ship spans to shared sinks.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.captureContent.polic: Mengontrol apakah Copilot OpenTelemetry export captures prompt, response, dan alat content.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.captureIdentity.poli: Mengontrol apakah Copilot OpenTelemetry captures the authenticated account name, operating system username, dan machine hostname. Independent of content capture.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.dbSpanExporter.enabl: Saat diaktifkan, the agen host persists every emitted OTel span to a local SQLite database. Configurable in user pengaturan only. Spans can be inspected via the `Export Agent Host Traces Database` command. Compatible dengan external exporters: spans are written to SQLite *dan* forwarded to the user-dikonfigurasi sink.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, the agen host emits OpenTelemetry traces dari the Copilot SDK. Configurable in user pengaturan only. Either konfigurasikan `#chat.agentHost.otel.otlpEndpoint#` to ship traces to an external collector atau aktifkan `#chat.agentHost.otel.dbSpanExporter.enabled#` to capture them locally.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.enabled.policy: Mengontrol apakah Copilot OpenTelemetry export is diaktifkan. When dikelola, users cannot override the enterprise value.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.exporterType: Exporter backend used oleh the Copilot SDK when `#chat.agentHost.otel.enabled#` is on. Configurable in user pengaturan only. `otlp-grpc` is downgraded to `otlp-http` transparently in the CLI runtime.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.headers: Enterprise-dikelola OTLP exporter headers (e.g. auth tokens) untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export. Policy-only dan ekstensi-only: diterapkan directly to the Copilot Chat ekstensi's OTLP exporter, never delivered to the agen host process.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.headers.policy: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola OTLP exporter headers untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.otlpEndpoint: OTLP endpoint URL when exporter type is `otlp-http` atau `otlp-grpc`. Configurable in user pengaturan only. Sets `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` inside the agen host process.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.otlpEndpoint.policy: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola OTLP collector endpoint untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.otlpProtocol: Enterprise-dikelola OTLP wire protocol (`http/json`, `http/protobuf`, atau `grpc`) untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export. Policy-only: there is no user-facing pengaturan; it carries the dikelola `telemetry.protocol` so the agen host's `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` distinguishes protobuf dari json.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.otlpProtocol.policy: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola OTLP wire protocol (protobuf vs JSON) untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.outfile: keluaran path untuk span JSON lines when exporter type is `file`. An enterprise-dikelola telemetry berkas path takes precedence over user pengaturan. Sets `COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH`.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.outfile.policy: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola berkas export destination untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry dan prevents local berkas export when an enterprise OTLP destination is dikonfigurasi.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.protocol.policy: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola OTLP protocol untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.protocol.policy.cons: Console exporter is not terpilih oleh enterprise dikelola pengaturan.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.resourceAttributes: Enterprise-dikelola OTel resource attributes untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export. Policy-only: there is no user-facing pengaturan; it carries the dikelola `telemetry.resourceAttributes` map so the agen host's `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` includes the deployment's attributes.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.resourceAttributes.p: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola OTel resource attributes untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.serviceName: Enterprise-dikelola OTel `service.name` resource attribute untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export. Policy-only: there is no user-facing pengaturan; it carries the dikelola `telemetry.serviceName` so the agen host's `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` identifies spans dari this deployment.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.otel.serviceName.policy: Mengontrol enterprise-dikelola OTel `service.name` resource attribute untuk Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentHost.systemProxy.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot sesi automatically discover dan use the operating system's proxy configuration when no proxy environment variable is set.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.addressReviews: Mengontrol apakah diaktifkan agen Merge sesi address unresolved review threads, changes-requested reviews, dan new pull request comments dari repository maintainers atau the Copilot pull request reviewer.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.enabled: Mengaktifkan the experimental agen Merge controller dan its commands. agen Merge can monitor an agen sesi's pull request, ask the agen to address terpilih blockers, dan optionally merge the pull request when it is ready. It is paused while `#chat.artifactIntegrations.enabled#` is diaktifkan; its tersimpan choices are preserved.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.fixCI: Mengontrol apakah diaktifkan agen Merge sesi ask the agen to fix failed required CI checks.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod: Mengontrol native merge method used oleh agen Merge.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod.auto: Uses the first repository-compatible method in this order: squash, merge commit, rebase.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod.merge: Uses a merge commit when the repository permits it.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod.rebase: Uses rebase merge when the repository permits it.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod.squash: Uses squash merge when the repository permits it.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest: Mengontrol apakah the agen Host automatically merges atau enqueues pull requests untuk diaktifkan agen Merge sesi after all terpilih maintenance work is complete.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest.always: Merges the pull request whenever it is ready, including after agen Merge has fixed CI failures atau addressed review feedback.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest.ifUncha: Merges the pull request only while agen Merge has not changed it. Once a repair turn lands a commit, automatic merging turns itself off untuk that sesi so the changes can be reviewed.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest.never: Never merges the pull request automatically.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.replyAttribution: Mengontrol apakah review-thread replies posted oleh agen Merge include an automated-reply attribution note.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.agentMerge.resolveConflicts: Mengontrol apakah diaktifkan agen Merge sesi ask the agen to perbarui branches that are behind atau resolve merge conflicts.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.canvases.enabled: Mengontrol apakah local agen Host Copilot sesi can buka kanvas dengan interactive content in the agen jendela dan the editor jendela. Newly dibuat sesi pick up changes to this pengaturan.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.canvases.enabled.policy: Mengontrol apakah Copilot sesi can use kanvas to present interactive content.
vs/platform/agentHost/common/agentHostSt.chat.experimental.workspaceSnapshot: Saat diaktifkan, the first turn of a new Copilot agen host chat includes a bounded berkas-name snapshot of its working direktori, so the agen can orient itself tanpa listing the ruang kerja first. berkas contents are never included.

vs/platform/agentHost/common/sessionComp.sessionComparison.judgePrompt:
Judge implementation comparison `__TOK_0__`.

1. Call `#readAttemptComparison` exactly once dengan this comparison ID.
2. Review every attempt's code changes dan validation evidence. Use `get_session_context` dengan the exact manifest target to identify validation that the attempt already completed. terminal commands mulai in the Judge worktree, not an attempt worktree, so explicitly `cd` to the exact `worktree.workingDirectory` dari the manifest in every command that inspects atau validates an attempt.
3. Do not rerun a validation category when the attempt report contains a bersihkan result. jalankan only missing targeted tests, build, lint, atau diagnostics needed to make a reliable recommendation. If required dependencies atau build artifacts are unavailable, record that validation as unavailable; do not pasang atau build dependencies, dan do not substitute a different validation category.
4. untuk each validation category, record one consistent `state` dan `source` evidence pair. Known `passed` atau `failed` results must use `attemptReport` atau `judgeRun`; use `unavailable` only dengan `notRun` atau `unknown`, dan use `notApplicable` untuk both fields when the category genuinely does not terapkan.
5. Keep `explanation` to one sentence. Fill `rationale` dengan exactly four concise points in this order: `comparison`, `validation`, `codeQuality`, dan `solution`. Each point must cite concrete evidence, contain no line breaks, dan stay within the alat schema length limit. untuk every other attempt, record its strongest reusable points in `notableDifferences`.
6. Do not modify, merge, terapkan, atau hapus any attempt.
7. Call `#completeAttemptComparison` dengan the recommendation dan supporting evidence. Refer to attempts only oleh the `attemptNumber` values returned oleh `#readAttemptComparison`; do not salin peserta atau sesi UUIDs. If it rejects invalid input, correct the reported fields dan retry; do not submit again after success.
8. After the alat returns, identify the winner as `Attempt N (agent, model, effort)` dan use the same rationale order, followed oleh the strongest reusable points dari every other attempt.

It asks this sesi's agen to buat the pull request dengan your terpilih options dan generate its own title dan description, tanpa using the form's text. The last-used action becomes the primary button. Control+Enter on jendela dan Linux, atau Command+Enter on macOS, runs that primary action. vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.activities: Activities appears below Autopilot when an artifact has activity. It starts diciutkan. Its heading shows the number of loaded activities, which increases when Earlier Activities loads older riwayat. Use Enter atau Space on its heading to bentangkan it, then arrow keys to read the newest activity first. Scrolling past either end of the list scrolls the surrounding panel. Only rows dengan a chat destination respond to clicking atau Enter; they reveal the related message. Other rows are informational. Pending actions offer batalkan Action, dan uncertain outcomes offer Reconcile Outcome. The Accessible tampilan includes the activity count dan text.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.automationPill: Artifacts dengan diaktifkan Autopilot rules have a trailing pill section dengan an Autopilot icon dan the number of diaktifkan rules. pilih it to buka dan focus Autopilot. This count includes tersimpan diaktifkan rules even when new enablement is temporarily unavailable.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.autopilot: All Available Autopilot Rules applies only to its provider's currently available rules. The diaktifkan count describes partial enablement. mengaktifkan a grup saves immediately dan uses the policies ditampilkan in the dropdowns. menonaktifkan a grup revokes diaktifkan rules tanpa mengaktifkan unavailable ones.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.controls: Use Tab dan Shift+Tab to move between controls. Buttons below the state lists jalankan actions once. diaktifkan actions come first in provider order, dan the first action is primary. List rows tampilkan a single line; their full text dan state remain available to screen readers dan in hovers. Use Space to change an Autopilot switch. mengaktifkan a rule grants permission untuk future automatic runs; it can jalankan immediately if its condition already holds. Turning it off prevents new runs, but does not batalkan work already dimulai.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.description: Descriptions tampilkan at most three lines. The Accessible tampilan includes the full description. When a provider supplies more information about a list, use Tab to reach its information icon dan Enter atau Space to read the hover.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.dismiss: Escape atau tutup returns focus to the invoking pill. Clicking outside, including in the chat input, dismisses details tanpa moving focus back. Clicking another artifact switches this panel; clicking its status section selects dan focuses the corresponding list, atau focuses its action.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.focus: A temporarily unavailable switch moves focus to its explanation, then back when available, unless you move focus elsewhere. diaktifkan automation remains available to turn off.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.itemActions: Some list rows offer actions untuk that item, such as rerunning a failed check atau resolving a review comment. They appear at the end of a row when it is hovered atau focused. dari the list, press Tab to reach the focused row's actions, Left dan Right Arrow to move between them, dan Enter atau Space to jalankan one. Shift+Tab returns to the list. Item actions jalankan immediately dan keep the details buka; their row shows progress until they finish, dan failures are reported. The Accessible tampilan names each item's actions.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.overview: Artifact details tampilkan the full resource title dan state icon, its description, tabbed state lists, actions, Autopilot, dan Activities. Activate the linked title to buka the resource. salin Link dan hapus Artifact are available in the footer.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/artifac.artifactDetailsHelp.tabs: State lists mulai diciutkan. Clicking a state-list tab, atau pressing Enter atau Space on it, expands its list; activating the dibentangkan tab again collapses all lists. While a list is dibentangkan, Left dan Right Arrow, Home, dan End pilih another state-list tab dan keep keyboard focus on the full tab; while all lists are diciutkan, they only move focus between tabs. Clicking a tab moves focus to the first item in its list. Tab moves through the information buttons beside each tab label dan ke the dibentangkan list. Enter atau Space on an information button shows that list's details tanpa memilih its tab. The list area keeps its height when you change tabs. Use arrow keys in a list dan Enter to buka its terpilih item. A pill's status section expands dan focuses its list. Autopilot is diciutkan secara bawaan; its heading expands atau collapses its rules, dan its separate switch enables all available rules atau turns them off. Policy dropdowns remain visible while rules are off. memilih a policy while off does not aktifkan the rule; turning the switch on uses the displayed policy tanpa asking again. Policy selections, dibentangkan tabs, dan Autopilot expansion choices are remembered when reopening the artifact.
