vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.aquariumAction: To tampilkan atau sembunyikan the aquarium action on the new-sesi tampilan, use the checked Aquarium item in the context menu outside the composer, atau jalankan the Toggle Aquarium Action Visibility command.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.archiveChat: To archive an individual nested chat tanpa archiving its sesi, buka the chat's context menu in the sesi list atau chat tab dan choose Archive. The chat is tersembunyi dari the sesi list dan ditutup, but is not dihapus. buka the sesi list Filter menu dan aktifkan Archived to tampilkan it again, then buka the chat's context menu dan choose Unarchive.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.archiveNudge: Saat all GitHub pull requests associated dengan the sesi have merged dan no chat is working atau waiting untuk input, an archive suggestion may appear above the chat input. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach Archive, konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup, atau Dismiss Archive Suggestion, then Enter atau Space to activate it. konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup opens the pengaturan untuk automatically archiving inactive merged sesi dan permanently menghapus automatically archived merged sesi. The explanation under What Does "Archive" Do? is diciutkan secara bawaan. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Dismiss Archive Suggestion, atau Escape while the suggestion is focused, hides the suggestion untuk this sesi, including after a muat ulang, until it is archived atau dihapus, dan returns focus to the chat input. Archiving the sesi hides it dari the sesi list so you can focus on your remaining tasks. The sesi is not dihapus. Ask your agen to cari it, atau look in the "Archived" section of the sesi list. You can unarchive it anytime. The worktree dibuat untuk the sesi, if any, will be dihapus. You can recreate it oleh unarchiving the sesi.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.archiveNudgeContinuation: Sending a new message after the suggestion appears hides it untuk those pull requests, including after a muat ulang. It can appear again when a new pull request is added to the sesi dan all its pull requests have merged.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.archiveNudgeOnboarding: The first time you activate the suggestion's Archive atau Mark as Done button, a spotlight may reveal that sesi's action in the sesi list. It briefly waits untuk the list action to appear. The action waits until you activate the highlighted action, activate Understood, atau press Escape to end the spotlight. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to move between the highlighted action dan Understood, dan Enter atau Space to activate either. If the spotlight cannot be ditampilkan atau is interrupted, the sesi is still archived atau marked as done as long as the suggestion remains available. Once completed atau skipped, the spotlight will not appear again.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.archiveSession: To archive atau mark one atau more sesi as done, focus them in the sesi list dan invoke Archive atau Mark as Done{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactActionDisclosure: Artifact actions appear as diciutkan request cards dengan an action dan resource label. Use Tab to reach the card dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan it. The details are a snapshot dari when the action dimulai. Use arrow keys within a details list dan Enter to buka an item. agen Message switches between these details dan the full prompt. buka the accessible view{0} while the request is focused to read its snapshot as text.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactAutomationFocus: If a focused automation control becomes temporarily unavailable, focus moves to its explanation dan returns to the control when it becomes available, unless you have moved focus elsewhere.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactAutomationNotices: In agen Host sesi, mengaktifkan, changing, atau menonaktifkan an artifact automation adds a notice to the chat that recorded the artifact. Notices explain what will jalankan automatically dan why a rule was turned off, including unsuccessful attempts that caused automatic disablement. Use Tab to reach the notice dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan its details. Notices raised while the agen is working appear after that turn finishes. Automatic repair prompts appear as messages in that chat tanpa mengganti your draft.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactAutopilot: Autopilot grup the opt-in rules untuk automatic actions. It starts diciutkan. Activate its heading to bentangkan the rules, atau use its separate switch to aktifkan all available rules atau turn them off. The trailing artifact pill section shows the number of diaktifkan Autopilot rules dan opens this section.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactIntegrationGroups: Saat two atau more artifacts of the same kind share an integration, such as several pull requests, they appear as one pill named oleh the integration, such as 4 Pull Requests. Its icon shows the state that needs attention most, dan a trailing section counts their diaktifkan Autopilot rules. Enter atau Space opens a list above the pill dengan one toolbar per artifact, menampilkan its state icon, label, status sections dan title. Up dan Down Arrow, Home dan End move between artifacts; Left dan Right Arrow move between an artifact's controls. Tab dan Shift+Tab move through every control dan stay in the list. Enter atau Space on the label opens the artifact's details, dan on a status section opens the matching list. The artifact's actions, such as buka, buka Pull Request Changes, salin Link, Pin dan hapus, follow its status sections. Pin moves the artifact ke a pill of its own; that pill's context menu{0} dan trailing button offer Unpin. Escape closes the list dan returns focus to the pill.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactIntegrations: Artifacts dan references dengan an integration that are not grouped appear as individual pills above the input. Enter atau Space on a main pill opens an input-width details panel above the pills tanpa moving the conversation atau draft. The terpilih pill has a highlighted border. Details tampilkan the linked title, state icon dan up to three lines of the actual description. salin Link dan hapus Artifact appear in the footer. Left dan Right Arrow, Home dan End pilih a list tab. Clicking a tab focuses its first item; arrow keys navigate list rows dan Enter opens an item. Some rows offer item actions, such as rerunning a check, which Tab reaches dari the list. A pill's status section selects dan focuses the corresponding list atau action, including when already buka. Lists tampilkan single-line rows, dengan full text available in hovers dan the Accessible tampilan. Actions below the lists jalankan once; diaktifkan actions come first in provider order, dengan the first action primary. Inapplicable actions are tersembunyi dan blocked actions explain why. Autopilot grup automatic rules below the lists, dengan an Activities card below it when riwayat exists. Both cards mulai diciutkan dan remember expansion. Autopilot switches grant standing permission dan may jalankan immediately when conditions hold. tersimpan rules remain revocable while unavailable. Turning a rule off prevents new runs but does not batalkan work already dimulai. Some activity rows reveal their related chat message; others are informational. Clicking another artifact switches the panel. Clicking the aktif pill, Escape atau tutup dismisses it. Escape dan tutup restore pill focus; outside clicks dismiss tanpa moving focus back. Use Tab dan Shift+Tab between controls, Space to change a switch, dan accessibility help atau the Accessible View{0} to read the full content. Background prompts do not ganti your draft, attachments atau visible chat.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactIntegrationSetting: The {0} pengaturan enables live artifact details, actions, dan Autopilot instead of agen Merge. It is off secara bawaan. Switching pauses tersimpan automation choices dan stops automation-owned work tanpa cancelling human-dimulai work. Switching back can resume previously diaktifkan rules; it does not grant new permission. Ordinary artifact links dan recorded riwayat remain available.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactListInformation: Artifact details remember the terpilih list tab when ditutup dan reopened. A tab can offer an information icon; hover it atau focus it dan press Enter atau Space to read the provider's explanation tanpa changing tabs. The Comments tab describes which review comments it includes.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.artifactSignIn: Saat an artifact needs authentication, buka its details dan use Tab to reach Sign In. Enter atau Space starts authentication in this jendela. The resource remains available dari the linked title. Signing in does not aktifkan automation.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.background: Outside high contrast themes, use Set Background to choose no background, the built-in theme-aware Codicons pattern, a new image, atau one of the five most recently terpilih images. One randomly terpilih icon in the Codicons pattern is a Celebrate button; press Tab to cari it, then press Enter atau Space to activate it. Each activation selects another random icon as the next Celebrate button. Use Change Background Layout to choose whether an image repeats, stretches, atau appears at an edge atau corner untuk the saat ini color theme. Moving through the layout picker previews each option; pilih one to simpan it, atau press Escape to restore the previous layout. Both commands are available dari the palet perintah dan oleh right-clicking empty chat space. Change Background Layout is ditampilkan only untuk images. Background kustomisasi is unavailable while a high contrast theme is aktif.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.backgroundActivities: Tekan Shift+Tab dari the chat input to reach metadata dan status pills above it, use the left dan right arrows to move between pills, dan press Enter atau Space to activate one. Live browsers appear in their own pill, dan the chat's subagents appear in another. An aggregated pill opens a picker. Use Pin on a picker row to keep that entry as its own pill; it is dihapus dari the picker, dan a sole remaining entry is ditampilkan directly unless it requires a details picker. A pinned pill shows a trailing Unpin button that pointer users can activate to unpin it. Keyboard dan screen reader users can buka the pinned pill's context menu dan choose Unpin. Pin choices are remembered untuk each chat. Subagents are grouped under Subagents: In Progress dan Subagents: Completed. In Progress includes subagents waiting untuk input; Completed includes failed subagents. Use the up dan down arrows to move between entries. When an entry has details, Tab moves through its row actions dan detail links; Shift+Tab returns to the row action, dan the up dan down arrows continue moving between entries. Press Enter to buka an entry, atau Escape to dismiss the picker dan return focus untuk the pill.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.backgroundTint: Saat a background image is set, use Tint jendela to Match Background in the palet perintah atau the background context menu to turn matching jendela colors on atau off. A check mark means tinting is diaktifkan. Turning it off keeps the background image dan restores the original jendela colors.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.blobby: Ketik /blobby untuk unlock True Name tanpa sending a chat request. If Blobby is off, it turns on; if it is already on, the Color tab opens. Change Color in the pet's context menu always opens Color. Stable dan Insiders are free choices; True Name unlocks solid dan custom colors. Activating the True Name achievement card atau account badge also opens Color. Use the color picker atau enter an opaque hex color such as #ff8800, then activate terapkan Color. Unapplied custom colors are dibuang when you leave the tab atau tutup the modal.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.branchPickerUpstream: untuk a new agen Host sesi in a Git repository, use Tab to reach the branch picker dan press Enter atau Space to choose a base branch. dengan New Worktree terpilih, the saat ini branch's tracked upstream is terpilih secara bawaan when available; otherwise the bawaan branch is terpilih. The picker lists the saat ini branch's upstream dan the saat ini branch when it is not the bawaan branch, then the bawaan branch's remote-tracking branch dan the bawaan branch, then the other branches, dengan a separator between each grup, dan focuses the terpilih branch when it opens. Each branch is announced dengan its grup name: saat ini Branch, bawaan Branch, atau Branches. dengan Branch terpilih, the checked-out branch, which is the terpilih branch, is listed first when it is not the bawaan branch, followed oleh the bawaan branch in its own grup, then the other branches. Use the arrow keys to choose a branch dan press Enter to pilih it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.canvases: Available kanvas appear in their own pill. A single kanvas shows its title dan opens directly; multiple kanvas tampilkan a count dan buka a picker. Activating a kanvas focuses its buka tab atau reopens it if it was ditutup. To tutup a kanvas rather than only its tab, use tutup kanvas: the X on a kanvas pill atau picker row, atau the pill's context menu. menutup ends the kanvas dan notifies the ekstensi that provides it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.chatGroups: Chats can be arranged in grup. Focus the previous group{0} atau next group{1}. Split the aktif chat ke a grup to the right{2} atau below{3}, atau move it to the previous group{4} atau next group{5}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.chatHeaderHierarchy: In both single dan multiple tab layouts, sub-sesi in separate panes tampilkan their title followed oleh a dot dan parent context as a secondary description, like editor tabs. This includes panes split within the parent sesi dan panes positioned independently in the jendela. Sub-sesi sharing their parent's tab strip tampilkan only their title. Drag a sub-sesi tab atau header outside its parent area to place that chat independently beside another sesi, tanpa moving its parent. The chat keeps its original parent relationship. menutup the parent pane leaves independent sub-sesi panes buka. You can drag a sub-sesi dari the sidebar ke the grid while its parent pane is ditutup. In multiple tab mode, drop it onto its parent's tab strip to reattach it as a tab, tanpa membuat a split. The parent's tab strip stays visible while a sub-sesi is detached. In single tab mode, detached sub-sesi cannot be dropped back ke their parent panel. You can also use the split dan move chat commands described above; sesi grid navigation dan movement commands operate on the focused independent pane.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.clearWorkspace: Saat the saat ini environment dan harness support chatting tanpa a ruang kerja, hover over atau focus the ruang kerja picker to reveal Chat tanpa a ruang kerja. Use Tab atau the Left dan Right arrow keys to reach this button, then Enter atau Space to switch to Chat tanpa membuang your prompt. You can send tanpa choosing a ruang kerja. Focus returns to the ruang kerja picker so you can choose a ruang kerja later. Chat remains available in the ruang kerja list.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.closeChat: Activate a chat tab's tutup button to tutup (sembunyikan) that chat dari the tab strip tanpa menghapus it; reopen it later dari the Chats menu. The sesi's main chat cannot be ditutup.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.closePane: Saat multiple sesi panes are visible, move focus to a pane header dan activate tutup to hapus that pane dari the grid. menutup a pane keeps the sesi dan its worktree available in the sesi list.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.cloudStartupError: If cloud sesi creation atau connection fails, the error notification offers tampilkan Details. Focus the notification, then use Tab to reach tampilkan Details dan Enter atau Space to buka a dialog dengan the failed step dan available request details. membuka details does not sign in atau retry the request.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compactArchiveNudge: After you successfully use the suggestion to archive atau mark a sesi as done three times, future suggestions appear in a compact layout tanpa the explanation. The buttons wrap below the title when space is limited, while Dismiss stays at the top right. The keyboard order is Archive atau Mark as Done, konfigurasikan, then Dismiss. konfigurasikan opens the same automatic cleanup pengaturan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compactSessionPickers: Saat space is limited, the new-sesi pickers tampilkan icons instead of labels tanpa moving to another row. The ruang kerja name remains visible. Icon-only pickers retain their accessible names dan tooltips; activate them to tampilan dan change the saat ini selection.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgents: In the new-sesi input, buka the model picker dan activate Compare Models. In Attempts, check two to ten distinct models. Attempts inherit the saat ini ruang kerja, branch, agen, dan permissions. Done dan Next stay dinonaktifkan until two to ten models are checked, dan the footer shows how many are terpilih. Use Tab to reach Done dan Next. In Judge, optionally pilih a model to review the attempts dan recommend a winner. Leave Judge unselected dan activate Done to jalankan attempts tanpa review. dengan a Judge terpilih, activate Next to choose an optional Synthesizer. tanpa a Synthesizer, review is available but synthesis is not. Activate a terpilih model again to bersihkan it. Back preserves your choices. Done returns to the composer; activate jalankan N Attempts to launch. Escape closes the picker tanpa launching. buka the comparison parent in the sesi list to buka every available attempt in a resizable grid. dengan two attempt panes, both chat inputs remain visible. dengan three atau more, only the aktif attempt pane shows its chat input; focus another attempt pane to tampilkan its input. Screen-reader optimized mode keeps every attempt input visible. After the Judge finishes, its chat shows a scorecard: the winning model dengan the Judge's explanation, then a row untuk each attempt, recommended first, dengan a summary of its validation checks such as Tests passed atau Not jalankan, total time, dan tokens. Use Tab to reach the Checks column header to hear what the checks cover. Focus the comparison result dan use buka Accessible View{0} to read its verdict dan attempt metrics as plain text. Use Tab to reach the attempt rows dan Up Arrow atau Down Arrow to move between them, then press Enter atau Space to bentangkan a row dengan the Judge's reasoning, what is worth keeping, gaps, each check's result, dan buka Attempt N. Each row also has an buka button after its metrics that opens that attempt's sesi. Activate buka Attempt to buka the recommended attempt, atau use its adjacent dropdown to buka another attempt. When synthesis is available, Synthesize starts the Judge's bawaan plan. buka its More Actions menu dan choose Additional Synthesis instruksi to enter requirements that are remembered dan diterapkan to recommended synthesis. Activate mulai Synthesis dengan instruksi, atau press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) in that field, to mulai the recommended plan dengan those requirements. The additional instruksi guide a new synthesis sesi dan do not modify the original attempts.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsConfiguration: Comparison selections are kept while draft permissions atau mode are memperbarui. jalankan N Attempts is unavailable until the perbarui finishes.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsDiscovery: The model picker offers Compare Models in the tab bar. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to begin setup. Use Compare Models{0} dari the new-sesi input atau model picker to buka comparison setup directly. aktifkan the experimental sesi.chat.compareAgents.showPickerHint pengaturan to also tampilkan Send Query to Multiple Models at the bottom dengan your dikonfigurasi shortcut until you first buka comparison setup. The tab-bar toggle remains available to return to single-model selection.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsFolderless: In a Chat dengan no ruang kerja, comparisons jalankan the prompt in separate ruang kerja-less chats. pilih at least two attempts, activate Done, then jalankan N Attempts to compare their responses side oleh side. Folderless comparisons do not offer Judge atau Synthesizer steps.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsGroupActions: Use the comparison header's Mark All as Done action to mark its sesi done, dengan the same confirmation dan urungkan as other grup. When every peserta is done, the automatically dibuat grup is dihapus. urungkan restores the grup dan its sesi. hapus grup remains available dari the comparison header context menu.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsInactivePaneNo: Saat a question alat needs attention in an inactive visible pane, the confirmation notification pengaturan can tampilkan an operating system notification even while another pane in the agen jendela is aktif.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsInstructions: The initial Judge dan synthesis messages are diciutkan under Judge instruksi atau Synthesis instruksi. Use Tab to reach the summary, then press Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan the full instruksi. The complete instruksi remain in the conversation dan in its Accessible tampilan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsOpenInGrid: Attempts buka in a grid when they mulai secara bawaan. Turn off sesi.chat.compareAgents.openInGrid to mulai them tanpa automatic navigation. You can still pilih the comparison grup to buka its grid.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsRationaleOrder: Judge results identify candidates as Attempt N dengan agen, model, dan effort, then present Why it won in this order: Solution, Comparison, Validation, Code quality.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsSetup: Comparison setup is a working salin until you activate Done. Escape atau clicking outside the picker discards setup changes dan keeps your previous single-model atau dikonfigurasi comparison ready to send. Unfinished setup does not resume when you reopen the picker. Done commits your choices dan changes the model label to N Attempts dan Send to jalankan N Attempts. Reopening a dikonfigurasi comparison starts a working salin of those choices.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.compareAgentsTokenWarning: berjalan a comparison uses tokens untuk each sesi. The jalankan N Attempts button shows this warning immediately on hover.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.connectionLog: While connecting to a Dev Container untuk an existing sesi, use Tab to reach tampilkan Log dan press Enter to buka the Dev Container keluaran channel.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.connectorRecommendations: Saat the new-sesi prompt contains known connector URLs, the standard chat tip can suggest matching connector tasks. Connector recommendations follow the same tip pengaturan, eligibility, layout, navigation, dan sesi visibility rules as other chat tips. No connector recommendation appears tanpa a matching URL. When multiple connectors match, use the Previous Tip dan Next Tip actions to browse every recommendation. Use Tab dan Shift+Tab to reach the linked suggestion dan the tip actions. Activate the link to review that connector in the Copilot Connectors marketplace. Dismissing the tip hides tips untuk the saat ini sesi dan prevents future URL-driven recommendations untuk that connector during this composer sesi.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.contextReferences: Ketik # in the chat input to attach context. Use #berkas to reference a berkas atau folder, atau #sesi to reference another agen sesi. Referencing a sesi together dengan the /troubleshoot command analyzes that sesi's logs instead of the saat ini one. Accept a suggestion dengan Tab atau Enter. Openable references appear as buttons above the input; activate one to buka it, atau use its hapus button untuk detach it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.conversationsAsSessionView: Chats buka directly in the sesi tampilan tanpa a tab row. Side-oleh-side chats each tampilkan a sesi header. Pin keeps that chat visible when another chat opens. tutup removes that chat grup. menutup the last grup closes the sesi dari the grid. Non-main chats are tersembunyi dan can be reopened later. untuk sesi that support multiple chats, use tampilkan Chat Tabs in the sesi overflow menu to tampilkan multiple tabs.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.conversationsAsTabs: Saat multiple chats appear as tabs in a single grup, the tab row replaces the sesi header dan includes the sesi actions. Side-oleh-side chat grup retain the sesi header dan keep their tab rows compact. untuk sesi that support multiple chats, use tampilkan Chat Tabs in the sesi overflow menu to tampilkan a single chat.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.copySessionLink: To salin a browser link that opens an agen Host sesi in the agen jendela, buka the sesi's context menu dan choose salin Link.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.copySessionRecord: Saat a pill represents a single item, its context menu offers the item's salin actions, such as menyalin its URL atau berkas path. untuk a collection, buka the dropdown dan use the individual row actions instead.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.createdBySession: Saat a sesi was dibuat oleh another sesi, focus it in the sesi list dan use the tampilkan Hover command{0}. Move focus to the dibuat oleh link, then press Enter atau Space to buka the creator sesi.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.customizations: Focus Chat kustomisasi in the left sidebar{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.delegatedMessage: Messages sent oleh another sesi atau chat tampilkan a source annotation above the message. Press Tab to focus the annotation, then press Enter atau Space to buka the source chat.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.deleteChat: Before a new nested sesi is committed, its sesi header dan sesi list row offer hapus tanpa confirmation. After it is committed, those controls offer Archive atau Mark as Done instead. To menghapus permanen a committed nested sesi, buka the chat tab's context menu dan choose hapus Chat. This is destructive dan cannot be undone.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.deleteSandboxSession: untuk a Cloud sandbox sesi, hapus removes its task dan stored conversation even when the environment is offline. A failed deletion leaves the sesi in the list.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.deleteSession: To menghapus permanen a sesi, buka its context menu dan choose hapus. This is destructive dan cannot be undone.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.detachChat: To buat an independent sub-sesi pane tanpa dragging, focus the sub-sesi dan jalankan Detach Chat ke New Pane{0} dari the palet perintah. The new pane stays buka when its parent pane closes.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.devContainer: Saat Dev Container agen Host sesi are diaktifkan, Docker is available on the host, dan a local, SSH, Tunnel, atau WSL folder contains a Dev Container configuration, buka the folder's submenu dan choose Use Dev Container. untuk remote folder, first connect to a host that supports Dev Container sesi. untuk WSL folder, Docker must be available in the WSL distribution. Use the arrow keys to navigate submenus dan Enter to pilih. The ruang kerja picker then identifies the folder dengan a Dev Container suffix. Choose Use This Computer atau Use Remote Host to switch back.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.devContainerSamples: The ruang kerja picker includes Dev Container Sample. buka its submenu dan choose a sample dengan the arrow keys dan Enter. memilih a sample does not mulai Docker atau clone the repository. The sample is prepared in a Docker volume when you send your first prompt.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.dictation: Saat dictation is dikonfigurasi, dictate your message ke the input{0}. Tap to mulai dan hentikan, atau hold to dictate only while pressed. If the speech-to-text model is still preparing, activate the dictation control again to batalkan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.disabledPickerNavigation: The Left dan Right arrow keys also reach dinonaktifkan sesi controls, such as Copilot when Cloud is terpilih, so you can inspect their saat ini value. dinonaktifkan controls cannot be activated dan are skipped oleh Tab.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.doneChat: To mark an individual nested chat as done tanpa marking its sesi as done, buka the chat's context menu in the sesi list atau chat tab dan choose Mark as Done. The chat is tersembunyi dari the sesi list dan ditutup, but is not dihapus. buka the sesi list Filter menu dan aktifkan Done to tampilkan it again, then buka the chat's context menu dan choose Restore.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.doneNudge: Saat all GitHub pull requests associated dengan the sesi have merged dan no chat is working atau waiting untuk input, a mark as done suggestion may appear above the chat input. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach Mark as Done, konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup, atau Dismiss Mark as Done Suggestion, then Enter atau Space to activate it. konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup opens the pengaturan untuk automatically archiving inactive merged sesi dan permanently menghapus automatically archived merged sesi. The explanation under What Does "Mark as Done" Do? is diciutkan secara bawaan. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Dismiss Mark as Done Suggestion, atau Escape while the suggestion is focused, hides the suggestion untuk this sesi, including after a muat ulang, until it is marked as done atau dihapus, dan returns focus to the chat input. Marking the sesi as done hides it dari the sesi list so you can focus on your remaining tasks. The sesi is not dihapus. Ask your agen to cari it, atau look in the "Done" section of the sesi list. You can restore it anytime. The worktree dibuat untuk the sesi, if any, will be dihapus. You can recreate it oleh restoring the sesi.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.emptyEditorAddTab: Saat the side panel's editor has no buka tabs, it shows Add Tab at the top dan lists the Add Tab actions, such as Changes, berkas, Browser, dan cari, dengan their keybindings. Press Tab to reach the list, use the Up dan Down arrow keys to move between actions, dan press Enter atau Space to buka one. untuk an action dengan a submenu, such as kanvas, press Enter, Space, atau the Right arrow key to buka the submenu, the Up dan Down arrow keys to choose an item, dan the Left arrow key atau Escape to return to the list.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.environmentFolders: Choose GitHub Environments in the ruang kerja picker to connect to a GitHub environment, then pilih a folder on that host. The picker starts in the host's home direktori. Enter a folder path to browse another location atau drive. Use the arrow keys to navigate, Enter to pilih, dan Escape to batalkan either picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.environmentPicker: Choose This Computer, Cloud, a remote host, atau an available Dev Container. ruang kerja dan sesi Type choices follow the terpilih environment. Local folder bawaan to This Computer unless you explicitly choose atau restore another environment. Choose ruang kerja is ditampilkan when no ruang kerja is terpilih. Cloud uses Copilot. Dev Container lists only supported folder dan requires a ruang kerja; it does not fall back to Chat. Compare agen is unavailable when Dev Container is terpilih. An incompatible ruang kerja is dibersihkan tanpa sending atau membuang your prompt. Use Tab atau the Left dan Right arrow keys to reach Environment, Enter atau Space to buka it, arrow keys dan Enter to pilih, dan Escape to dismiss. Screen-reader optimized mode keeps sesi options dibentangkan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.environmentPicker.beforeWor: Above the new-sesi input, Environment is before ruang kerja dan remains visible when sesi options are diciutkan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.environmentPicker.manage: Choose kelola Remote Environments at the bottom of the Environment picker to buka the Remote Environments dialog. This does not change your terpilih environment. Hosts not listed in Remote Environments, including dikonfigurasi WebSocket hosts, keep their per-entry kelola submenu.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.environmentPicker.repositor: dengan This Computer terpilih, Work in Repository reuses a known local checkout atau opens the Git clone flow to pilih a local destination. membatalkan the clone keeps your saat ini ruang kerja selection.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.extensionArtifactAutomation: ekstensi-provided artifact actions dan automation use the same controls dan request cards. Their automatic prompts go to the chat that recorded the artifact. ekstensi automation runs on this computer while the ekstensi dan sesi connection are available. Hosts tanpa support untuk automation notices pause automatic actions dan explain why; manual actions remain available. A rule can prevent a new schedule while allowing an existing schedule to continue. You can still use Space on its switch to turn it off.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionAdoption: Once you send a message to an external sesi's agen, it becomes a regular sesi. Its banner disappears, dan it is no longer grouped atau filtered as external.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionBanner: Saat you first buka a sesi dibuat in another application, a banner appears at the top of the chat. Use Tab to reach its external-sesi picker, choose an option, dan activate simpan. The tutup action dismisses the banner tanpa changing the pengaturan. menyimpan atau menutup permanently dismisses the banner.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionContinuation: Saat you first buka a sesi dibuat in another application, a banner explains that you can continue it here. Codex sesi can use your ChatGPT atau Copilot subscription, terpilih in the model picker. Claude sesi use your Copilot subscription. Use Tab to reach tutup dan press Enter atau Space to permanently dismiss the banner untuk all external sesi dan return focus to the chat input.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionFilter: The sesi list Filter sesi menu includes a dibuat Externally submenu. Choose None, terkini, Last 24 Hours, Last 7 Days, atau Last 30 Days to control which sesi dari other applications are ditampilkan. Last 7 Days is the bawaan. tampilkan in External Section places these sesi in their own External section. This option is off secara bawaan, so external sesi appear alongside other sesi in their normal grup.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionImport: To make an external sesi a regular sesi tanpa sending a message, use Import in its row toolbar, before Archive atau Mark as Done, atau focus the sesi dan choose Import dari its context menu{0}. This action is available when the host supports importing sesi.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionSectionArchi: External sesi appear in an External section above Archived unless they are pinned atau in a custom grup. The section is tersembunyi when empty. Focus its heading dan buka the context menu{0} to konfigurasikan which external sesi are ditampilkan atau archive the section's sesi.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.externalSessionSectionDone: External sesi appear in an External section above Done unless they are pinned atau in a custom grup. The section is tersembunyi when empty. Focus its heading dan buka the context menu{0} to konfigurasikan which external sesi are ditampilkan atau mark the section's sesi as done.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.failingChecksPullRequest: Saat a sesi pull request has failing checks, use Reveal in its banner item to buka that pull request, atau use Fix Checks to ask the agen to address the failures.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.feedbackAttachment: Saat a feedback comments attachment appears above the input, focus it dan press Enter atau Space. A single comment opens directly. Multiple comments buka a tree grouped oleh berkas; use the arrow keys to navigate, Enter to reveal a comment, dan Escape to tutup the tree.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.feedbackComments: Saat pull requests have failing checks atau unreviewed comments, one banner appears above the input. If several pull requests need attention, use the Previous Banner dan Next Banner buttons to move between them. A pull request dengan both failing checks dan comments uses a split button. Activate the main action to address both. buka its More Actions menu to choose Fix Checks atau Address Comments separately. Choose Reveal Checks in the More Actions menu to buka the pull request. Choose Reveal Comments in the same menu to tampilan the first comment. In-product agen review comments appear as their own carousel item.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.feedbackComments.artifactIn: While the {0} pengaturan is diaktifkan, pull request failing-check dan review-comment banners do not appear above the input. buka a recorded pull request artifact's details to review its checks dan comments. In-product agen review comments still appear in a banner above the input.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.find: To cari the chat transcript, invoke cari in Chat{0}. cari Next{1} dan cari Previous{2} move between results, scrolling each one ke tampilan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.focusActiveSession: Focus the aktif session{0}. The bawaan buka Chat (agen) shortcut also focuses the aktif sesi in the agen jendela.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.forkToSide: Alt-click, atau Option-click on macOS, the Fork Conversation button at a checkpoint to buka the fork beside its source. Ordinary activation keeps its existing behavior. dengan the keyboard, activate Fork Conversation, reopen the source dari the sesi list, then choose Buka di Samping dari the fork's context menu.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.generateBackgroundSkill: To generate a chat background, ask the agen atau type /generate-chat-background to use the built-in keahlian. It provides optional design guidance dan applies the generated image when the required alat are available.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.generatedImageArtifacts: Generated images dari this chat automatically appear in the Generated Images section of the Artifacts pill, separate dari other images dan berkas. When Images Preview is diaktifkan untuk chat, buka an image dan use the Left dan Right Arrow keys to browse generated images dan user attachments dari the conversation. Images ditampilkan dari the transcript do not offer hapus dari sesi unless they were also recorded as artifacts.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.generatedImageBatch: Each consecutive batch of image-generation calls has its own preview in conversation order. pilih any thumbnail, including one still generating, to tampilkan its image atau progress dan its alat dropdown above the preview. Use Tab to focus the terpilih thumbnail, then Left atau Right Arrow, Home, atau End to pilih another image atau its progress. bentangkan the terpilih alat dropdown to inspect its prompt dan keluaran. The terpilih thumbnail has a highlighted border. The thumbnail row follows the terpilih preview's size. Generating images tampilkan only the compact glyph band, while dibatalkan atau failed images tampilkan their status in the alat dropdown tanpa an empty preview. The Image batch status below the thumbnails shows how many images are ready out of the total, along dengan any that need attention, failed, atau were dibatalkan. Later results arrive tanpa changing your selection, dan only the terpilih preview animates. Focus the main image dan press Enter to buka the carousel. Approval dan authentication requests remain visible even when another image is terpilih.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.generatedImageBatchDownload: Use the download action beside the Image batch status to Simpan Semua currently ready images as a ZIP archive. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to download. The action is unavailable until an image is ready dan while a download is in progress. Only images ready when you mulai the download are included; failed, dibatalkan, dan pending images are not included.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.generatedImageDetails: bentangkan a completed image-generation dropdown to inspect its duration, total image byte size, dan tokens. A dash means the value was not reported; token usage is not yet available. Generated image downloads include a stable hash suffix so different images have distinct filenames.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.generatedImagePreparation: Image-generation alat entries, previews, dan batch counts stay tersembunyi while the model assembles the alat arguments. If approval is required, the confirmation is the first alat UI ditampilkan. Generating image, the glyph animation, painting progress phrases, dan the painting pet mulai only when the alat executes, after any required confirmation. Confirmation dan authentication waits pause image-generation progress.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.githubContext: Use Add Context to attach berkas, images, dan, when available, GitHub issues atau pull requests.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.githubReferences: Pull request dan issue pills above the chat input buka their GitHub item in the GitHub Pull Requests ekstensi when it is available. Pills that represent several items buka a keyboard-accessible picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.goBack: Go back through visited sesi, the New sesi tampilan, dan custom tampilan such as Automations{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.goForward: Go forward through visited sesi dan views{0}. Reopening New sesi atau a custom tampilan moves its single riwayat entry to the most terkini position.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.groupAppearance: Custom grup, ruang kerja grup, repository grup, dan environment grup, including remote hosts, offer Change Icon dan Change Color in their context menus. In the icon picker, enter a name to cari, then press Down Arrow to enter the grid. Arrow keys navigate icons, Home dan End move to the first dan last icon, dan Up Arrow dari the top row returns to cari. Tab dan Shift+Tab move between cari, the grid, dan atur ulang to bawaan. Press Enter to pilih an icon atau atur ulang. The color picker uses the terminal's theme-aware ANSI colors. Both pickers offer atur ulang to bawaan, which resets only that part of the grup's appearance. Escape cancels either picker tanpa changing the grup. Icon dan color choices are tersimpan independently untuk each grup, including subgroups. diciutkan grup still tampilkan unread dan attention indicators when needed.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.harnessSwitchFeedbackSurvey: After you switch dari Copilot to Local, a feedback survey may appear above the chat input. Use Shift+Tab to reach it. Use Up dan Down Arrow to choose why you switched, then press Enter atau Space to submit. Dismiss Survey atau Escape closes the survey. After submission, a message confirms that your feedback was recorded. Use Tab to reach Share it on GitHub to provide specific feedback in a GitHub issue. Use Dismiss Feedback Acknowledgement atau Escape to tutup the message.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.history: Use up dan down arrows to navigate your request riwayat in the input box.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.historyRefresh: Previously loaded conversations refresh silently. If terkini messages cannot be loaded, a banner offers Refresh. Use Tab to reach Refresh dan press Enter atau Space to retry loading recorded messages tanpa memulai ulang the sesi atau waking its environment. Your draft is preserved.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.imageDownloads: Images Preview offers Download untuk the terpilih image. Image rows in Artifacts dan References offer Download Image. Use Tab to reach these actions dan Enter atau Space to download. When a pill contains a single image, its download action is also available in the pill hover dan context menu. membuka an image in the new-sesi composer includes all images attached to that draft.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.input: You are in the chat input. Type a message dan press Enter to send it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.inputBackground: Tekan Alt+Enter untuk mulai the sesi in the background tanpa navigating ke it. The dimulai sesi appears in the Chat sesi tampilan.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.inputPills: Saat sesi metadata atau aktif-turn status pills appear above the input, press Shift+Tab to reach them, use the Left dan Right arrow keys to move between them, dan press Enter atau Space to activate one. buka the context menu{0} to choose which pills are ditampilkan. Pull Requests Options lets you tampilkan all pull requests atau only buka dan draft ones. Subagent Options offers tampilkan All dan tampilkan In Progress. These choices are remembered across sesi. If every entry of a pill is filtered out, its options are also available in any other pill's context menu atau the toolbar context menu.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.layoutDensity: Choose bawaan atau Compact dari tampilan > Appearance > Layout Density, atau change the jendela.density.layout pengaturan. bawaan uses a taller bilah judul. Compact uses a shorter bilah judul, removes the gaps between parts, dan reduces pane spacing. Changes terapkan immediately.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.mainChatToSide: To buka the main chat beside a peer chat, choose Buka di Samping dari the sesi row's context menu. You can also Alt-click (Option-click on macOS) the row atau drag it to a chat pane's edge.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.markNestedSessionRead: The same read dan unread shortcuts work on nested sesi dan change only the targeted nested sesi, not their parent.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.markNestedSessionsRead: Saat a parent sesi has unread nested sesi, buka its context menu dan choose Mark All as Read.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.markSessionsRead: Saat the sesi list has focus, mark the focused sesi atau terpilih sesi as read{0} atau unread{1} tanpa membuka them. These shortcuts do not terapkan while typing in an input.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.micContextMenu: To choose a microphone atau turn off dictation atau Voice Mode, focus the microphone button in the input toolbar dan buka its context menu (untuk example Shift+F10).
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.migrations: Saat agen kustomisasi need an perbarui, a notice below the new-sesi input shows how many need attention. Use Tab to reach Review migrasi dan buka the migrasi page. Dismiss migrasi Notice untuk This ruang kerja hides the notice untuk that ruang kerja, including after memulai ulang, dan returns focus to the input.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.missionControlHosts: In kelola Remote agen Hosts atau the ruang kerja picker, choose GitHub Environments to discover your environments tanpa memulai compute atau sesi. Use the arrow keys to choose an environment dan Enter to connect. Tab reaches Refresh Environments. Escape returns to the previous control. Environment options offer Reconnect, Disconnect, dan ganti nama. ganti nama changes only this profile's label, not the remote machine's name. The picker shows whether each environment is online atau offline dan whether you are connected to it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.mobileConfig: On mobile, the mode dan model pickers appear as tappable chips below the input. Tap a chip to buka a bottom sheet where you can change the selection.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.moveNestedChat: To reorder a sesi's nested chats in the sesi list, focus a nested chat dan invoke Move Up{0} atau Move Down{1}, atau choose them dari its context menu. They are available only untuk nested chats that their provider can move. Focus stays on the moved chat.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.navigateChatTabs: Saat a chat tab is focused, use the left dan right arrow keys to move to dan activate an adjacent chat tab, atau Home dan End to activate the first dan last tabs. Tabs that do not fit are scrolled ke tampilan when activated. You can also scroll the tab row dengan the mouse wheel atau drag the horizontal scrollbar that appears when hovering over overflowing tabs.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.navigateNextSession: Navigate to the next sesi in the list{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.navigatePreviousSession: Navigate to the previous sesi in the list{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.nestedCustomGroups: Custom grup can contain subgroups at any depth. Focus a grup's heading dan buka the context menu{0} to choose buat Subgroup, which adds an empty grup inside it dan starts mengganti nama it. Subgroups are listed above the grup's own sesi, dan each grup's level is announced. Mark All as Done dan Mark All as Read on a grup include its subgroups' sesi. hapus grup also deletes the grup's subgroups; when it deletes more than one grup, an urungkan notice appears at the bottom of the sesi list that restores them. buat grup on sesi that are all in the same grup creates the new grup inside it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.nestedGroupingSections: ruang kerja, repository, dan environment sections can also be placed inside custom grup. Focus a section heading dan buka the context menu{0}, then choose Move to grup dan a destination. hapus dari grup returns it to the top level. You can also drag the section heading ke a custom grup atau beside another header. The section includes future matching sesi, while pinned sesi dan explicit custom-grup memberships keep their placement. Section nesting is remembered separately untuk each grouping mode dan is tersembunyi when another mode is terpilih. grup actions include the sesi of their currently nested sections. menghapus a custom grup returns its nested sections to the top level dan offers an urungkan notice that restores their placement.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.nestedSessionWorkspace: New Nested Session{0} opens a composer that uses the sesi's agen dan host, so it has no agen atau environment picker. Above the input, the folder picker preselects the sesi's folder, atau No ruang kerja in a sesi tanpa one. When the sesi's folder no longer exists, No ruang kerja is preselected dan the picker says why. Pick a terkini folder, browse atau buka a folder, atau pick No ruang kerja to give the nested chat its own scratch folder. untuk a Git folder, check New Worktree to give the nested chat its own worktree dan pick the branch it starts dari. An agen that supports only one folder offers only the sesi's folder. The choice applies when you send the first request.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.nestedSubagentActivity: Saat a subagent starts another subagent, its activity row identifies the nested subagent oleh name. Focus that link dengan Tab dan press Enter atau Space to buka the nested subagent's chat beside the saat ini chat. The enclosing pill still opens the parent subagent.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.newSessionDrag: To move a new-sesi pane before sending a prompt, drag its blank top area beside another pane. The sesi grid movement commands also work on new-sesi panes.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.newSessionInputControls.age: Saat an agen picker is available in a new atau berjalan sesi, it initially appears in Add Context. buka Add Context dan choose agen to pilih an agen. After you pilih an agen, the agen picker returns to its usual position. Other new-sesi controls remain in their layout-specific positions. Use Tab to reach toolbar controls, arrow keys to navigate toolbar items, dan Enter atau Space to buka a picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.newSessionInputControls.exp: Inside the new-sesi prompt, the controls appear in this order: Add Context, agen, Mode dan Permissions, dan Model. Which controls are available depends on the terpilih harness. Use Tab to reach the controls, arrow keys to navigate toolbar items, dan Enter atau Space to buka a picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.newSessionInputControls.leg: Inside the new-sesi prompt, Add Context dan Model appear in the input toolbar. agen, Mode, dan Permissions appear below the input when available untuk the terpilih harness. Use Tab to reach the controls, arrow keys to navigate toolbar items, dan Enter atau Space to buka a picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.newSessionPickers: In a new-sesi composer, buka dan focus the ruang kerja picker{0} atau the harness picker{1}. Focus either picker control dan buka its context menu{2} to konfigurasikan its keybinding.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.offlineDraft: secara bawaan, membuka a cloud sandbox conversation connects atau wakes its environment in the background. Turn off chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.autoConnectOnOpen to wait until you mulai composing atau explicitly connect instead. You can read its riwayat dan compose a draft while it connects. Connection progress dan failures appear in a banner only after you type, tempel, atau add an attachment. If the sesi is ready before you mulai composing, no connection banner appears. Send, mode, dan permissions are unavailable until the sesi is ready. If connecting fails, your draft stays in the input; use Retry in the banner to try again. Connecting never sends your draft automatically.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.openPullRequest: Saat the sesi is associated dengan GitHub pull requests, a status pill above the chat input shows the pull request number atau count. Activate it to buka a single pull request atau choose dari the associated pull requests{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.overview: You are in the agen jendela. The agen jendela is a dedicated ruang kerja untuk working dengan AI agen. It provides a chat interface, a changes tampilan untuk reviewing agen-generated changes, a berkas explorer, dan kustomisasi options.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.pasteAsText: To tempel the clipboard as plain text, tanpa converting it to Markdown atau storing it as an attachment, invoke tempel as Text{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.pastedText: Long ditempelkan text is stored as an attached text item dan diganti in the input dengan a numbered inline reference.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.pickerShortcuts: While the new-sesi input has focus, buka the environment picker{0}, branch picker{1}, atau Branch/New Worktree picker{2}. Focus Sync Changes{3}, then press Enter to synchronize. These shortcuts are available only when the corresponding control is available dan bentangkan tersembunyi sesi options before focusing them.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.pickFolderQuickPick: To choose a folder dari a searchable list instead, use the New sesi in folder command{0}.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.policyContinuation: If your organization disables Claude atau Codex dan requires the new Copilot experience, an buka, idle conversation automatically moves to Copilot dengan its title, riwayat, dan draft. Nothing is sent automatically. The original is archived only after the salin opens dan other conversations in its sesi can still be reached. membuka an archived original does not move it again. If moving needs a ruang kerja atau trust decision, atau fails, use Tab to focus Continue in Copilot in the banner, then press Enter atau Space. This action reopens an existing salin when available. Subagent chats dan other policy restrictions use the manual action. untuk a dikelola checkout, choose an independent ruang kerja; uncommitted berkas stay in the original checkout.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.positionalPaneFocus: Focus sesi 1 in Grid{0} dan the other numbered focus commands follow visual pane order, including independent sub-sesi panes even when their parent is ditutup. Focus Last sesi in Grid{1} selects the last pane.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.preparation: While a new sesi is being prepared, the transcript shows your submitted prompt dan attachments followed oleh startup progress. Use Tab to reach tampilkan Log beside the progress message dan press Enter to buka the Dev Container keluaran channel. The chat input dan attachment controls are dinonaktifkan until preparation finishes. Use the input's hentikan action atau batalkan Chat command{0} to batalkan preparation. If preparation fails atau is canceled, your original prompt dan attachments remain in the new-sesi composer.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.promptOptions: Saat prompt options appear above the new-sesi input, use Tab dan Shift+Tab to move between them, then press Enter atau Space to insert one. You can pilih a different option while the input is empty, exactly matches the inserted prompt, atau only has its editable placeholder dihapus; other edits nonaktifkan the options tanpa menyembunyikan them. membersihkan the input also clears the terpilih option. Use the tutup action to sembunyikan the options dan return focus to the input.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.promptTemplatePlaceholder: Saat the new-sesi prompt contains a highlighted task placeholder, place the caret inside it dan ganti it{0} to type your task.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.promptTimeline: Saat the prompt timeline is diaktifkan, a handle on the left edge of the transcript lists your prompts. Activate it to bentangkan the list, use the up dan down arrows (atau Home dan End) to move between prompts, Enter atau Space to jump to a prompt, dan Escape to dismiss the list dan return focus to the handle. When a prompt title is pinned above the transcript, activate its title to jump to that prompt.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.pullRequestArtifact: Recorded GitHub pull request artifacts can tampilkan checks dan unresolved review threads as additional pill sections. Their details offer repair actions dan separate, opt-in automation controls. Repair prompts require a matching checkout dan instruct the agen to commit dan push the repair. Automatically Mark Ready can exclude check-name patterns dikonfigurasi in pengaturan; automatic merging still requires every check to pass. The main details offer Mark Ready, Merge, dan branch-perbarui controls. Branch-discovered pull requests dan reference links do not gain these automations.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.pullRequestSession: In a repository section where New sesi is a split button, focus New sesi dan press Right Arrow to reach its dropdown, then activate New sesi dari Pull Request to buka a searchable pull request picker. Pull requests are grouped oleh review dan assignment status. Use the arrow keys to navigate, Enter to buat the sesi, dan Escape to tutup the picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.quickChat: To mulai a ruang kerja-less quick chat, use the New Quick Chat command{0} atau the plus button on the Chats section in the sesi list. When consolidated remote ruang kerja are diaktifkan, this opens the new-sesi composer, where you can choose Chat. Otherwise, it starts a ruang kerja-less chat directly. When GitHub sandboxes are diaktifkan, choose Cloud in the Environment picker, then Chat in the ruang kerja picker, to chat tanpa a repository atau pull request. If the Environment picker is dinonaktifkan, choose Cloud in the harness picker instead. The Toggle Side panel command is dinonaktifkan untuk quick chats.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.quickChatNestedChats: Quick chats can have nested chats: use New Nested Session{0} on a quick chat, dan each nested chat works in its own scratch folder. Chats move between quick chats dan ruang kerja sesi dan keep their folder. A quick chat stays in the Chats section, dan those of its chats that have a folder of their own announce it. A chat that shares its folder dengan another chat in its sesi can't be moved on its own.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.remoteConnections: On desktop, the bilah judul offers Remote Connections. The preview pengaturan chat.agentHost.remoteConnections selects the connection method. The Remote Connections button opens a menu that offers Off, Dev Tunnels, dan GitHub Environments when available. Use Tab to reach the bilah judul, arrow keys to reach the button, Enter atau Space to buka it, Up dan Down Arrow to choose an option, Enter to pilih, dan Escape to tutup dan return focus to the button. memilih a method updates the pengaturan dan enables sharing. memilih Off disables sharing tanpa changing the preferred method. The footer shows the name used to identify this machine on other clients dan whether it is shared atau connecting. Changing the pengaturan directly turns sharing off. The pengaturan chat.agentHost.githubEnvironments.diaktifkan controls GitHub Environments availability. If your organization disables it, the menu explains that you must contact your administrator. dengan GitHub environment terpilih, mengaktifkan sharing registers your local environment untuk remote owner access dan allows clients authenticated as your GitHub account to read dan modify berkas across this machine's accessible berkas systems, including sensitive berkas. Remote work uses the host's OAuth token secara bawaan, controlled oleh chat.agentHost.experimentalMissionControl.useLocalCredentials. Operating system permissions still terapkan. Local sesi continue using local IPC.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.remoteConnections.policyHel: If GitHub Environments is dinonaktifkan oleh your organization, the footer explains the restriction. Press Tab to reach tampilan pengaturan dan Enter to buka the dikelola pengaturan. Shift+Tab returns to the connection options.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.remoteConnections.renameHel: In the Remote Connections menu, press Tab to reach the name link in the footer, then Enter atau Space to ganti nama the shared environment. The input starts dengan the saat ini name. Enter saves the name ditampilkan on other clients, dan Escape cancels. Shift+Tab returns to the connection options. mengganti nama while Off does not aktifkan sharing.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.remoteDelegation: Ask the agen to list remote agen hosts atau buat a remote sesi dengan platform dan resource requirements. Creation uses the standard alat confirmation dan does not change the focused chat. The result includes a link to the remote sesi. Remote sesi can send messages back to the originating chat while this agen jendela remains connected.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.remoteInspection: Ask the agen to inspect a remote sesi using its sesi link. Inspection reads its saat ini state dan latest response atau error tanpa changing focus, marking the chat as read, atau approving pending requests. If the host is unavailable, the result explains why; inspection does not reconnect it.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.removeSessionRecord: Recorded artifacts dan references offer hapus dari sesi untuk each row. Use Tab to reach row actions. When only one item is visible, use its pill hover actions atau context menu instead. Removal waits untuk persistence dan only deletes the sesi record; it does not hapus the linked resource, tutup a pull request atau issue, atau hapus independent sesi associations.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.removeWorkspace: ruang kerja rows offer a hapus action. Use the arrow keys to focus a ruang kerja, then Tab to reach its actions. dihapus ruang kerja stay tersembunyi across reloads until you browse to that ruang kerja dan successfully mulai a sesi dari the new-sesi composer. menghapus a ruang kerja does not hapus its sesi atau berkas.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.renameChat: Saat ganti nama is available untuk a non-main chat, focus its tab atau nested row in the sesi list dan invoke Rename{0}, atau double-click its title, to ganti nama it inline. Type the new title, then press Enter to confirm atau Escape to batalkan. dari the chat transcript atau input, invoking ganti nama opens a prompt instead.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.renameSession: To ganti nama a sesi inline, focus its row in the sesi list dan invoke Rename{0}, double-click its title, atau buka its context menu dan choose ganti nama. Type the new title, then press Enter to confirm atau Escape to batalkan. dari the main chat transcript atau input, invoking ganti nama edits the header title inline when it is visible dan opens a prompt otherwise.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.reopenConversation: If the environment is connected but the conversation cannot be reopened, the banner offers Retry. Use Tab to reach Retry dan press Enter atau Space to reopen the conversation on the existing connection. The banner reports reopening progress dan offers Retry again if it fails. Your draft is preserved dan is not sent automatically. Send stays unavailable until the conversation is ready.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.repositoryCreation: This host creates a new environment untuk each sesi. buka pilih Repository to choose its repository. memilih a repository does not mulai an environment; sending your first message does. Before sending, use the mode picker to choose Interactive, Plan, atau Autopilot, dan the permissions picker to konfigurasikan alat approvals. buka the model picker to choose a cloud model dan its supported reasoning effort. Use the arrow keys to navigate options, Enter to pilih, dan Escape to tutup a picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.repositorySectionNewSession: In a repository section dengan sesi in several environments, the New sesi dropdown can mulai a sesi in each environment, in the ruang kerja of its most recently dibuat sesi there. sesi rows in a repository section name their environment, except untuk This Computer.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.repositorySelection: Saat choosing a GitHub repository in the browser, cari atau enter a GitHub URL atau owner/repository. Use the arrow keys to navigate results, Enter to pilih, dan Escape to batalkan. Sign in to GitHub if prompted.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.responseSelectionInput: Saat you pilih assistant response text, an Ask Question input appears. Type a side question dan press Enter to send it, press Shift+Enter to insert a new line, atau press Escape to dismiss the input.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.responseSelectionMenu: Saat you pilih assistant response text, an action menu appears. Press Tab to focus the menu, use the Up Arrow dan Down Arrow keys to move between actions, dan press Enter to activate one. Press Escape to dismiss the menu. Ask in a Side Chat opens a question input anchored to the terpilih text. Quote appends the selection as a blockquote in the chat input when the conversation is interactive. salin copies the terpilih text.
vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/session.sessionsChat.sessionActivityBar: The sesi bilah aktivitas beside the aktif chat opens the Changes, berkas, Browser, dan kanvas tabs. The pull request action appears automatically in the side-pane grup. buka Pull Request is available untuk the aktif chat's pull requests when a contributed opener is available untuk their links. The action reveals an already-buka matching editor atau opens the first supported pull request if none is buka. A checked button means the pull request editor is visible; activating it collapses the side pane. Activate it again to reveal the editor. The action opens directly, tanpa a dropdown atau picker, even dengan multiple pull requests. Issue actions are not ditampilkan in the bilah aktivitas; issue pills remain available above the chat input. Its layout actions, Toggle Side panel above the tabs dan Toggle panel below them, ganti the bilah judul buttons; turn them off dengan tampilkan Layout Actions in its context menu. Press Tab past the chat input's controls to reach it, use the Up dan Down Arrow keys to move between its entries, dan press Enter atau Space to buka one. The Changes entry's label includes the aktif chat's number of changed berkas dan lines added dan dihapus, dan New changes when it has changes you have not yet seen in the Changes tab. Only kanvas belonging to the aktif chat are ditampilkan. A single kanvas opens directly dan is labeled dengan its title. dengan multiple kanvas, kanvas opens a submenu: press Enter, Space, atau Left Arrow to buka it, dan Right Arrow atau Escape to tutup it. vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.chat.agentHost.forwardSSHAgent: Saat diaktifkan, forwards the local SSH agen to the remote machine during SSH agen host connections to hosts whose SSH config has `ForwardAgent yes`. Only aktifkan this untuk trusted hosts. The remote agen host process must be dimulai ulang untuk this pengaturan to take effect.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.chat.agentHost.localFilePermissions: Per-host filesystem grants untuk remote agen hosts. Maps a remote agen host address to URI strings dan the access mode the host has been granted (`r` untuk read, `rw` untuk read dan write). Hosts cannot read atau write any berkas outside the granted URIs tanpa prompting; a URI grant covers descendants. This pengaturan is normally maintained oleh the agen-host permission prompts dan rarely edited oleh hand.

vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.connection: Status labels include Connected, Connecting, dan Disconnected. A warning indicates that a connection you requested failed. Hover the warning atau buka the Accessible tampilan to read the error. Automatic connection failures do not buat a warning, but automatic retries retain an existing warning until they finish. A failed retry updates the error; a successful retry clears it. GitHub environments whose owning application is not online tampilkan Offline. Use Connect atau Disconnect to kelola the connection. Connection actions are unavailable while connecting atau reconnecting. Disconnect follows the existing remote behavior dan may hapus it dari the picker.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.discovery: Refresh looks untuk remotes tanpa connecting. Its icon spins while discovery is berjalan. Each grup also shows a spinner after its count while that grup's discovery is berjalan. A failed grup immediately shows a warning instead of its spinner, even if other grup are still loading. The tooltip dan grup label explain the problem; the jendela log contains diagnostic details. If tunnel sign-in permissions are missing, a Sign In action appears instead of an error. Focus that row dan press Tab, then Enter atau Space to sign in dan grant access to your tunnels. Sign In is dinonaktifkan dengan a spinner while sign-in is in progress. This refreshes the list tanpa connecting to a remote. Known locations remain available, dan Refresh retries discovery.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.environments: untuk GitHub Environments, Connect is dinonaktifkan when the owning application is offline. Disconnect retains the environment dan follows its existing reconnection preferensi. ganti nama applies only to the saat ini account dan profile. hapus asks untuk confirmation before menghapus the user-shared environment registration dan disconnecting this client. It does not hapus berkas on the machine. The environment can reappear if its owning application registers it again. The GitHub Environments gear opens its pengaturan.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.manage: ganti nama changes the remote's display name in this client. Leave the name empty to restore its bawaan. salin Address copies a remote's connection address tanpa connecting, including while it is offline atau busy. SSH dan tunnel rows offer Change Preferred agen Location, which uses the existing choice of a dedicated process atau remote editor jendela dan reconnects after menyimpan. Cancelling leaves the preference unchanged. Incompatible hosts offer perbarui Server when they advertise an perbarui method. This reports progress dan reconnects after the server restarts. Environment dan supported tunnel rows also offer hapus dengan confirmation. menghapus a tunnel removes its service-side registration dan disconnects its clients, tanpa menghapus remote berkas. A tunnel currently hosted oleh this application must be dihentikan before it can be dihapus. A dihapus tunnel may reappear if a machine starts hosting it again. tersimpan SSH connections offer hapus only after discovery confirms the host is absent dari SSH configuration. menghapus one asks untuk confirmation, forgets the tersimpan connection, dan disconnects this client tanpa editing SSH configuration atau remote berkas. Use the arrow keys to reach these row actions. WSL distributions must be dikelola at the source.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.navigation: Ketik in cari to filter remotes oleh name, address, atau connection type. bersihkan cari dan ciutkan All are at the right of the cari field; use Tab to reach these actions dan Left dan Right Arrow to move between them. bersihkan cari returns focus to the input. ciutkan All preserves the cari text. grup tanpa matches are tersembunyi while mencari. Use Down Arrow dari cari to enter the table. Use Up dan Down Arrow to navigate rows. On a grup, use Left dan Right Arrow to ciutkan atau bentangkan it, atau press Enter to toggle it. Visibility icons are always ditampilkan; other row actions appear on hover atau keyboard focus. On a remote, press Tab to reach its actions dan use Left dan Right Arrow to move between Connect atau Disconnect dan ganti nama. Use Enter atau Space untuk activate an action. Resize columns oleh dragging their boundaries. Narrow jendela scroll horizontally.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.overview: Remote Environments lists known SSH hosts dan Dev Tunnels in a table grouped oleh connection type. buka it dengan kelola Remote Environments in the palet perintah, dari the sesi section's More Actions menu, atau dengan kelola Remote Environments in the Environment picker. WSL distributions are also available on jendela. When diaktifkan dan available, GitHub Environments lists known user-shared machines, including offline machines. The columns are Name, Status, dan Actions.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.setup: Empty grup tampilkan setup guidance dan a documentation link. Focus the placeholder row dan press Tab to reach its link. grup dengan documentation also have an info action that opens the same guide, even when they contain remotes atau are diciutkan. Focus the grup dan use Tab dan the arrow keys to reach its actions. The SSH pengaturan action opens your user SSH config in a modal editor dan creates it if necessary. The Dev Tunnels grup has an buka Dev Tunnels pengaturan action. After mengonfigurasi a host, return to Remotes dan choose Refresh.
vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgen.remotes.help.visibility: Use the eye action at the mulai of an eligible remote row to tampilkan atau sembunyikan it in the Environment dan ruang kerja pickers. Focus the row dan press Tab, then Enter atau Space to toggle it. tersembunyi remotes remain in this editor dengan a dimmed name dan a tampilkan action. Remotes that cannot currently appear have a dinonaktifkan unavailable indicator instead of an eye; hover it atau buka the Accessible tampilan untuk the reason. Newly discovered remotes must first be connected, dan offline shared environments must come online. Your tersembunyi preference is retained while a remote is unavailable. Choosing a folder through a remote subpicker shows that remote again. menyembunyikan a remote does not prevent sending an existing draft when the remote is available dan connected. This preference is local to your profile on this machine dan does not connect, disconnect, atau hapus sesi.
