vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.allWorktreesO: You are in the Worktree Cleanup editor. It lists all agen sesi worktrees, including terkini dan protected sesi. Any uncommitted changes are committed before a worktree is dihapus. Cleaning up a sesi marks it as done; you can restore the sesi later to recreate its worktree.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.automatic: Changes in the Cleanup pengaturan section are tersimpan immediately. Background cleanup evaluates existing dan future sesi after confirming their eligibility. Use the checkboxes to aktifkan automatic completion atau deletion of merged pull request sesi, then adjust the number of days in the adjacent input. Another checkbox turns the storage cleanup suggestion on atau off.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.cleanup: Activate Clean Up Worktrees to hapus the terpilih sesi' worktrees dan mark those sesi as done after confirmation. It is dinonaktifkan until at least one sesi is terpilih, dan its label reports how many worktrees will be cleaned up.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.matchingWorkt: A summary line above the table reports how many matching worktrees can be cleaned up dan, when nonzero, about how much storage they use. A nearby info button explains eligibility. When no worktrees match the filters, an informational message replaces the summary, action, dan table.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.measurementPr: A status line above the results reports the overall number of worktrees processed out of the scan total, independently of the filters. Failed measurements count as processed. The final count remains visible when the scan completes.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.reopen: Return to this editor any time oleh berjalan buka Worktree Cleanup dari the palet perintah atau the sesi More Actions menu.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.retry: sesi already marked as done can still have worktrees. When their host supports retrying cleanup, these rows are terpilih secara bawaan unless a previous removal failed. Failed cleanup requires manual selection. Activate Clean Up Worktrees to retry tanpa menghapus sesi riwayat. Scheduled dan berjalan cleanup is not selectable. Cleanup you request stays visible in the main table while it progresses, tanpa a checkbox, dan disappears when removal is confirmed. An explanation below each sesi title reports blocked, deferred, atau failed cleanup, including the error when available. Worktree still present means the previous outcome is unknown, not that cleanup failed.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.workspaceAndA: Use the Untouched untuk selector to filter oleh inactivity memulai at one day, atau choose Any time to include sesi used today. When worktrees belong to multiple ruang kerja, use the ruang kerja selector to tampilkan one ruang kerja atau All ruang kerja. Filters limit both the table dan cleanup selection. Changing ruang kerja clears the selection.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanupHelp.workspaceAndP: The main table lists worktrees that can be cleaned up, dengan each sesi's title, ruang kerja, last used time, dan worktree size. aktif sesi dan sesi waiting untuk input have an unchecked checkbox untuk manual selection. Other worktrees are in the diciutkan Unavailable untuk cleanup section, dengan an explanation below each title dan no checkbox. Use Tab to focus the section heading dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Each sesi title is a link that opens the sesi dan includes its cleanup explanation. The pilih All checkbox in the main table header toggles every row in the saat ini filter that can be cleaned up.

Remaining worktrees untuk sesi already marked as done are terpilih secara bawaan when their host supports retrying cleanup, unless a previous removal failed. Failed cleanup requires manual selection. vs/sessions/contrib/sessionInputBanners/.sessionWorktreeCleanup.filteredIntro: Review all agen sesi worktrees, atau filter oleh ruang kerja dan inactivity period. Inactive, unpinned sesi can be cleaned up to reclaim disk space, including recently used sesi. aktif sesi dan sesi waiting untuk input can be terpilih manually but are not terpilih secara bawaan. Remaining worktrees untuk sesi already marked as done are terpilih secara bawaan when their host supports retrying cleanup, unless a previous removal failed. Failed cleanup can be retried oleh memilih the worktree manually. Scheduled atau berjalan cleanup cannot be terpilih again. Any uncommitted changes are committed before the worktree is dihapus. Cleaning up a sesi marks it as done; you can restore the sesi later to recreate its worktree. bentangkan Unavailable untuk cleanup to see other worktrees dan why they cannot be terpilih.

vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.authority: Automations jalankan on their terpilih provider, not in this jendela. Creation dan changes require an available provider that supports automations. jalankan now requests execution dari that provider; a disconnected atau unsupported provider never falls back to local execution. To use another provider, duplikasikan the automation. The original riwayat stays dengan its provider, dan an diaktifkan original keeps scheduling until you nonaktifkan it.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.builtInTempla: The Built-in Templates section is diciutkan secara bawaan because tersimpan automations exist. Press Enter atau Space on its disclosure control to bentangkan it.

The Built-in Templates section is dibentangkan secara bawaan while there are no tersimpan automations. Tab to a template dan press Enter atau Space to buka a New automation dialog dengan an editable name, prompt, dan schedule.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.cards: untuk tersimpan automations, Tab to a card's Edit control dan action buttons. Use Left Arrow dan Right Arrow to move between jalankan now dan More Actions. Press Enter atau Space to activate a control. Edit, atau clicking anywhere else on the card, opens the automation dialog. More Actions opens the automation menu. duplikasikan opens a prefilled New automation dialog untuk portable schedules dan is unavailable untuk event-triggered automations. nonaktifkan prevents future runs, dan hapus asks untuk confirmation. jalankan now requests execution dari the terpilih provider when available.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.cloudDialog: Saat membuat an automation dan cloud automations are diaktifkan, a jalankan in the cloud switch, described as Preview, follows the Name field; press Space to turn it on atau off. If cloud automations cannot be reached when you turn it on, the switch turns back off dan a message asks you to try again in a few moments. When it is on, Cloud is the agen dan the ruang kerja picker lists Git-backed ruang kerja. Only GitHub repositories that support cloud automation management can be terpilih; unavailable repositories are announced dengan the reason. Choose Add repository to cari untuk a repository atau tempel its URL. A matching local folder is retained. If cloud automations become unavailable while the switch is on, Cloud stays terpilih dan buat is unavailable until they return atau, untuk a new automation, you turn the switch off. Turning the switch off restores the previous local ruang kerja dan agen, atau otherwise selects Copilot when it is available. Cloud models are dikonfigurasi in the prompt section. In the alat section, the button shows All alat allowed atau the number of alat allowed. Activate it to buka a searchable checklist of the alat GitHub offers, grouped oleh category. Categories mulai diciutkan; use Right Arrow to bentangkan one. Press Space to toggle a alat atau category. Each change applies immediately to the dialog; Enter atau Escape closes the checklist tanpa membuang changes. simpan atau buat saves the automation. New automations mulai dengan every listed alat terpilih. While the list loads the button is unavailable, dan if it cannot be loaded a Retry button appears. Trigger follows the alat controls. Scheduled triggers display local time; GitHub stores a fixed UTC schedule, so the local jalankan time may shift when daylight menyimpan time changes. When editing a cloud automation, the switch dan ruang kerja picker are dinonaktifkan because changing the repository atau provider requires duplication. Editing preserves diaktifkan state; aktifkan atau nonaktifkan an automation dari its card.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.cloudHistory: Cloud riwayat shows the repository, status, dan last diperbarui time even when no local sesi is available. When a cloud jalankan has a sesi on GitHub that is not yet loaded in VS Code, click its row, atau Tab to its title dan press Enter atau Space, to buka that exact sesi. Tab to a row's toolbar dan use Left Arrow dan Right Arrow to reach buka on GitHub dan hentikan when supported. Archive atau Mark as Done is unavailable until the cloud jalankan dan its conversation have finished. It changes local sesi state, not the task on GitHub. hentikan requests remote cancellation; the status changes when GitHub reports it. Follow-up requests tampilkan conversation progress dan mulai ulang bounded riwayat discovery. Use Refresh in the tampilan header to muat ulang definitions dan riwayat. aktif cloud runs refresh every 15 seconds tanpa moving the riwayat rows; idle definitions do not poll.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.dialog: In the automation dialog, Target controls are above the prompt. agen dan model pickers are inside the prompt input, dan execution mode dan permission controls are below it. Use Tab dan Shift+Tab to move between fields dan pickers. When membuat an automation, you only need to enter a prompt. An empty name is derived dari the prompt, dan the target defaults to No ruang kerja unless one is already supplied. An available agen Host that supports the target is still required.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.events: untuk Cloud automations, the Trigger picker combines Weekly, Daily, Hourly, Issue, Pull Request, dan Manual in one control. Issue dan Pull Request are offered when their events are available to your account. Scheduled triggers tampilkan time dan day controls as applicable. Event appears to the right of Trigger, in the same position as Time untuk a schedule. Issue uses one Event. untuk Pull Request, activate the Event button to buka a searchable checklist. Use Up Arrow dan Down Arrow to navigate dan Space to pilih events; at least one stays terpilih. Enter atau Escape closes the checklist. Required event fields appear directly below the Trigger dan Event row. buat remains unavailable until they are completed, dan its hover explains what is missing. bentangkan Advanced below them to konfigurasikan optional filters dan Include activity dari users tanpa write access to this repository. When terpilih events support the same filter, such as Query atau Paths, it appears once dan applies to each of those events. Labels, assignees dan changed paths accept comma-separated values; paths use gitignore patterns. Query filters the target dan Comment text filters a comment's body. Review states are checkboxes. Include activity dari users tanpa write access to this repository starts on; turn it off to require write access to trigger the automation. Unsupported atau mixed triggers are read-only dengan buka on GitHub; editing other fields keeps the tersimpan triggers. Event automations jalankan dari GitHub events rather than jalankan now.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.eventsReposit: Saat repository pengaturan disallow activity dari users tanpa write access, that option is turned off dan unavailable, dengan the explanation dinonaktifkan oleh your repository pengaturan.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.externalDefin: untuk cloud automation cards, More Actions also offers buka on GitHub to buka the automation's details in your browser.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.history: jalankan riwayat is grouped oleh date. While a jalankan is waiting untuk its sesi, a lightweight row shows the automation name dengan a Working... description. Once the sesi is available, use Up Arrow dan Down Arrow to navigate the sesi list, Enter to buka, dan Tab to reach hentikan, the dikonfigurasi Archive atau Mark as Done action, atau hapus when available. buka a row's context menu, untuk example dengan Shift+F10, to ganti nama it, change its aktif atau read state, atau hapus it. Hapus Secara Permanen deletes the sesi dan removes it dari jalankan riwayat after confirmation.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.overview: You are in the Automations tampilan. It contains available automation cards followed oleh jalankan riwayat. Loading, unavailable, dan error messages indicate that the catalogue may be incomplete.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.ownership: tersimpan cards are grouped under collapsible Your automations dan Shared automations sections. Press Enter atau Space on a section header to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. The Shared automations info icon explains who can tampilan dan edit those automations. Cloud creation has an Owner control after alat. Use the arrow keys to choose Only me atau Repository; Only me is the bawaan. Ownership cannot be changed when editing. Repository readers can tampilan Shared automations; writers can kelola them. A failed simpan leaves the dialog buka dengan the server's explanation above buat.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.pluginTemplat: The Templates dari plugin section is available whenever diaktifkan plugin provide templates. Press Enter atau Space on its disclosure control to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. A blue marker indicates templates added since the section was last dibentangkan. plugin templates mulai dinonaktifkan.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.read: Completed dan failed runs that have not been dibuka are announced as unread. Use Mark all as read in the riwayat header, atau focus the Automations sidebar shortcut dan press Shift+F10 to choose Mark All as Read dari its context menu. This marks available completed dan failed runs as read, except cloud runs dengan an aktif follow-up.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.sharing: Use Import Automation in the tampilan header, atau drop one .automation.md berkas anywhere in the tampilan, to review a shared Automation blueprint. Imported Automations mulai dinonaktifkan. untuk agen Host automations, buka the context menu dan choose Export to simpan a portable blueprint. Cloud automations do not currently offer Export.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationsCustomView.help.weekdays: untuk agen Host automations, choose Weekdays to jalankan Monday through Friday at the same local time, tanpa choosing a day of the week. Weekdays is not available untuk Cloud automations.

vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.findBugs.description: Explore the codebase dan report verified, reproducible bugs.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.findBugs.name: cari bugs
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.findBugs.prompt:
Explore this codebase dan cari concrete, reproducible bugs.

Read the repository guidance dan understand the architecture before choosing a focused area to investigate, such as terkini changes, complex state transitions, atau error handling. Trace suspected masalah through callers dan existing tests. Use the smallest relevant tests atau a minimal reproduction to verify behavior, dan distinguish confirmed bugs dari hypotheses. Avoid style-only suggestions dan speculative findings.

Report high-confidence, actionable bugs dengan severity, berkas dan line references, a triggering scenario, expected versus actual behavior, dan supporting test atau reproduction results. Suggest a focused fix untuk each finding tanpa modifying repository berkas atau committing changes. State what you explored, any validation limitations, dan when no confirmed bugs were found.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.issueTriage.descripti: Triage my GitHub repositories' issues using their precedents.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.issueTriage.name: Issue triage
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.issueTriage.prompt:
Triage my GitHub repositories' issues using existing repository precedents.

Use the authenticated GitHub account to cari my repositories, prioritizing aktif repositories dan new atau untriaged issues. untuk each repository, read its contribution guidelines, issue templates, existing labels, dan comparable issues dengan maintainer decisions. Learn each repository's conventions separately before making recommendations.

Produce a report grouped oleh repository. Link to each issue, recommend existing labels, identify likely duplicates, dan draft a reply when useful. Cite prior issues, pull requests, atau maintainer comments supporting each recommendation. Flag uncertainty atau missing precedent rather than inventing a rule. Do not terapkan labels, post comments, tutup issues, atau make other GitHub changes. State which repositories dan issues were reviewed dan any access limitations.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.mainUpdates.descripti: Pull the latest main dan summarize new commits.
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.mainUpdates.name: Catch up on main
vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/vie.automationTemplate.mainUpdates.prompt:
Pull the latest main dan summarize the commits that were pulled.

Inspect this repository's saat ini branch, working tree, dan dikonfigurasi remotes. Resolve the remote untuk main dari the repository configuration rather than assuming origin. Record HEAD, then pull that remote's main ke the saat ini checkout using --ff-only. Proceed only dengan a clean working tree dan a fast-forward perbarui. If the remote is ambiguous, main is missing, atau the perbarui is blocked, hentikan dan explain why. Do not switch branches, stash atau buang local changes, rebase, atau force an perbarui.

Compare the memulai dan ending HEAD dan summarize only newly pulled commits, grouped oleh theme. Highlight user-visible changes, bug fixes, breaking changes, dan follow-up actions. Include commit links dan related pull requests when available. If no commits were pulled, say so.

vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.closeOnFileDelete: Mengontrol apakah editor menampilkan a berkas that was dibuka during the sesi should tutup automatically when getting dihapus atau diganti nama oleh some other process. menonaktifkan this will keep the editor buka  on such an event. vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enablePreview: Mengontrol apakah preview mode is used when editor buka. There is a maximum of one preview mode editor per editor grup. This editor displays its filename in italics on its tab atau title label dan in the buka editor tampilan. Its contents will be diganti oleh the next editor dibuka in preview mode. Making a change in a preview mode editor will persist it, as will a double-click on its label, atau the 'Keep buka' option in its label context menu. membuka a berkas dari Explorer dengan a double-click persists its editor immediately.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enablePreviewFromCodeNavigation: Mengontrol apakah editor remain in preview when a code navigation is dimulai dari them. Preview editor do not stay buka, dan are reused until explicitly set to be kept buka (via double-click atau editing). This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enablePreviewFromQuickOpen: Mengontrol apakah editor dibuka dari Quick buka tampilkan as preview editor. Preview editor do not stay buka, dan are reused until explicitly set to be kept buka (via double-click atau editing). When diaktifkan, hold Ctrl before selection to buka an editor as a non-preview. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.exclude: Konfigurasikan paths atau [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) untuk excluding berkas dari the local berkas riwayat. Glob patterns are always evaluated relative to the path of the ruang kerja folder unless they are absolute paths. Changing this pengaturan has no effect on existing local berkas riwayat entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.focusedView: `${focusedView}`: the name of the tampilan that is currently focused.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.focusRecentEditorAfterClose: Mengontrol apakah editor are ditutup in most recently used order atau dari left to right.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.folderName: `${folderName}`: name of the ruang kerja folder the berkas is contained in (e.g. myFolder).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.folderPath: `${folderPath}`: berkas path of the ruang kerja folder the berkas is contained in (e.g. /Users/Development/myFolder).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.fontAliasing: Mengontrol font aliasing method in the workbench.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.highlightModifiedTabs: Mengontrol apakah a top border is drawn on tabs untuk editor that have unsaved changes. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.layoutcontrol.type.both: Shows both the dropdown dan toggle buttons.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.layoutcontrol.type.menu: Shows a single button dengan a dropdown of layout options.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.layoutcontrol.type.toggles: Shows several buttons untuk toggling the visibility of the panels dan bilah sisi.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.layoutControlEnabled: Mengontrol apakah the layout control is ditampilkan in the custom bilah judul. This pengaturan only has an effect when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.layoutControlEnabledWeb: Mengontrol apakah the layout control in the bilah judul is ditampilkan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.layoutControlType: Mengontrol apakah the layout control in the custom bilah judul is displayed as a single menu button atau dengan multiple UI toggles.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.limitEditorsEnablement: Mengontrol jika the number of dibuka editor should be limited atau not. When diaktifkan, less recently used editor will tutup to make space untuk newly membuka editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.limitEditorsExcludeDirty: Mengontrol jika the maximum number of dibuka editor should exclude dirty editor untuk counting towards the dikonfigurasi limit.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.limitEditorsMaximum: Mengontrol maximum number of dibuka editor. Use the {0} pengaturan to control this limit per editor grup atau across all grup.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.localHistoryEnabled: Mengontrol apakah local berkas riwayat is diaktifkan. When diaktifkan, the berkas contents of an editor that is tersimpan will be stored to a backup location to be able to restore atau review the contents later. Changing this pengaturan has no effect on existing local berkas riwayat entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.localHistoryMaxFileEntries: Mengontrol maximum number of local berkas riwayat entries per berkas. When the number of local berkas riwayat entries exceeds this number untuk a berkas, the oldest entries will be dibuang.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.localHistoryMaxFileSize: Mengontrol maximum size of a berkas (in KB) to be considered untuk local berkas riwayat. berkas that are larger will not be added to the local berkas riwayat. Changing this pengaturan has no effect on existing local berkas riwayat entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.menuBarVisibility: Control the visibility of the menu bar. A pengaturan of 'toggle' means that the menu bar is tersembunyi dan a single press of the Alt key will tampilkan it. A pengaturan of 'compact' will move the menu ke the bilah sisi.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.menuBarVisibility.mac: Control the visibility of the menu bar. A pengaturan of 'toggle' means that the menu bar is tersembunyi dan executing `Focus Application Menu` will tampilkan it. A pengaturan of 'compact' will move the menu ke the bilah sisi.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.mergeWindow: Konfigurasikan an interval in seconds during which the last entry in local berkas riwayat is diganti dengan the entry that is being added. This helps reduce the overall number of entries that are added, untuk example when auto simpan is diaktifkan. This pengaturan is only diterapkan to entries that have the same source of origin. Changing this pengaturan has no effect on existing local berkas riwayat entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUI: Mengontrol apakah the Modern UI perbarui is diaktifkan. When on, the side bars dan bottom panel are ditampilkan as floating cards dengan rounded corners dan gaps, dan a set of refreshed workbench styles is diterapkan, matching the agen jendela design.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUIEditorTabStyle: Mengontrol editor tab style when {0} is diaktifkan, dan the chat dan side-panel tab style in the agen jendela. High contrast themes retain explicit selection dan focus borders.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUIEditorTabStyle.connected: Connect the aktif tab to the editor surface dengan an outside border dan curved shoulders.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUIEditorTabStyle.pill: tampilkan editor tabs as separate rounded pills.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUIFrostedGlass: Adds a softly blurred background to menus, the palet perintah, dan other pop-ups. Available in the agen jendela dan in editor jendela dengan {0} diaktifkan. Always respects reduced transparency in your operating system's accessibility pengaturan, as well as {1}. Uses solid backgrounds in high contrast themes atau when the effect isn't supported. Turn this off if you notice display atau performance issues. Your operating system's own menus dan dialogs are unchanged.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUIFrostedGlassOpacity: Mengontrol bagaimana see-through frosted glass backgrounds are, dari 50% to 100%. Lower values reveal more of the blurred content behind them; higher values make the background more solid. Text dan controls stay unchanged. Requires {0} dan does not override reduced transparency pengaturan in your operating system atau VS Code.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.modernUIUppercaseViewHeaders: Mengontrol apakah tampilan headers, bilah sisi titles, dan panel tabs use uppercase text when {0} is diaktifkan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.mouseBackForwardToNavigate: Mengaktifkan the use of mouse buttons four dan five untuk commands 'Go Back' dan 'Go Forward'.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.navigationControlEnabled: Mengontrol apakah the navigation control is ditampilkan in the custom bilah judul. This pengaturan only has an effect when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.navigationControlEnabledWeb: Mengontrol apakah the navigation control in the bilah judul is ditampilkan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.navigationScope: Mengontrol scope of riwayat navigation in editor untuk commands such as 'Go Back' dan 'Go Forward'.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.notificationsButton: Mengontrol visibility of the Notifications button in the bilah judul. Only applies when notifications are positioned at the top right.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.notificationsPosition: Mengontrol position of the notification toasts dan notification center.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openDefaultKeybindings: Mengontrol apakah membuka keybinding pengaturan also opens an editor menampilkan all bawaan keybindings.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openDefaultSettings: Mengontrol apakah membuka pengaturan also opens an editor menampilkan all bawaan pengaturan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openFilesInNewWindow:
Mengontrol apakah berkas should buka in a new jendela when using a command line atau berkas dialog.
Note that there can still be cases where this pengaturan is ignored (e.g. when using the `--new-window` atau `--reuse-window` command line option).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openFilesInNewWindowMac:
Mengontrol apakah berkas should buka in a new jendela when using a command line atau berkas dialog.
Note that there can still be cases where this pengaturan is ignored (e.g. when using the `--new-window` atau `--reuse-window` command line option).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openFoldersInNewWindow:
Mengontrol apakah folder should buka in a new jendela atau ganti the last aktif jendela.
Note that there can still be cases where this pengaturan is ignored (e.g. when using the `--new-window` atau `--reuse-window` command line option).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.panelDefaultLocation: Mengontrol bawaan location of the panel (terminal, konsol debug, keluaran, masalah) in a new ruang kerja. It can either tampilkan at the bottom, top, right, atau left of the editor area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.panelOpensMaximized: Mengontrol apakah the panel opens maximized. It can either always buka maximized, never buka maximized, atau buka to the last state it was in before being ditutup.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.panelShowLabels: Mengontrol apakah activity items in the panel title are ditampilkan as label atau icon.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.perEditorGroup: Mengontrol jika the limit of maximum dibuka editor should terapkan per editor grup atau across all editor grup.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.pinnedTabSizing: Mengontrol size of pinned editor tabs. Pinned tabs are sorted to the beginning of all dibuka tabs dan typically do not tutup until unpinned. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.preserveInput: Mengontrol apakah the last typed input to the palet perintah should be restored when membuka it the next time.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.problems.visibility: Mengontrol apakah the masalah are visible throughout the editor dan workbench.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.profileName: `${profileName}`: name of the profile in which the ruang kerja is dibuka (e.g. Data Science (Profile)). Ignored if bawaan profile is used.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.restoreOnStartup: Mengontrol apakah editor are restored on startup. When dinonaktifkan, only dirty editor will be restored dari the previous sesi.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.restoreViewState: Restores the last editor tampilan state (such as scroll position) when re-membuka editor after they have been ditutup. editor tampilan state is stored per editor grup dan dibuang when a grup closes. Use the {0} pengaturan to use the last known tampilan state across all editor grup in case no previous tampilan state was found untuk a editor grup.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.revealIfOpen: Mengontrol apakah an editor is revealed in any of the visible grup if dibuka. If dinonaktifkan, an editor will prefer to buka in the currently aktif editor grup. If diaktifkan, an already dibuka editor will be revealed instead of dibuka again in the currently aktif editor grup. Note that there are some cases where this pengaturan is ignored, such as when forcing an editor to buka in a specific grup atau to the side of the currently aktif grup.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.rootName: `${rootName}`: name of the ruang kerja dengan optional remote name dan ruang kerja indicator if applicable (e.g. myFolder, myRemoteFolder [SSH] atau myWorkspace (ruang kerja)).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.rootNameShort: `${rootNameShort}`: shortened name of the ruang kerja tanpa suffixes (e.g. myFolder, myRemoteFolder atau myWorkspace).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.rootPath: `${rootPath}`: berkas path of the dibuka ruang kerja atau folder (e.g. /Users/Development/myWorkspace).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.scrollToSwitchTabs: Mengontrol apakah scrolling over tabs will buka them atau not. secara bawaan tabs will only reveal upon scrolling, but not buka. You can press dan hold the Shift-key while scrolling to change this behavior untuk that duration. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.secondarySideBarDefaultVisibility: Mengontrol bawaan visibility of the bilah sisi sekunder in ruang kerja atau empty jendela that are dibuka untuk the first time. Can be overridden oleh the agen sesi startup editor pengaturan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.secondarySideBarForceMaximized: Mengontrol apakah the bilah sisi sekunder is enforced to always tampilkan maximized on startup dan when there are no buka editor, in layouts that support a maximized bilah sisi sekunder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.secondarySideBarShowLabels: Mengontrol apakah activity items in the bilah sisi sekunder title are ditampilkan as label atau icon. This pengaturan only has an effect when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.separator: `${separator}`: a conditional separator (" - ") that only shows when surrounded oleh variables dengan values atau static text.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.settings.editor.desc: Menentukan which pengaturan editor to use secara bawaan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.settings.showAISearchToggle: Mengontrol apakah the AI cari results toggle is ditampilkan in the cari bar in the pengaturan editor after doing a cari dan once AI cari results are available.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.shadows: Mengontrol apakah shadow effects are ditampilkan around the side panels dan other workbench elements.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.sharedViewState: Preserves the most terkini editor tampilan state (such as scroll position) across all editor grup dan restores that if no specific editor tampilan state is found untuk the editor grup.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.showAskInChat: Mengontrol apakah the palet perintah shows 'Ask in Chat' option at the bottom.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.showEditorTabs: Mengontrol apakah dibuka editor should tampilkan as individual tabs, one single large tab atau if the title area should not be ditampilkan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.showIcons: Mengontrol apakah dibuka editor should tampilkan dengan an icon atau not. This requires a berkas icon theme to be diaktifkan as well.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.showTabIndex: Saat diaktifkan, will tampilkan the tab index. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.sideBarLocation: Mengontrol location of the bilah sisi utama dan bilah aktivitas. They can either tampilkan on the left atau right of the workbench. The bilah sisi sekunder will tampilkan on the opposite side of the workbench.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.sideBySideDirection: Mengontrol bawaan direction of editor that are dibuka side oleh side (untuk example, dari the Explorer). secara bawaan, editor will buka on the right hand side of the currently aktif one. If changed to `down`, the editor will buka below the currently aktif one. This also impacts the split editor action in the editor toolbar.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.splitInGroupLayout: Mengontrol layout untuk when an editor is split in an editor grup to be either vertical atau horizontal.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.splitOnDragAndDrop: Mengontrol jika editor grup can be split dari drag dan drop operations oleh dropping an editor atau berkas on the edges of the editor area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.splitSizing: Mengontrol size of editor grup when splitting them.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.statusBarVisibility: Mengontrol visibility of the bilah status at the bottom of the workbench.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.suggestCommands: Mengontrol apakah the palet perintah should have a list of commonly used commands.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.swipeToNavigate: Navigate between buka berkas using three-finger swipe horizontally. Note that System preferensi > Trackpad > More Gestures > 'Swipe between pages' must be set to 'Swipe dengan two atau three fingers'.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabActionLocation: Mengontrol position of the editor's tabs action buttons (tutup, unpin). This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabDescription: Mengontrol format of the label untuk an editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabScrollbarHeight: Mengontrol height of the scrollbars used untuk tabs dan breadcrumb in the editor title area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabSizing: Mengontrol size of editor tabs. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tips.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, will tampilkan the watermark tips when no editor is buka.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.titleScrollbarVisibility: Mengontrol visibility of the scrollbars used untuk tabs dan breadcrumb in the editor title area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.untitledLabelFormat: Mengontrol format of the label untuk an untitled editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.useModal: Mengontrol apakah editor buka in a modal overlay.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.useModal.all: All editor buka in a centered modal overlay.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.useModal.off: editor never buka in a modal overlay.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.useModal.some: Certain editor such as pengaturan dan pintasan papan tombol may buka in a centered modal overlay.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.useSplitJSON: Mengontrol apakah to use the split JSON editor when editing pengaturan as JSON.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.viewVisibility: Mengontrol visibility of tampilan header actions. tampilan header actions may either be always visible, atau only visible when that tampilan is focused atau hovered over.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.commandCenter: tampilkan command launcher together dengan the jendela title. This pengaturan only has an effect when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.commandCenterWeb: tampilkan command launcher together dengan the jendela title.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.confirmBeforeClose.always.web: Always try to ask untuk confirmation. Note that browsers may still decide to tutup a tab atau jendela tanpa confirmation.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.confirmBeforeClose.keyboardOnly: Only ask untuk confirmation if a keybinding was used.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.confirmBeforeClose.keyboardOnly.w: Only ask untuk confirmation if a keybinding was used to tutup the jendela. Note that detection may not be possible in some cases.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.confirmBeforeClose.never.web: Never explicitly ask untuk confirmation unless data loss is imminent.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.menuBarVisibility.classic: Menu is displayed at the top of the jendela dan only tersembunyi in full screen mode.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.menuBarVisibility.compact: Menu is displayed as a compact button in the bilah sisi. This value is ignored when {0} is {1} dan {2} is either {3} atau {4}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.menuBarVisibility.compact.web: Menu is displayed as a compact button in the bilah sisi.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.menuBarVisibility.toggle: Menu is tersembunyi but can be displayed at the top of the jendela via the Alt key.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.menuBarVisibility.toggle.mac: Menu is tersembunyi but can be displayed at the top of the jendela oleh executing the `Focus Application Menu` command.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.menuBarVisibility.visible: Menu is always visible at the top of the jendela even in full screen mode.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFilesInNewWindow.default: berkas will buka in a new jendela unless picked dari within the application (e.g. via the berkas menu).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFilesInNewWindow.defaultMac: berkas will buka in the jendela dengan the berkas' folder buka atau the last aktif jendela unless dibuka via the Dock atau dari Finder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFilesInNewWindow.off: berkas will buka in the jendela dengan the berkas' folder buka atau the last aktif jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFilesInNewWindow.on: berkas will buka in a new jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFoldersInNewWindow.default: folder will buka in a new jendela unless a folder is picked dari within the application (e.g. via the berkas menu).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFoldersInNewWindow.off: folder will ganti the last aktif jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.window.openFoldersInNewWindow.on: folder will buka in a new jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.windowDensityLayout: Mengontrol spacing density of the workbench layout. Applies in the agen jendela dan when {0} is diaktifkan in the editor jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.windowDensityLayout.compact: Removes the gaps between workbench parts dan reduces their internal spacing to provide more room untuk content. Uses a shorter bilah judul in the agen jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.windowDensityLayout.default: Uses the standard spacing between workbench parts dan a taller bilah judul in the agen jendela.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.windowTitle: Mengontrol jendela title based on the saat ini context such as the dibuka ruang kerja atau aktif editor. Variables are substituted based on the context:
Focus the bilah sisi utama if the clicked item is already visible.
sembunyikan the bilah sisi utama if the clicked item is already visible.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.activityBar.location.bottom: tampilkan the bilah aktivitas at the bottom of the Primary dan Secondary Side Bars.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.activityBar.location.default: tampilkan the bilah aktivitas on the side of the bilah sisi utama dan on top of the bilah sisi sekunder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.activityBar.location.hide: sembunyikan the bilah aktivitas in the Primary dan Secondary Side Bars.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.activityBar.location.top: tampilkan the bilah aktivitas on top of the Primary dan Secondary Side Bars.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.doubleClickTabToToggleE: The editor grup takes as much space as possible oleh making all other editor grup as small as possible.
All other editor grup are tersembunyi dan the saat ini editor grup is maximized to take up the entire editor area.
No editor grup is resized when double clicking on a tab.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation.d: tampilkan editor actions in the jendela bilah judul when {0} is set to {1}. Otherwise, editor actions are ditampilkan in the editor tab bar.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation.t: tampilkan editor actions in the jendela bilah judul. If {0} is set to {1}, editor actions are tersembunyi.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.empty.hint: Mengontrol jika the empty editor text hint should be visible in the editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.historyBasedLanguageDet: Mengaktifkan use of editor riwayat in language detection. This causes automatic language detection to favor languages that have been baru saja dibuka dan allows untuk automatic language detection to operate dengan smaller inputs.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.dirname: `${dirname}`: name of the folder in which the berkas is located (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> folder`).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.enabled: Mengontrol apakah the custom workbench editor labels should be diterapkan.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.filename: `${filename}`: name of the berkas tanpa the berkas ekstensi (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> file`).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.nthdirname: `${dirname(N)}`: name of the nth parent folder in which the berkas is located (e.g. `N=2: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/static/folder/file.txt -> WORKSPACE_FOLDER`). folder can be picked dari the mulai of the path oleh using negative numbers (e.g. `N=-1: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> WORKSPACE_FOLDER`). If the __Item__ is an absolute pattern path, the first folder (`N=-1`) refers to the first folder in the absolute path, otherwise it corresponds to the ruang kerja folder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.nthextname: `${extname(N)}`: the nth ekstensi of the berkas separated oleh '.' (e.g. `N=2: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.ext1.ext2.ext3 -> ext1`). ekstensi can be picked dari the mulai of the ekstensi oleh using negative numbers (e.g. `N=-1: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.ext1.ext2.ext3 -> ext2`).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.patterns: Mengontrol rendering of the editor label. Each __Item__ is a pattern that matches a berkas path. Both relative dan absolute berkas paths are supported. The relative path must include the WORKSPACE_FOLDER (e.g `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/src/**.tsx` atau `*/src/**.tsx`). Absolute patterns must mulai dengan a `/`. In case multiple patterns match, the longest matching path will be picked. Each __Value__ is the template untuk the rendered editor when the __Item__ matches. Variables are substituted based on the context:
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.template: The template which should be rendered when the pattern matches. May include the variables ${dirname}, ${filename} dan ${extname}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.default: tampilkan the name of the berkas. When tabs are diaktifkan dan two berkas have the same name in one grup the distinguishing sections of each berkas's path are added. When tabs are dinonaktifkan, the path relative to the ruang kerja folder is ditampilkan if the editor is aktif.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.long: tampilkan the name of the berkas followed oleh its absolute path.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.medium: tampilkan the name of the berkas followed oleh its path relative to the ruang kerja folder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.short: tampilkan the name of the berkas followed oleh its direktori name.

vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.agentProgress: Allow agen mode to speak brief semantic progress updates while it investigates, plans, edits, validates, atau recovers dari a problem.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.backendUrl: Voice backend WebSocket URL. Leave empty to use the bawaan hosted backend. Set to e.g. `ws://localhost:8000/api/v1/realtime/voice` to point at a backend berjalan on your machine.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.enabled: Aktifkan the Voice Mode panel in the chat tampilan untuk voice-driven coding conversations.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.handsFree: Saat diaktifkan, voice mode automatically re-enters listening after the assistant finishes speaking, so you can hold a hands-free back-dan-forth conversation. When dinonaktifkan, you mulai dan end each turn manually, dan ending the turn sends it. Turns are not ended automatically on trailing silence atau a hentikan phrase unless {0} atau {1} is explicitly dikonfigurasi.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.language: The language used untuk speech recognition, dictation, dan spoken responses. The selectable languages support native voice keluaran. Automatic uses the dikonfigurasi display language untuk speech recognition dan dictation when supported; otherwise, it follows the system atau browser locale. English voice keluaran is used when the detected language does not support native voice keluaran. Changing this while voice mode is connected takes effect immediately.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.liveTranscript: tampilkan your speech as a live, word-oleh-word transcript while you are speaking. When dinonaktifkan, your transcript appears only once you finish speaking. Requires `#agents.voice.showTranscript#` to be diaktifkan to be visible.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.sessionAwareness: Share a bounded briefing of tracked sesi dan the aktif chat's terkini conversation dengan OpenAI BYOK Voice Mode, so it can answer sesi status questions directly. This includes sesi titles, response summaries, pending prompt details, the terpilih model, dan attachment names, but not attachment contents. nonaktifkan to restore input-only context. Changes take effect when Voice Mode reconnects.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.showButton: Mengontrol apakah the Voice Mode button is ditampilkan in the chat input. When tersembunyi, Voice Mode can still be dimulai dengan its keyboard shortcut.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.showTranscript: tampilkan the voice transcript overlay in the chat input area while voice mode is aktif. aktifkan this to read responses as text when `#agents.voice.speakResponses#` is dinonaktifkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.speakResponses: Saat diaktifkan, the assistant reads responses aloud. When dinonaktifkan, responses are not spoken; aktifkan `#agents.voice.showTranscript#` to read them as a text transcript instead.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.turn.silenceMs: Trailing silence in milliseconds before the backend ends the turn automatically. Set to `-1` to nonaktifkan ending the turn on silence, in which case the turn ends only via a hentikan phrase ({0}) atau manually. When diaktifkan, the backend clamps this to its supported range (currently 200-5000 ms) dan is the source of truth. When hands-free mode ({1}) is dinonaktifkan, the turn is not ended on silence secara bawaan unless this pengaturan is explicitly dikonfigurasi, so you keep manual control over when a turn is sent.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.turn.silenceMs.disabled: Do not end the turn on trailing silence.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.turn.stopPhrases: Phrases that end the turn when spoken at the end of an utterance. Leave empty to nonaktifkan ending the turn on a hentikan phrase, in which case the turn ends only on trailing silence ({0}) atau manually. The backend strips the matched phrase dari the transcript before it reaches the agen. When hands-free mode ({1}) is dinonaktifkan, hentikan phrases do not end the turn secara bawaan unless this pengaturan is explicitly dikonfigurasi, so you keep manual control over when a turn is sent.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.useBYOKVoiceModel: The OpenAI live model ID to use untuk Voice Mode dengan your dikonfigurasi API key. Add the key in Models Management. Voice Mode uses this model when client BYOK is allowed dan the key has access to it; leave empty to use the hosted voice model, which requires a paid Copilot plan.
vs/workbench/contrib/agentsVoice/browser.agents.voice.voice: The voice used when the assistant reads responses aloud. Changing this while voice mode is connected takes effect immediately. Use [Voice Mode instructions](command:__TOK_0__) to customize Voice Mode behavior dan terminology.
