vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.agentHostApprovalsPicker: Saat an agen sesi exposes approval presets, use Tab to reach the Approvals picker dan choose how it handles ruang kerja access, commands, dan the internet.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.agentHostPolicyContinuation: Saat your organization disables Claude atau Codex, their agen Host conversations remain listed dan read-only. If your organization also requires the new Copilot experience, an buka, idle conversation automatically moves to Copilot dengan its title, riwayat, dan draft. Nothing is sent automatically. The original is archived only after the salin opens dan other conversations in its sesi can still be reached. membuka an archived original does not move it again. If moving needs a ruang kerja atau trust decision, atau fails, use Tab to focus Continue in Copilot in the banner, then press Enter atau Space. This action reopens an existing salin when available. Subagent chats require the manual action. untuk a dikelola checkout, choose an independent ruang kerja; uncommitted berkas stay in the original checkout. If tersimpan riwayat cannot load, use Retry in the error banner.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.agentHostSandboxDiagnostics: Saat a sandbox dependency warning appears above the input, use Tab to reach Troubleshooting Guide atau, when permitted, nonaktifkan Sandboxing. Press Enter atau Space to activate the button. nonaktifkan Sandboxing turns sandboxing off untuk this sesi dan in pengaturan; organization policy still applies.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.agentHostSandboxPolicy: In Copilot agen-host sesi, use /sandbox policy to tampilan the effective sandbox policy. In the response, use Tab to focus buka Sandbox Policy dan Enter to buka the diformat report.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.agentsWindowInvitation: A berjalan agen Host chat may tampilkan an invitation to continue atau tampilan your sesi in the agen jendela. Only one invitation is ditampilkan across editor jendela at a time. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach its action, Don't tampilkan Again, atau Dismiss notification. The action opens the agen jendela dan highlights this sesi's row in the sesi list when onboarding is diaktifkan. secara bawaan, it also opens this chat. Choose Next to highlight the New sesi button, which you can activate to mulai another task. nonaktifkan chat.agentsWindowBanner.revealCurrentSession to buka the New sesi tampilan instead dan only highlight the invited sesi's row. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to move between the tour actions dan any interactive highlighted control. Choose Understood to finish the tour, atau press Escape to dismiss it. Sending another message atau completing a task does not dismiss the invitation. It is temporarily tersembunyi while the sesi needs attention. Dismiss notification snoozes invitations until you have dibuat five more agen Host sesi in editor jendela dan at least 24 hours have passed since the invitation appeared. Don't tampilkan Again turns off all future agen jendela invitations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.announcement: Chat responses will be announced as they come in. A response will indicate the number of code blocks, if any, dan then the rest of the response.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.artifactActionDisclosure: Artifact actions appear as diciutkan request cards dengan an action dan resource label. Use Tab to reach the card dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan it. The details are a snapshot dari when the action dimulai. Use arrow keys within a details list dan Enter to buka an item. agen Message switches between these details dan the full prompt. buka the accessible view{0} while the request is focused to read its snapshot as text.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.attachments.inlineReferenceHover: To inspect an inline attachment reference, place the cursor on it dan invoke tampilkan atau Focus Hover{0}. Image references include a preview, while berkas dan folder references include their path.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.attachments.inlineReferences: To mention an attached context item at a specific position tanpa menghapus it dari the attached context, type # atau @ dan pilih the attachment dari the suggestions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.attachments.pastedText: Long ditempelkan text, including single-line text, is stored as an attached text item dan diganti in the input dengan a numbered inline reference.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.attachments.removal: To hapus attached contexts, focus an attachment dan press hapus atau Backspace.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.blobby: Ketik /blobby untuk unlock the True Name achievement tanpa sending a chat request. If Blobby is off, the command turns it on; if it is already on, it opens the Color tab in Customize Blobby. Change Color in the pet's context menu always opens Color, where Stable dan Insiders are free choices. True Name unlocks solid presets dan custom colors; activating that achievement also opens Color. Use the color picker atau enter an opaque hex color such as #ff8800, then activate terapkan Color. Unapplied custom colors are dibuang when you leave the tab atau tutup the modal.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.btw: In a conversation that supports side chats, type /btw followed oleh a question to buka a side chat dengan the prior conversation as context. You can ask while a response is in progress tanpa menghentikan it.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.canvasesAddContext: In local Copilot agen-host sesi dengan chat.kanvas.diaktifkan turned on, Add Context includes kanvas immediately after sesi. buka kanvas to choose a registered atau ditutup kanvas oleh name. Activating one opens atau refocuses its tab; it does not attach anything to the prompt.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.cloudSandboxEarlyPreparation: Saat {0} is diaktifkan, typing in a new Cloud chat, dengan atau tanpa a repository, can prepare cloud resources in the background. Your message is not sent dan no conversation is added to the sesi list until you press Send. Send waits untuk pending preparation dan reuses it when possible, otherwise it can continue tanpa early preparation. While the jendela is berjalan, VS Code attempts to release unused preparation after five minutes, when you change repositories, atau when you turn the pengaturan off.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.cloudStartupError: If cloud sesi creation atau connection fails, the saat ini response offers tampilkan Details. Use Tab to focus tampilkan Details dan Enter atau Space to buka a dialog dengan the failed step dan available request details. membuka details does not sign in atau retry the request. As dengan other response buttons, tampilkan Details is unavailable after the conversation is restored.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.codexContinuation: A ChatGPT limit suggestion may offer Continue dengan Copilot. If the eligible Codex sesi is not aktif, the guide highlights its row in the sesi list. Activate buka sesi in the guide atau buka the row using the list's usual keyboard shortcut: secara bawaan, Command+Down Arrow on macOS atau Enter on jendela dan Linux. The next step opens its model picker dengan a matching Copilot model in the cari. Activate Use Copilot in the guide atau use Up dan Down Arrow dan Enter in the picker to pilih the Copilot model. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach the guide's buttons dan Enter atau Space to activate them. An already-aktif eligible sesi goes directly to the picker. End Tour atau Escape cancels the remaining guidance; it does not urungkan a model selection.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.completedResponseDisclosure: Saat completed response menciutkan is diaktifkan, the final response remains visible while earlier work is diciutkan. Use Tab to focus the work disclosure dan press Enter atau Space to tampilkan atau sembunyikan that work. dengan persistent progress diaktifkan, a separate berkas changes button shows lines added dan dihapus when the diciutkan work includes edits. Activate it to buka those berkas changes tanpa membentangkan the work.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.copilotHarnessIntroduction: Depending on the aktif experiment, a new Copilot harness chat may tampilkan an introduction to the new Copilot experience when the sesi starts atau after the first request is submitted. Once ditampilkan, sending messages does not dismiss it. Use Tab to reach let us know, Learn More, Got it!, atau Not Helpful. Learn More opens documentation tanpa menyembunyikan the introduction. Got it! dan Not Helpful turn off future introductions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.customizationMigrations: Saat ruang kerja kustomisasi need an perbarui, a notice above the new-chat input shows how many need attention. Use Tab to reach Review migrasi dan buka the migrasi page. Dismiss migrasi Notice untuk This ruang kerja hides the notice untuk that ruang kerja, including after memulai ulang, dan returns focus to the input. The kustomisasi toolbar button also announces when migrasi are available.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.differencePanel: The chat tampilan is a persistent interface that also supports navigating suggested follow-up questions, while the quick chat tampilan is a transient interface untuk making dan viewing requests.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.differenceQuick: The quick chat tampilan is a transient interface untuk making dan viewing requests, while the panel chat tampilan is a persistent interface that also supports navigating suggested follow-up questions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.editorArtifactsPill: The editor jendela uses the same compact Artifacts pill as the agen jendela, rather than an dibentangkan list above the input. Generated images appear automatically. In a subagent chat, the Artifacts pill shows that chat's transcript artifacts tanpa the parent sesi's metadata. A single berkas pill opens directly; multiple artifacts buka a dropdown dengan a Generated Images section. Use the pill's hover atau context menu, atau a dropdown row's actions, to simpan an artifact atau salin its path.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.editorCanvasesPill: In local Copilot agen-host sesi dengan chat.kanvas.diaktifkan turned on, a kanvas submenu appears in the final section of the New Chat menu, dan the chat's buka kanvas appear in their own pill in the main jendela. buka the kanvas submenu to choose a registered atau ditutup kanvas oleh name. Use Up dan Down Arrow, Right Arrow, dan Enter to navigate the menus dan buka atau refocus a kanvas. A single kanvas in the pill shows its title dan opens directly; multiple kanvas tampilkan a count dan buka a picker. Activating a kanvas focuses its tab beside the chat, atau reopens it if it was ditutup. To tutup a kanvas rather than only its tab, use tutup kanvas: the X on a kanvas pill atau picker row, atau the pill's context menu. menutup ends the kanvas dan notifies the ekstensi that provides it.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.editorCopySessionLink: untuk an agen Host chat editor, buka the editor tab context menu dan choose salin Link to salin a sesi URL that renders as a sesi link in Markdown. memilih multiple chat tabs copies one link per line.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.externalSessionFilter: The agen sesi filter includes an External submenu. Use it to choose whether external sesi dari another application are ditampilkan untuk the last 24 hours, the last 7 days, always, atau not at all.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.fileChangesDisclosure: berkas change summaries tampilkan the total berkas, additions, dan deletions. Focus the disclosure dan press Enter atau Space to tampilkan atau sembunyikan the individual berkas. Focus an additions dan deletions label dan press Enter atau Space to buka the changes in a diff editor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.find: To cari the chat transcript, invoke cari in Chat{0}. cari Next{1} dan cari Previous{2} move between results, scrolling each one ke tampilan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.focusMostRecentTerminal: To focus the last chat terminal that ran a alat, invoke the Focus Most terkini Chat terminal command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.focusMostRecentTerminalOutput: To focus the keluaran dari the last chat terminal alat, invoke the Focus Most terkini Chat terminal keluaran command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.focusNotice: Saat a tip, notification atau introduction appears above the input, toggle focus between it dan the chat input{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.focusQuestionCarousel: Saat a chat question appears, toggle focus between the question dan the chat input{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.forkSession: In an agen Host chat that supports forking, type /fork to buat a forked chat beside the saat ini one. Add a title after /fork to name it, atau type /fork prompt followed oleh a prompt to also send that prompt in the new chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.forkSession.completions: memilih the /fork title atau /fork prompt completion inserts the command tanpa submitting it. The title dan prompt hints ditampilkan after the command are suggestions dan are not part of your input.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImageBatch: Each consecutive batch of image-generation calls has its own preview in conversation order. pilih any thumbnail, including one still generating, to tampilkan its image atau progress dan its alat dropdown above the preview. Use Tab to focus the terpilih thumbnail, then Left atau Right Arrow, Home, atau End to pilih another image atau its progress. bentangkan the terpilih alat dropdown to inspect its prompt dan keluaran, including timing dan size. The terpilih thumbnail has a highlighted border. The thumbnail row follows the terpilih preview's size. Generating images tampilkan only the compact glyph band, while dibatalkan atau failed images tampilkan their status in the alat dropdown tanpa an empty preview. The Image batch status below the thumbnails shows how many images are ready out of the total, along dengan any that need attention, failed, atau were dibatalkan. Later results arrive tanpa changing your selection, dan only the terpilih preview animates. Focus the main image dan press Enter to buka the carousel. Approval dan authentication requests remain visible even when another image is terpilih.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImageBatchDownload: Use the download action beside the Image batch status to Simpan Semua currently ready images as a ZIP archive. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to download. The action is unavailable until an image is ready dan while a download is in progress. Only images ready when you mulai the download are included; failed, dibatalkan, dan pending images are not included.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImageCancellation: menghentikan image generation shows Image generation dibatalkan, not a generation error. dibatalkan image alat keep their dibatalkan status when you reopen the chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImageCarousel: Generated images also appear in artifacts. When Images Preview is diaktifkan untuk chat, membuka an image lets you browse generated images, user-attached images, dan images ditampilkan in responses dari the same conversation. Use the Left dan Right Arrow keys to move between images.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImageDetails: bentangkan a completed image-generation dropdown to inspect its duration, total image byte size, dan tokens. A dash means the value was not reported; token usage is not yet available. Generated image downloads include a stable hash suffix so different images have distinct filenames.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImagePreparation: Image-generation alat entries, previews, dan batch counts stay tersembunyi while the model assembles the alat arguments. If approval is required, the confirmation is the first alat UI ditampilkan. Generating image, the glyph animation, painting progress phrases, dan the painting pet mulai only when the alat executes, after any required confirmation. Confirmation dan authentication waits pause image-generation progress.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImages: Image generation appears separately dari thinking dan alat-call grup. Copilot dan Codex agen sesi share this presentation. Completed steps ciutkan only before the first image-generation alat, keeping image alat in their original position. While generation runs, bentangkan the alat dropdown to inspect the submitted prompt. Its title says Generating image dengan the image model when the model is available, dan does not shimmer. The image model can differ dari the terpilih conversation model. A compact decorative band of shifting glyphs remains visible below the dropdown dan reveals a single image when its bytes are available. The animation does not indicate a percentage complete dan stays still when reduced motion is diaktifkan atau a high contrast theme is aktif. The reveal is skipped in those modes dan when reopening a chat. Only the persistent progress line rotates through painting-themed phrases, tanpa repeatedly announcing them. These phrases are decorative, not individual generation stages. Use Tab to focus the dropdown dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Successful generation shows the Generated image dropdown, including the image model when available, dengan a single image below it even when diciutkan. If generation fails, the Generated image failed row can be dibentangkan to inspect the error. Completed dan failed image alat keep their final status when you reopen the chat. Image previews mulai loading as soon as generation succeeds, even if the response is still in progress. A preview is marked as busy while its bytes load. Unable to load image indicates a problem loading the preview, not a failed generation. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to focus an image dan Enter to buka it. Use the simpan action to the right of the image to simpan generated images.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.generatedImageTransition: Once an image is ready, the preview begins resizing immediately, followed oleh the glyph-to-image reveal. Reduced motion dan high contrast skip this transition.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.harnessSwitchFeedbackSurvey: After you switch dari Copilot to Local, a feedback survey may appear above the chat input. Use Shift+Tab to reach it. Use Up dan Down Arrow to choose why you switched, then press Enter atau Space to submit. Dismiss Survey atau Escape closes the survey. After submission, a message confirms that your feedback was recorded. Use Tab to reach Share it on GitHub to provide specific feedback in a GitHub issue. Use Dismiss Feedback Acknowledgement atau Escape to tutup the message.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.historyRefresh: Cloud sandbox conversations can tampilkan previously loaded messages while refreshing silently. If terkini messages cannot be loaded, use Tab to reach Refresh in the banner dan press Enter atau Space. Refresh retries recorded riwayat tanpa memulai ulang the sesi, waking its environment, atau sending your draft.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.inputBlocked: Saat another Codex app is using a conversation, a banner above the input explains how to release it. You can keep editing your draft, but sending is dinonaktifkan. Quit the app holding the conversation, such as ChatGPT, atau exit the Codex CLI sesi. Use Tab to focus Retry in the banner, then press Enter atau Space to check again. Retry does not send your draft.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.inspectResponse: In the input box, inspect the last response in the accessible view{0}. Thinking content is included in order secara bawaan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.inspectResponseThinkingToggle: To include atau exclude thinking content in the accessible tampilan, jalankan the Toggle Thinking Content in Accessible tampilan command dari the palet perintah.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.linkContextMenu: Focus a link in the chat transcript dan press Shift+F10 to buka its context menu. Use salin Link to salin its target. berkas links dengan additional editor choices also provide buka dengan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.localHarnessPolicy: Saat enterprise policy disables Local, it remains in the harness picker as a dinonaktifkan option. Use Tab to reach its Learn why link dan Enter to buka policy guidance. Its hover also includes a Learn why Local is dinonaktifkan link. dinonaktifkan options cannot be terpilih.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.localModel.details: A model's detail page has a heading untuk each section; the first, the model's name, also gives the model's state, such as Ready atau Downloading 41%. Its header has icon buttons named after the model; Tab reaches them dan Left dan Right Arrow move between them. The first shows the state dan what it does: Load untuk a model that isn't loaded, which loads it right away; Resume while it is paused; hentikan while it is loaded; dan while the model is busy, an in-progress indicator named dengan the state dan the action that stops it, such as Loading, batalkan, atau Downloading 41%, Pause, atau batalkan while a model change waits untuk berjalan responses, which keeps the loaded model. Once chosen, it reads Pausing, Cancelling atau menghentikan dan can't be chosen again until the state changes. Then come perbarui, when an perbarui is available, dengan its size, dan hapus, which asks first. Use Tab dan Shift+Tab to move between its links, buttons, choices dan switches, Back to Models to return to the list, dan Escape to tutup the picker. A warning at the top says when this device doesn't have the GPU memory untuk the model at its context size. To download a model, its page states the download size, the free space needed, the source dan the license; choosing Download, atau Set Up untuk model berkas already on this device, agrees to exactly what the page shows dan downloads it in the background. Downloading doesn't need llama.cpp, but loading a model does, dan VS Code doesn't pasang it. When no llama-server is set, atau the one set doesn't support the model atau is too old, loading the model shows an error on its page dan in the notice above the chat input, dengan Get llama.cpp, which opens directions untuk getting a build that supports the model, buka pengaturan, which opens the Llama Server Path pengaturan (chat.copilot.localModel.llamaServerPath) to point to its llama-server, dan Retry. While a model downloads, its page shows a progress bar dan the time remaining. While it loads, the page shows Loading model atau Warming up, atau memuat ulang when a new context size loads it again, atau Retrying tanpa speculative decoding, dan why, when this llama.cpp build crashed dengan it, dan, when an earlier load of the same model dan context size took a known time, a progress bar dan the time remaining estimated dari it, which counts down dan reads Almost done once that time has passed; a screen reader hears when the step changes. An terpasang model's page has an Effort Level choice when the model supports it, which sets its effort level untuk this chat, like a cloud model's effort level, tanpa memuat ulang it; the row dan the readout tampilkan the new level. It also has a Context choice of the model's context sizes, each read dengan the GPU memory it needs. Changing the context size of a loaded model reloads it right away tanpa asking, once its berjalan responses finish; untuk a model that isn't loaded, it applies the next time it loads. In these choices, use the arrow keys to move between options, then Enter atau Space to choose one. The page also has the Use in Auto switch, which lets Auto jalankan some requests on this device dengan cloud fallback. The page updates in place as the model's state changes, dan a change of state is announced.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.localModel.notice: While an on-device model is terpilih, the readout beside the model name in the chat input shows its state while it isn't ready, such as Loading, memuat ulang atau Not loaded, dan its effort level dan context size once it is; a screen reader hears all of them, dan the readout opens the model's detail page. On-device models tampilkan no notifications. Instead, one notice above the chat input shows an error, a berjalan download, a model loading atau memuat ulang atau another step dengan a progress bar dan the busy indicator of an aktif sesi, atau a pause, dengan its actions, such as the Pause, batalkan atau hentikan Now button, Retry, Resume atau Review, which opens the model's detail page; use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach them. The notice has no Details action: the model's detail page opens dari the readout atau the model picker. A load's progress is estimated dari the last comparable load, dengan a time remaining that counts down on screen dan then reads almost done; the first load shows no estimate. After Pause, batalkan atau hentikan Now, the notice says Pausing, Cancelling atau menghentikan right away, dan so does the button, which can't be chosen again. While a terpilih model waits untuk the loaded model's berjalan responses, the notice says how many it waits untuk, dengan hentikan Now, which asks first, dan batalkan, which keeps the loaded model; a load always has batalkan. untuk a screen reader its text updates are throttled, dan it hears when the step changes, pauses atau fails. When an on-device model is ready, the same notice offers to switch to it. Use in Auto is off until you turn it on in the model's detail page, where its description also says that local models may not use the same safety filters as GitHub Copilot-provided models. dengan Auto terpilih dan Use in Auto on, Auto may jalankan some requests on this device dan uses a cloud model when the device can't respond; a reply that ran on this device shows On-device after the model name, dan a notice tells you the first time a cloud model was used instead in a chat. The palet perintah also has Set Up On-Device Model, which opens the detail page of the model to set up, dan batalkan On-Device Model Download, Resume On-Device Model Download, Retry On-Device Model Setup, perbarui On-Device Model, hapus On-Device Model, mulai On-Device Model, hentikan On-Device Model dan Make On-Device Model aktif.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.localModel.rows: On-device models: when this device has an NVIDIA GPU that can jalankan one, the model picker lists it in its On This Device tab, right after the Copilot tab, in Copilot chats that jalankan on the local agen host. dari the model list, use Left dan Right Arrow to switch tabs dan Up dan Down Arrow to focus a model's row. Each model has a single row, like a cloud model's: its name, an aktif badge while it is loaded atau loading, dan the effort level dan context size, such as Medium dan 128K. A screen reader also reads the model's state while it isn't ready, such as Downloading 42% atau Not loaded; the detail page dan the notice above the chat input tampilkan it too. Tab reaches the row's only button, labelled dengan the model's effort level dan context size, atau, untuk a model that isn't downloaded, Download (Set Up untuk model berkas already on this device), the download's progress, such as 42%, atau Paused; it opens the model's detail page; Right Arrow on the row opens it too. Actions such as Retry, Pause, Resume, Download dan Set Up are on the detail page, dan those untuk a berjalan, paused atau failed step also in the notice above the chat input. Pause stops a download atau perbarui so it can be resumed later; batalkan takes back a model change, keeping the loaded model while the change waits untuk berjalan responses, atau stops loading a model, dan hentikan Now ends the responses a model change is waiting untuk. Once chosen, these read Pausing, Cancelling atau menghentikan dan can't be chosen again until the model's state changes. A model that isn't downloaded can't be terpilih: a screen reader reads Not downloaded dengan its row, dan Enter opens its detail page, which has its license, size dan Download button. Enter on an terpasang model selects it dan starts loading it right away, tanpa asking. Only one on-device model is loaded at a time: memilih another one unloads the loaded one once its berjalan responses finish, dan the notice above the chat input shows how many responses it is waiting untuk, then the load, dengan batalkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.managedSettingsRetry: If loading your organization's dikelola pengaturan fails, your request remains in the conversation. Use Tab to focus Retry below the error, then press Enter atau Space to resend that request. While pengaturan are loading, hentikan cancels the pending request.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.markNestedSessionRead: The same read dan unread shortcuts work on nested sesi dan change only the targeted nested sesi, not their parent.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.markSessionsRead: Saat the sesi list has focus, mark the focused sesi atau terpilih sesi as read{0} atau unread{1} tanpa membuka them. These shortcuts do not terapkan while typing in an input.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.mcpStartupSkip: Saat a chat turn is waiting untuk server MCP to mulai, a Skip link may appear. Use Tab to focus Skip dan press Enter atau Space to continue the turn while those servers mulai in the background. The saat ini startup message disappears immediately dan focus returns to the chat input. New server startups may tampilkan another message.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.missionControl.help: Connect to Mission Control Environment opens a list of existing user-local hosts. Cached hosts are ditampilkan while the list refreshes in the background tanpa membersihkan your cari. Use Up dan Down Arrow to choose a host dan Enter to connect, atau Escape to batalkan. The owning application must be berjalan; connecting does not buat replacement compute. Passive connections are read-only, dan local sesi continue using the local host.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.autoMode: In the model picker, Auto is the first model in the Copilot tab dan is terpilih like any other model. Provider tabs dan cari remain available. Browsing another provider does not change the terpilih model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.configurationMeaning: Model bawaan means no effort override is terpilih; focusing an effort option does not pilih it. Use the arrow keys to focus an option dan Enter atau Space to choose it. Context Size shows selectable jendela when available. A value prefixed dengan Max is the model's capacity, not a terpilih context jendela. New Cloud chat choices are checked against the host before the first request is sent.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.detailsPage: In the model picker, effort level dan context appear as a configuration button on the hovered, terpilih, atau keyboard-focused model. Use Up dan Down Arrow to focus a model dan Enter to pilih it. To buka its information dan configuration page tanpa memilih it, press Right Arrow, atau use Tab to reach its configuration button dan press Enter atau Space. The button shows Details when no readout is available. Models tanpa configurable pengaturan still buka their information page. The effort level dan context readout beside the model name in the chat input opens the same page untuk the saat ini model. membuka the page focuses its configuration controls when available. Known values are ditampilkan even at their defaults. The Back to Models arrow is beside the model name; navigation dan model actions stay at the top while details scroll. Back to Models, atau {0}, returns to the previous provider, cari, dan model list dengan focus on that model. Escape closes the picker dari any page dan restores focus.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.fusion: Saat Auto's tiers come dari the Copilot service, Auto is presented as Copilot Fusion, dan its details hold an "Effort Level" pengaturan instead, such as Standard, High, dan Max. The terpilih effort level is described below the pengaturan, dan a Learn more link follows Copilot Fusion's description. Choosing an effort level keeps Copilot Fusion checked dengan that effort level.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.hydraFusion: HydraFusion, a research preview, is listed after Auto as a model of its own. When HydraFusion Max is available, HydraFusion's details offer two tiers, bawaan dan Max, along dengan a Learn more link. Choosing one selects it dan keeps HydraFusion's details buka. HydraFusion stays in the model list dengan that tier as its readout, dan the readout beside HydraFusion in the chat input opens the same details.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.managedDefault: In the model picker, Org bawaan identifies the model your organization sets untuk new chats. It remains on that model when you choose another model untuk this chat; the checkmark identifies your saat ini selection. Auto carries the same label when it is the organization bawaan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.managedOptions: An agen host can make effort level atau context read-only. Its value is announced as dikelola oleh the agen host dan cannot be changed. An overridable bawaan remains selectable. Changing models uses the options available untuk the newly terpilih model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.optimizeFor: Auto's details hold its "Optimize untuk" preference: Efficiency, Balance, atau Intelligence. buka them dari Auto like any model's details, then use arrow keys to move between preferensi dan Enter atau Space to choose one. Choosing a preference selects Auto dan keeps its details buka. When Auto has a discount, it is described below the preferensi. The preference readout beside Auto in the chat input opens the same details.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.otherModelsSection: In the model picker, less common models are grouped under Other Models, which reports whether it is dibentangkan. dengan Other Models focused, press Right Arrow atau Enter to bentangkan it. Press Left Arrow on Other Models atau on any model in it to ciutkan it dan return focus to Other Models.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.pricingDetails: Pricing Details expands in place tanpa moving the model's controls. Expansion dan ciutkan are immediate when reduced motion is diaktifkan. If the details exceed the available space, use Page Up atau Page Down while the model details have focus to scroll.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.providerTabs: In the model picker, use {0} dan {1} to switch to the next atau previous provider tab. When a provider tab is focused, Left dan Right Arrow also switch tabs.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.resetToDefault: In a model's details, use Tab to reach effort level, context, dan model actions. Use arrow keys to move between options, then Enter atau Space to choose one. atur ulang to bawaan appears beside Pin Model when effort level atau context has been changed. It restores both pengaturan to the model's defaults tanpa changing its pinned state. Choosing an option atau mengatur ulang the pengaturan selects that model dan keeps its details buka. Pinning atau unpinning updates the model list tanpa moving its details atau keyboard focus. Back does not urungkan tersimpan pengaturan, but a simpan that finishes after leaving details does not override a newer model selection.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.modelPicker.search: Ketik while the model list is focused to cari across all providers. In the cari field, use Up dan Down Arrow to navigate results, Enter to pilih a model, dan Escape untuk tutup the picker. Left dan Right Arrow move the text cursor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.nestedSubagentActivity: Saat a subagent starts another subagent, its activity row identifies the nested subagent oleh name. Focus that link dengan Tab dan press Enter atau Space to buka the nested subagent's chat to the side. The enclosing pill still opens the parent subagent.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.nextQuestionCarouselQuestion: Saat a chat question is focused, move to the next question{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.openAgentsWindow: buka agen jendela brings an already-buka jendela to the front tanpa changing its aktif atau visible sesi, unless the action explicitly requests a sesi atau New sesi. Revealing New sesi preserves any unsent draft.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.openTerminalFullOutput: Saat retained full keluaran is available untuk a completed command, use the tampilan Full keluaran link below the keluaran preview, atau the buka Full keluaran (Read-Only) action in the command header atau terminal keluaran Accessible tampilan, to buka it in a read-only editor. You can also focus the keluaran region dan press Enter.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.overview: The quick chat tampilan is comprised of an input box dan a request/response list. The input box is used to make requests dan the list is used to display responses.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.participant.localSession.help: Submitting an @ chat peserta dari an agen Host chat starts a Local chat untuk that peserta, preserving your message dan attachments. The original conversation remains available. Your organization may restrict Local chats.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.paste.asText: To tempel the clipboard as plain text, tanpa converting it to Markdown atau storing it as an attachment, invoke tempel as Text{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.permissionLevelPolicy: Saat Assisted permissions atau Allow all is unavailable untuk a sesi, the option remains in the permissions picker as a dinonaktifkan option dengan its reason, such as dinonaktifkan oleh policy when your organization's policy disables it. Its hover also explains the restriction. dinonaktifkan options cannot be terpilih.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.persistentProgress: The chat.experimental.persistentProgress pengaturan defaults to Draw in all versions of VS Code. Experiments can override the bawaan; an explicit pengaturan takes precedence. Choose Draw, Draw (Monochrome), atau Draw (Monochrome, No Icon) to keep a working progress indicator at the bottom until the response finishes. When the response finishes, its toolbar takes the indicator's place. Draw ties dan unravels the VS Code mark dengan fast parabolic ribbon motion dan a brief rest between loops. The No Icon variant hides only the decorative VS Code icon; progress text dan spoken updates are unchanged. The chat.experimental.persistentProgressVerbosity pengaturan defaults to Compact: alat calls preview while berjalan, then ciutkan in place to a single summary row when thinking atau response text resumes, atau the response finishes. Choose Verbose to keep alat chains dibentangkan tanpa a grup header atau an internal scrolling limit. Choose Conversation to ciutkan reasoning dan alat calls together ke one section between response text; the section starts diciutkan, its header names the saat ini alat call, atau the heading of the saat ini reasoning summary (Thinking when the reasoning has no heading), while it runs, dan reports how long it took once it finishes, such as Finished thinking after 5s, atau Finished thinking when the time is unknown. Use Tab to focus a summary dan press Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan its alat calls. Automatic ciutkan waits until keyboard focus leaves the grup. Completed responses still follow chat.agen.collapseCompletedResponses. Except in Conversation, reasoning appears separately as collapsible previews; focus a reasoning header dan press Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Standalone alat keep their decorative icons. terminal activity animations dan subagent pills are unchanged. The indicator reports counts of berjalan subagents dan background commands, including work dimulai in earlier requests, whether the main response is progressing atau idle. Requests untuk your input, approval, plan review, atau authentication take priority over these counts. After 90 seconds tanpa response activity dan dengan no aktif alat, progress tasks, atau known background work, it reports that the response is taking longer than usual. Long-berjalan foreground terminal commands do not trigger this message. Reduced motion disables the ciutkan animation dan the Conversation header's transitions between steps, dan keeps the indicator visible tanpa animation. Spoken progress updates are controlled oleh accessibility.verboseChatProgressUpdates.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.persistentProgressHandoff: While a response is berjalan, automatically menciutkan a reasoning atau alat preview keeps a visible header in place. If the header is above the visible content but its details are visible, it moves below the pinned prompt, atau to the top of the viewport when there is no pinned prompt. Only the space needed untuk the visible viewport is reserved. That space is dihapus when the response finishes atau is dihentikan, after any pending transition dan content rendering finish. membentangkan a preview consumes reserved space as its content grows. Scrolling to the bottom removes the reserved space. Manual collapses do not add padding. The following response content appears after an automatic ciutkan finishes. Reduced motion skips this delay. If keyboard focus keeps a preview buka, new content continues to appear tanpa waiting untuk focus to move.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.persistentProgressSimplifiedTools: dengan Compact persistent progress, a single alat uses its normal rendering, icon, dan details tanpa a grup summary atau automatic grup ciutkan. grup headers summarize up to three activity grup dari agen Host data, prioritizing edits dan commands, tanpa an additional model request. Remaining activity is counted as other steps; this counts alat calls dan visible steps rather than unique berkas atau cari phrases. bentangkan the summary to inspect all calls. Repeated berkas dan cari phrases are counted once in named activity grup. Read summaries count berkas rather than requested lines. Edit summaries tampilkan filenames atau berkas counts, dengan available additions dan deletions in the existing diff badge. Failed, skipped, denied, dan unfinished alat invocations remain explicit, including when folded ke other steps. A completed shell invocation counts as a command even if its process continues in the background; grup headers do not track later process status. grup dengan no recognized activity atau outcome retain a neutral step-count summary. MCP alat use the MCP icon. The working indicator reports when chat is waiting untuk your answers instead of menampilkan a separate question-alat progress row. Question controls remain available, answered questions remain in the response, dan question-alat failures remain visible.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.persistentReasoningTitles: dengan persistent progress, reasoning headers say Thinking while content arrives. When reasoning finishes, a single heading becomes the header dan is dihapus dari the details. Multiple headings remain in the details, dengan a summary in the header when chat.agen.thinking.generateTitles is diaktifkan dan title generation is available. Otherwise, the header says Finished thinking, followed oleh how long it took when that is known.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.planReviewEditor: Saat a plan is ready untuk review, buka it dari the chat response to edit the plan dan add line comments. Use the editor toolbar to navigate, bersihkan, atau submit feedback. Choose an implementation action dari the plan review in Chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.policyInputBlocked: If your organization configures dikelola permissions atau requires sandboxing, membuka an existing Local chat automatically moves its conversation dan draft to Copilot tanpa sending. The original chat is archived only after the new conversation opens dengan its riwayat. If moving fails, the original stays read-only. Use Tab to focus Move to Copilot in the banner, then press Enter atau Space to try again. Archived originals remain available tanpa moving again, dan in remote jendela they still offer Move to Copilot so you can recover chats that an earlier move archived tanpa menyalin their riwayat. Empty chats offer New Copilot Chat instead. When the agen Host cannot import riwayat, nothing moves automatically. Use Tab to focus Continue in Copilot in the banner, then press Enter atau Space to mulai a new Copilot chat dengan the conversation attached as context dan your draft, tanpa sending. The original chat stays available dan is not archived, dan archived chats offer this too.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.previousQuestionCarouselQuestion: Saat a chat question is focused, move to the previous question{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.progressVerbosity: As the chat request is being processed, you will hear verbose progress updates if the request takes more than 4 seconds. This includes information like searched text untuk <cari term> dengan X results, dibuat berkas <file_name>, atau read berkas <berkas path>. This can be dinonaktifkan dengan accessibility.verboseChatProgressUpdates.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.readOnlyThinking: In read-only chats, thinking details preview while streaming dan ciutkan when finished, regardless of your thinking-style pengaturan. Focus a thinking header dan press Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan its details.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.remoteByokNotification: If you have bring your own key (BYOK) models dikonfigurasi dan pilih Copilot on a connected remote host, the first eligible chat input in this editor jendela shows a warning that these models are not supported. The warning does not repeat in other chats in the same jendela. Use Tab to reach Dismiss notification atau Don't tampilkan Again, then Enter atau Space to activate it. Dismiss notification hides the warning until the jendela reloads. Don't tampilkan Again permanently hides this warning untuk your profile, including when new models are added.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.remoteConnections.help: On desktop, Remote Connections is available in the local agen Host chat toolbar atau the agen jendela bilah judul. The preview pengaturan chat.agentHost.remoteConnections selects the connection method. The Remote Connections button opens a menu that offers Off, Dev Tunnels, dan GitHub Environments when available. Use Tab to reach the button in chat atau arrow keys in the bilah judul, Enter atau Space to buka it, Up dan Down Arrow to choose an option, Enter to pilih, dan Escape to tutup dan return focus to the button. memilih a method updates the pengaturan dan enables sharing. memilih Off disables sharing tanpa changing the preferred method. The footer shows the name used to identify this machine on other clients dan whether it is shared atau connecting. Changing the pengaturan directly turns sharing off. The pengaturan chat.agentHost.githubEnvironments.diaktifkan controls GitHub Environments availability. If your organization disables it, the menu explains that you must contact your administrator. dengan GitHub environment terpilih, mengaktifkan sharing registers your local environment untuk remote owner access. Remote work uses the host's OAuth token secara bawaan, controlled oleh chat.agentHost.experimentalMissionControl.useLocalCredentials. Local sesi continue using local IPC.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.remoteConnections.policyHelp: If GitHub Environments is dinonaktifkan oleh your organization, the footer explains the restriction. Press Tab to reach tampilan pengaturan dan Enter to buka the dikelola pengaturan. Shift+Tab returns to the connection options.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.remoteConnections.renameHelp: In the Remote Connections menu, press Tab to reach the name link in the footer, then Enter atau Space to ganti nama the shared environment. The input starts dengan the saat ini name. Enter saves the name ditampilkan on other clients, dan Escape cancels. Shift+Tab returns to the connection options. mengganti nama while Off does not aktifkan sharing.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.renameSession: To ganti nama the saat ini chat sesi when supported, invoke the ganti nama command{0}. agen Host sesi can be diganti nama after sending the first request.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.requestHistory: In the input box, use up dan down arrows to navigate your request riwayat. Edit input dan use enter atau the submit button to jalankan a new request.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.responseImages: To buka an image ditampilkan in a response, use Tab to focus it dan press Enter atau Space. To attach it to your next request, buka its context menu{0} dan choose Add berkas to Chat, atau drag it ke the chat input.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxCertificateCommands: buka the Command Palette{0} dan jalankan Sandbox: kelola Trusted CA untuk the last-focused chat. Use Up dan Down Arrow to choose pasang, Rotate, atau hapus, then Enter to continue atau Escape to batalkan. If there is no agen-host target untuk the last-focused chat, a dialog says No agen host detected.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxCertificateInstall: Use Tab to reach Learn more untuk certificate guidance. When the host supports certificate installation, use Tab to reach the pasang button dan Enter atau Space to activate it. You can also choose pasang in kelola Trusted CA after dismissing the notice. A confirmation names the host. pasang creates dan trusts the certificate, mengganti it if needed. berjalan alat may need to mulai ulang. Progress appears in the notice; failures are ditampilkan in a dialog.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxCertificateMissing: If the agen host reports a missing sandbox certificate that it can pasang, an informational notice appears above the focused chat input. Installation is optional dan chatting is not blocked. Dependency warnings take priority over this notice. Use Tab to reach Dismiss notification dan Enter atau Space to sembunyikan certificate notices untuk that host runtime in this jendela.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxCertificateRemove: Choose hapus in kelola Trusted CA to hapus OS trust. The stored certificate authority is kept. A confirmation explains that alat relying on OS trust may hentikan working. Progress appears in the notice; completion dan failures are ditampilkan in a dialog.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxCertificateRotate: Choose Rotate in kelola Trusted CA to ganti the terpasang sandbox CA dan private key. A confirmation explains that the CA is shared dan berjalan alat may need to mulai ulang. Progress appears in the notice; completion dan failures are ditampilkan in a dialog.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxPathGrant: Saat a sandbox confirmation offers path access, review the granted path dan whether it allows reading atau reading dan writing. A grant may cover a folder rather than only the blocked berkas. The header asks to add access to user sandbox pengaturan dan retry. Allow saves access in your user pengaturan dan retries inside the sandbox. These pengaturan are shared dengan connected agen hosts across ruang kerja dan sesi. Skip declines access. Use Tab to reach these choices.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sandboxUnavailable: If the agen host cannot support the dikonfigurasi sandbox, a notification above the input explains why. You can pilih dan salin the warning text. Use Tab to reach support links atau Dismiss notification, dan Enter to buka a focused link. Dismissing hides the warning untuk this sesi until the jendela reloads, tanpa changing sandboxing atau preventing messages.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.selectionSideChat: pilih text within an assistant response dan buka the context menu dengan Shift+F10 atau the context menu key. Choose Ask in Side Chat... to buka a small Ask Question input. Type a question dan press Enter to buka a side chat dengan conversation context through the terpilih response dan its quoted text. Escape closes the input dan returns focus to the response. Asking requires a writable conversation that supports side chats.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionActivityPills: Subagents dan kustomisasi are available in both the agen jendela dan editor jendela, dan are tersembunyi secara bawaan. aktifkan them dari the sesi status toolbar context menu. Subagents lists the saat ini chat's direct subagents, grouped ke in-progress dan completed chats. Activate an entry to buka its chat to the side. Subagent Options lets you tampilkan all subagents atau only those in progress, remembered across jendela. kustomisasi lists the agen, keahlian, instruksi, kait, prompts, server MCP, dan plugin used oleh the saat ini chat. Activate an entry to reveal it in the kustomisasi editor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionArchiveNudge: An archive suggestion appears above the chat input when the sesi's pull requests are merged. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach Archive, konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup, atau Dismiss Archive Suggestion, then press Enter atau Space. konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup opens the pengaturan untuk automatically archiving inactive merged sesi dan permanently menghapus automatically archived merged sesi. The explanation under What Does "Archive" Do? is diciutkan secara bawaan. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Dismissing the suggestion, including dengan Escape while it is focused, returns to the chat input. Archiving the sesi hides it dari the sesi list so you can focus on your remaining tasks. The sesi is not dihapus. Ask your agen to cari it, atau look in the "Archived" section of the sesi list. You can unarchive it anytime. The worktree dibuat untuk the sesi, if any, will be dihapus. You can recreate it oleh unarchiving the sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionDoneNudge: A mark as done suggestion appears above the chat input when the sesi's pull requests are merged. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach Mark as Done, konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup, atau Dismiss Mark as Done Suggestion, then press Enter atau Space. konfigurasikan Automatic Cleanup opens the pengaturan untuk automatically archiving inactive merged sesi dan permanently menghapus automatically archived merged sesi. The explanation under What Does "Mark as Done" Do? is diciutkan secara bawaan. Use Tab to reach it dan Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. Dismissing the suggestion, including dengan Escape while it is focused, returns to the chat input. Marking the sesi as done hides it dari the sesi list so you can focus on your remaining tasks. The sesi is not dihapus. Ask your agen to cari it, atau look in the "Done" section of the sesi list. You can restore it anytime. The worktree dibuat untuk the sesi, if any, will be dihapus. You can recreate it oleh restoring the sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionPreparation: While a sesi is being prepared, a progress message appears in the transcript. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach tampilkan Log, when available, dan press Enter atau Space to buka the keluaran log. Use hentikan to batalkan preparation. The chat input dan attachment controls are dinonaktifkan until preparation finishes.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionPullRequestChanges: In the Pull Requests pill, buka the dropdown dan use a pull request's buka Pull Request Changes row action to tampilan its changed berkas in a multi-berkas diff editor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionStatusPillCopy: Saat a pill represents a single item, its context menu offers the item's salin actions, such as menyalin its URL atau berkas path. untuk a collection, buka the dropdown dan use the individual row actions instead.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionStatusPills: Saat sesi status pills appear above the input, use Tab to focus the toolbar, then use the left dan right arrow keys to move between pills. Press Enter atau Space to activate a pill. An aggregated pill opens a picker. Use Pin on a picker row to keep that entry as its own pill; it is dihapus dari the picker, dan a sole remaining entry is ditampilkan directly unless it requires a details picker. A pinned pill shows a trailing Unpin button that pointer users can activate to unpin it. Keyboard dan screen reader users can buka the pinned pill's context menu{0} dan choose Unpin. Pin choices are remembered untuk each chat. The context menu also lets you choose which optional pills are visible. Pull Requests Options lets you tampilkan all pull requests atau only buka dan draft ones, remembered across sesi. If every pull request is filtered out, these options are also available in any other pill's context menu atau the toolbar context menu.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionStatusPillsCompact: Saat space is limited, sesi status pills ciutkan to icons one at a time dari right to left. Their full labels remain available to screen readers dan in tooltips. Labels return as space becomes available. If the icons still do not fit, the row scrolls horizontally; use the arrow keys to reach every pill.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet: The working set above the input lists changes across the whole sesi instead of menampilkan a Changes pill. Use Tab atau Shift+Tab to reach its heading dan press Enter atau Space to bentangkan atau ciutkan it. {0} Use Tab to reach the berkas list, Up dan Down Arrow to choose a berkas, dan Enter to buka it in a regular editor at its first edit. Each berkas announces its path dan added dan dihapus line counts.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.contextMenu: Tekan Shift+F10 atau the Context Menu key on the working set heading atau a berkas to buka its context menu. Keep dan urungkan is checked secara bawaan; toggle it to tampilkan atau sembunyikan review controls in both the working set dan buka editor. tampilan All Edits remains available. tampilkan Pill replaces the working set dengan the Changes pill oleh turning off chat.editor.workingSet.diaktifkan. The Changes pill's context menu offers tampilkan Working Set untuk restore it.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.fileActions: To keep atau urungkan the sesi's changes to the chosen berkas, atau buka them in a diff editor, press Tab to reach its Keep button, Left dan Right Arrow to move between Keep, urungkan, dan buka Changes in Diff editor, dan Enter atau Space to activate one. Keep removes berkas dari the working set until the sesi changes them again, as does staging atau committing them dengan Git. urungkan reverts the sesi's changes after any confirmation the sesi asks untuk, dan deletes a berkas the sesi dibuat. urungkan is available only when the sesi supports it, dan is unavailable while a request is berjalan. The accessibility.signals.editsKept dan accessibility.signals.editsUndone pengaturan control the signals played when changes are kept atau undone.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.fileKeep: To keep the sesi's changes to the chosen berkas, atau buka them in a diff editor, press Tab to reach its Keep button, Left dan Right Arrow to move between Keep dan buka Changes in Diff editor, dan Enter atau Space to activate one. Keep removes berkas dari the working set until the sesi changes them again, as does staging atau committing them dengan Git. The accessibility.signals.editsKept pengaturan controls the signal played when changes are kept.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.fileView: To inspect the chosen berkas's changes, press Tab to reach buka Changes in Diff editor, then Enter atau Space.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.headingKeep: The Keep dan tampilan All Edits buttons after the heading keep the changes to every berkas in the working set, atau buka all of them in a diff editor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.headingKeepUndo: The Keep, urungkan, dan tampilan All Edits buttons after the heading keep atau urungkan the changes to every berkas in the working set, atau buka all of them in a diff editor. urungkan in the heading asks untuk confirmation.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.sessionWorkingSet.headingView: The tampilan All Edits button after the heading opens all changed berkas in a diff editor. Keep dan urungkan are tersembunyi in both the working set dan the editor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.showHiddenTerminals: If there are any tersembunyi chat terminals, you can tampilan them oleh invoking the tampilan tersembunyi Chat Terminals command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.signals: Accessibility Signals can be changed via pengaturan dengan a prefix of signals.chat. secara bawaan, if a request takes more than 4 seconds, you will hear a sound indicating that progress is still occurring.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.speechToText.contextMenu: To choose a microphone atau turn off dictation atau Voice Mode, focus the microphone button in the input toolbar dan buka its context menu{0} (untuk example Shift+F10).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.stickyPromptHeader: The prompt you have scrolled past is pinned to the top of the transcript. Activate its title to jump back to that prompt.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.subagentPill: Saat a subagent pill appears in a response, use Tab to focus it dan press Enter atau Space to buka that subagent chat to the side.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.subagentPills: Subagents appear as pills in the response. Use Tab to focus a subagent pill, then Enter atau Space to buka its chat to the side. If the subagent has no separate chat, Enter atau Space expands atau collapses its inline details instead. The pill announces its berjalan state, model pengaturan, dan any pending confirmations. berkas dan markdown links in its activity row can be focused dengan Tab dan dibuka independently dengan Enter.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.systemNotificationDisclosure: Some sesi status messages have additional details. Use Tab to focus the status message dan press Enter atau Space to tampilkan atau sembunyikan its details.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.terminalOutputReflow: terminal keluaran reflows to fit the chat width secara bawaan. Set {0} to false to keep fixed-width previews dengan horizontal scrolling. This only changes the preview, not the terminal berjalan the command.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.toolFailureIcon: Failed alat calls use an error icon in place of their normal alat icon. Their content dan available actions stay the same. The Accessible tampilan includes the failure reason atau terminal exit code when available.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceInputMode.agentProgress: Saat the experimental agen.voice.agentProgress pengaturan is diaktifkan, Voice Mode agen requests may speak brief progress updates while investigating, planning, editing, validating, atau recovering dari a problem.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceInputMode.holdToTalk: In manual Voice Mode, the mulai atau hentikan Listening button toggles listening when tapped, atau you can press dan hold it to talk dan release to send. You can also hold the Voice Mode: Hold to Talk keybinding{0} to talk dan release to send; this interrupts the assistant to barge in.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceInputMode.segmented: Saat the segmented voice input control is diaktifkan, the input toolbar offers Dictation dan Voice Mode. A connected hands-free sesi also offers Mute atau Unmute Microphone; manual Voice Mode instead offers mulai atau hentikan Listening, where menghentikan sends the completed turn. Each button can be focused dan activated dengan Enter atau Space.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceMode.byokAnswers: In OpenAI BYOK Voice Mode, say approve, approved, accept, accepted, allow, yes, I approve, atau I accept to approve the saat ini prompt, dan reject, deny, atau no to reject it. These approval commands must be complete, unqualified English replies. untuk questions, say an exact displayed choice atau its number; untuk multiple selections, separate choices dengan commas atau dan. Answer text questions directly. To give a custom answer to a selection question that permits it, say other followed oleh your answer. Forms collect one answer at a time dan submit when complete. Say skip only when the form permits skipping. Ambiguous replies ask untuk clarification tanpa approving anything atau sending a new chat request.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceMode.byokSession: Saat using dikonfigurasi OpenAI BYOK Voice Mode, only the bound chat input's prompts dan responses are read. Voice Mode belongs to the input where you mulai it, including chat editor tabs dan the chat sidebar. Switching the bound input atau membuang a recording stops Voice Mode to prevent buffered audio dari acting on another sesi. mulai Voice Mode again in the intended input; membuat the sesi dari the same draft does not require a mulai ulang.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceMode.introduction: The first time Voice Mode starts, an introduction appears above the input box. Tab to reach it, then use the arrow keys to move between the available voices; Enter atau Space plays a voice dan keeps it untuk future conversations. Its description also contains two links: pengaturan, which opens the Voice Mode pengaturan, dan How It Responds, which opens a berkas untuk customizing what the agen says back. Voice Mode stays connected but does not listen while the introduction is buka. Press Escape, atau activate the tutup button, to dismiss it dan return to the input box.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceMode.questionSequence: untuk forms dengan multiple questions, Voice Mode identifies the saat ini question oleh number. Answer only that question, then wait untuk the next one. Each spoken reply fills one field, not several fields.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceMode.sessionAwareness: Saat agen.voice.sessionAwareness is diaktifkan, OpenAI BYOK Voice Mode receives a bounded sesi briefing dan the aktif chat's terkini conversation. You can ask where you left off, what just happened, atau which tracked sesi needs input tanpa memulai a coding request. The briefing may not include every sesi. Coding work dan replies to approvals still use the bound chat input. nonaktifkan the pengaturan dan reconnect Voice Mode to restore input-only context.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.voiceMode.steering: Saat Voice Mode sends a new request while the coding agen is working, it is sent as steering rather than queued untuk after the saat ini task. Voice-only exchanges during ongoing work are not retained as context untuk later requests. Answers to pending questions dan approvals continue to respond to those prompts.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.vscodePet: Ketik /vscode-pet to tampilkan atau sembunyikan Blobby, the VS Code pet, above the input. One pet appears in whichever editor atau agen jendela is aktif. Drag it around the chat dengan the mouse dan release it to drop it, atau flick it in any direction to throw it along the gesture before gravity pulls it down. Pointer collisions are ignored untuk half a second after a drag release. After that, while the pet is falling, move the pointer ke it to bounce it upward; pointer movement dan where it catches the pet affect the bounce. Sideways dan upward travel do not mulai the bounce counter. A counter beside the pet tracks consecutive bounces dan remains untuk up to five seconds after landing, atau until the pet next reacts atau interacts. Landing dengan at least twenty bounces triggers confetti unless reduced motion is diaktifkan. If it falls past the input, a despawn effect appears at the bottom dan a respawn effect appears at the top before it automatically returns to the input. Moving the pointer rapidly between the pet’s left dan right sides makes it dizzy. dengan the keyboard, use Tab to focus the pet, then the left dan right arrows to make it hop along the input until it reaches an edge. Hold Shift dengan the left atau right arrow to throw it toward a wall; while it is airborne, press Enter atau Space to bounce it upward. Rapidly alternate the unmodified arrows to make it dizzy. Press Enter atau Space while it is resting to interact dengan it. When an achievement unlocks, the pet shows a gold star untuk ten seconds; activate the pet during that time to buka Achievements. buka its context menu{0} (untuk example Shift+F10), use the up dan down arrow keys to choose Achievements, Go on the jalankan, Come Back, Grow, Shrink, atur ulang Size, atau Change Color, dan press Enter untuk activate the choice. Grow dan Shrink change its size in twenty-percent steps, while atur ulang Size restores its bawaan size. The pet position, size, dan color are shared across chats dan jendela dan remembered after you mulai ulang.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chat.vscodePetPainting: While an image-generation alat is berjalan, Blobby paints at a small easel, then returns to its normal activity. Reduced motion shows a still painting pose.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.acceptTool: To accept a alat action, use the Accept alat Confirmation command{0}. When the confirmation carousel is ditampilkan, this activates the primary button of the terpilih confirmation. dinonaktifkan actions cannot be accepted.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.autoApprove: To automatically approve alat actions tanpa manual confirmation, set {0} to {1} in your pengaturan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.focusTodosView: To toggle focus between the agen TODOs tampilan dan the chat input, use agen TODOs: Toggle Focus{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.openEditedFilesSetting: secara bawaan, when edits are made to berkas, they will be dibuka. To change this behavior, set accessibility.openChatEditedFiles to false in your pengaturan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.overview: The chat agen tampilan is used to terapkan edits across berkas in your ruang kerja, aktifkan berjalan commands in the terminal, dan more.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.runCommand: To take the action, use the accept alat command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.sectionProgress: Finished thinking dan alat-call sections hentikan menampilkan activity. The Working indicator is omitted when subagent pills are the last visible content; it appears after other content while the response remains in progress.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatAgent.userActionRequired: An alert will indicate when user action is required. untuk example, if the agen wants to jalankan something in the terminal, you will hear Action Required: jalankan Command in terminal.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.acceptHunk: In the editor, Keep{0}, Undo{1}, atau Toggle the Diff{2} untuk the saat ini Change.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.expectation: Saat a request is made, a progress indicator will play while the edits are being diterapkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.format: It is comprised of an input box dan a berkas working set (Shift+Tab).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.overview: The chat editing tampilan is used to terapkan edits across berkas.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.review: Once the edits are diterapkan, a sound will play to indicate the document has been dibuka dan is ready untuk review. The sound can be dinonaktifkan dengan accessibility.signals.chatEditModifiedFile.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.sections: Navigate between edits in the editor dengan navigate previous{0} dan next{1}
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.chatEditing.undoKeepSounds: Sounds will play when a change is accepted atau undone. The sounds can be dinonaktifkan dengan accessibility.signals.editsKept dan accessibility.signals.editsUndone.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.access: It can be activated via code actions atau directly using the command: Inline Chat: mulai Inline Chat{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.contextActions: Context menu actions may jalankan a request prefixed dengan a /. Type / to discover such ready-made commands.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.diff: Once in the diff editor, enter review mode with{0}. Use up dan down arrows to navigate lines dengan the proposed changes.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.fix: If a fix action is invoked, a response will indicate the problem dengan the saat ini code. A diff editor will be rendered dan can be reached oleh tabbing.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.inspectResponse: In the input box, inspect the response in the accessible view{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.overview: Inline chat occurs within a code editor dan takes ke account the saat ini selection. It is useful untuk making changes to the saat ini editor. untuk example, fixing diagnostics, documenting atau merefaktor code. Keep in mind that AI generated code may be incorrect.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.requestHistory: In the input box, use tampilkan Previous{0} dan tampilkan Next{1} to navigate your request riwayat. Edit input dan use enter atau the submit button to jalankan a new request.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.inlineChat.toolbar: Use tab to reach conditional parts like commands, status, message responses dan more.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.sessions.requestOrigin: Some requests include a source chat button above the message. Use Tab to focus it, then Enter atau Space to buka the originating chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.sessions.selectionSideChat: Saat you pilih text within an assistant response, an Ask Question input atau terpilih text actions appear near the selection. Choose Ask in a Side Chat if a menu appears. Type a question dan press Enter to mulai a new side chat scoped to that selection. Escape closes the input dan returns focus to the response.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.sessions.threadCoordinationResult: Completed buat-sesi, buat-chat, dan send-message operations can include a target sesi atau chat button in the response. Use Tab to focus it, Enter atau Space to buka it normally, atau Alt+Enter (Option+Enter on macOS) to buka it to the side.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.announceConfirmati: To focus pending chat confirmation dialogs, invoke the Focus Chat Confirmation Status command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.cancelSpeechToText: While dictating, invoke the batalkan Dictation command{0} to hentikan dan buang the dictated text.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.focus: To focus the chat request dan response list, invoke the Focus Chat command{0}. This will move focus to the most terkini response, which you can then navigate using the up dan down arrow keys.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.focusAgentSessions: You can focus the agen sesi list oleh invoking the Focus agen sesi command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.focusInput: To focus the input box untuk chat requests, invoke the Focus Chat Input command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.focusLastFocusedIt: To return to the last chat response you focused, invoke the Focus Last Focused Chat Response command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.newChat: To buat a new chat sesi, invoke the New Chat command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.nextCodeBlock: To focus the next code block within a response, invoke the Chat: Next Code Block command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.nextUserPrompt: To navigate to the next user prompt in the conversation, invoke the Next User Prompt command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.openAgentHostFolde: Saat memulai an agen sesi in a multi-root ruang kerja, you can choose which root folder it runs in oleh invoking the folder command{0}, then memilih a folder dari the list.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.previousUserPrompt: To navigate to the previous user prompt in the conversation, invoke the Previous User Prompt command{0}.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.chat.toggleSpeechToText: To dictate your request ke the input box, invoke the Dictate command{0}. Invoke it again to hentikan; recording mulai dan hentikan are indicated oleh accessibility signals.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/action.workbench.action.openAgentsWindow: To buka the agen jendela, invoke the buka agen jendela command{0}. The bawaan keybinding is diaktifkan after you buat your first sesi in the agen jendela. In screen reader mode, this keybinding includes Alt to avoid conflicts dengan screen reader shortcuts.
