vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentS.agentHostModePicker.accessibilityHelp: Saat the experimental combined picker is diaktifkan untuk a Copilot agen Host sesi atau a new Cloud sesi, Tab reaches separate Mode dan Permissions buttons. Press Enter atau Space on Mode to buka the picker dengan agen Mode dibentangkan, atau on Permissions to buka it dengan Permissions dibentangkan. Each section header shows its saat ini selection, dan the dibuka section initially focuses that selection. Press Enter atau Space on a section header to bentangkan atau ciutkan it, atau use Right Arrow to bentangkan dan Left Arrow to ciutkan. Hover atau keyboard navigation moves the single row highlight tanpa changing the selection until you activate a choice. Focus the Permissions header dan press Tab to reach konfigurasikan Permissions, which opens the related pengaturan. Use Up dan Down Arrow to navigate dan Enter to pilih a mode, permission level, atau terminal sandboxing. Assisted permissions is experimental dan evaluates risk before berjalan alat. When Assisted permissions atau Allow all is unavailable untuk a sesi, the option remains visible but cannot be terpilih, dengan a reason such as dinonaktifkan oleh policy. Its hover also explains the restriction. When the sesi's host requires terminal sandboxing, its sandbox toggle is checked dan dinonaktifkan. If your organization permits bypassing, a supported outside-sandbox permission prompt can offer Allow in this sesi. After that action succeeds, you can use the toggle to aktifkan sandboxing again. This restriction applies only to that sesi. Cloud draft choices are locked while the first request starts the sesi. Escape closes the picker dan returns focus to the button that dibuka it.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.create: Add kustomisasi starts the same creation flows as each management section. untuk agen, keahlian, instruksi, dan prompts, choose a ruang kerja atau user location, Generate dengan AI when available, atau an action provided oleh the terpilih agen. vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.descriptionL: The kustomisasi type links below the heading buka their respective management sections.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.getStarted: In an item's details, choose a prompt under Get dimulai to pasang the item dan buka that prompt in a new Copilot sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.install: Review an available item's source, then choose pasang. untuk connectors, choose Connect, Reconnect, atau Disconnect to kelola the connection. When the terpilih agen provides SDK installation management, its inventory is authoritative dan its exact review is ditampilkan before installation atau removal. Copilot SDK cari omits candidates that the runtime does not mark installable. memasang a public Browse result through Copilot prompts untuk GitHub sign-in first when needed. Repair asks the owning SDK atau local implementation to recover missing content. terpasang marketplace items provide an copot action. server MCP that require unsupported local prerequisites provide tampilan Setup to buka the publisher's instruksi instead. VS Code continues to terapkan destination, trust, policy, dan compatibility checks.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.links: Available kustomisasi names no longer buka external resources. buka an item's details to review its metadata, then use the explicitly labeled resource atau repository actions untuk external navigation. Back atau Escape returns to Browse dan restores focus.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.navigation: Use Tab dan Shift+Tab between controls. In cari results, use the arrow keys, Home, dan End to navigate the list. Press Enter atau Space on an available item to buka its in-product details. Press Enter to buka an terpasang item.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.overview: Browse kustomisasi searches terpasang agen, keahlian, instruksi, prompts, kait, server MCP, dan plugin, dan can browse available marketplace items.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.paging: Scrolling near the end of cari results loads another page tanpa menghapus loaded items. Retry repeats a failed marketplace request.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.ranking: Available cari results are ordered oleh source-assigned relevance, not trust atau quality. Curated Browse sections preserve their tersimpan editorial order. When curated sections are unavailable, Browse uses source priority dan catalog order.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.search: Type words atau use @terpasang, @type:keahlian, @type:mcp, @type:plugin, dan @type:kanvas. kanvas ekstensi results use explicit compatibility metadata dari the marketplace. The cari filter menu updates the same query dan filters can be combined.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.sourceFailur: Unavailable sources tampilkan a warning notification dengan a Retry action. Scrolling continues healthy sources. Retrying a source reloads all sources dari the first page to restore relevance order.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCust.customizationDiscovery.help.sourceRecove: Sources that need the same GitHub account share one Sign In action instead of menampilkan duplikasikan prompts. Sign-in starts only when you choose it; cancelling keeps the other results available. Additional Connector permission is requested only when you explicitly connect, reconnect, disconnect, atau check a connection.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.autoApprove3.description:
Global auto approve also known as "YOLO mode" disables manual approval completely untuk all alat in all ruang kerja, allowing the agen to act fully autonomously. This is extremely dangerous dan is *never* recommended, even containerized environments like Codespaces dan Dev Containers have user keys forwarded ke the container that could be compromised.

This feature disables critical security protections dan makes it much easier untuk an attacker to compromise the machine.

Note: This pengaturan only controls alat approval dan does not prevent the agen dari asking questions. To automatically answer agen questions, use the `#chat.autoReply#` pengaturan.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agent.thinking.terminalTools: Saat diaktifkan, terminal alat calls are displayed inside the thinking dropdown dengan a simplified tampilan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agent.thinkingMode.collapsed: Thinking parts will be diciutkan secara bawaan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agent.thinkingMode.collapsedPreview: Thinking parts will be dibentangkan first, then ciutkan once we reach a part that is not thinking.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agent.thinkingMode.fixedScrolling: tampilkan thinking in a fixed-height streaming panel that auto-scrolls; click header to bentangkan to full height.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agent.thinkingStyle: Mengontrol bagaimana thinking is rendered. Read-only chats always use the diciutkan preview style.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.agentDebugLog.enabled: Aktifkan agen debug logging untuk agen host sesi: surface their debug events in the agen debug panel. Takes effect immediately; only sesi that jalankan while this is diaktifkan are captured.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.agentDebugLog.maxEventsIn: Maximum number of debug events kept in memory per agen host sesi untuk the agen debug panel. Older events beyond this limit are dropped dari the in-memory buffer, which also lowers the totals (such as token usage) ditampilkan in the panel overview.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.allowSignedOutWhenUsable: Saat diaktifkan, agen Host sesi remain available while signed out. The agen jendela opens tanpa forcing GitHub sign-in, dan editor chat lets you pilih the Copilot harness. agen usable tanpa GitHub (untuk example Codex dengan ChatGPT authentication atau Claude in native mode dengan your own Anthropic credentials) work while signed out; agen that require GitHub prompt you to add a model atau sign in. When dinonaktifkan (the bawaan), GitHub sign-in is required before the agen jendela opens.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilot.executionSubagent: Saat diaktifkan, local Copilot agen Host sesi opt ke the Copilot runtime's execution subagent. The runtime's experiment assignments may override this bawaan. When the runtime implementation is available, the ekstensi-native execution alat is excluded dari that sesi. This is independent of `#github.copilot.chat.executionSubagent.enabled#`, which controls the ekstensi-native implementation. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot runtime after aktif turns finish.

bawaan model ID untuk the Copilot runtime's execution subagent. Empty inherits the parent sesi model. The runtime's experiment assignments may override this bawaan. This does not affect the ekstensi-native execution subagent's model. An unavailable model disables the runtime execution subagent. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot runtime after aktif turns finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilot.modelCapabilityOv: Per-model overrides untuk Copilot agen Host sesi. Use `*` to match every model. Supports model family, reasoning effort, alat filters, model capabilities, dan YAML prompt overrides.

Saat set, only matching alat are available to sesi on this model. Patterns: bare alat names, `builtin:*` atau `builtin:<name>` (Copilot runtime alat), `mcp:*` atau `mcp:<name>` (server MCP alat), dan `custom:*` atau `custom:<name>` (every alat VS Code registers dengan the SDK, including the agen host's own terminal alat); a bare `*` expands to all three sources.

alat dinonaktifkan untuk sesi on this model; same pattern syntax as `availableTools` dan takes precedence over it. Note that `custom:*` dan a bare `*` also nonaktifkan the agen host's own terminal alat registered dengan the SDK.
Route the model to another family's tuned system prompt dan alat profile (e.g. `claude-opus-4.8`). The model id sent to the runtime is unaffected, so the sesi still runs on the terpilih model.

Per-property model capability overrides passed through to the Copilot SDK's `modelCapabilities` sesi field (e.g. `{ "supports": { "vision": false }, "limits": { "max_context_window_tokens": 64000 } }`), deep-merged over the runtime's resolved defaults untuk this model. diterapkan when the sesi launches atau resumes.
Path to a YAML berkas containing `systemPrompt` dan/atau `toolDescriptions` overrides. Ignored when `promptOverrideString` is dikonfigurasi.
Inline YAML containing `systemPrompt` dan/atau `toolDescriptions` overrides. Takes precedence over `promptOverrideFile`. A system prompt replaces all agen Host dan SDK prompt sections dan guardrails.
Reasoning effort untuk sesi on this model, overriding the model picker's effort level. Use the `*` entry to set it untuk every model. Unrecognized values are ignored.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilot.runtimePath: Absolute path to a local `copilot-runtime` executable. The bundled Copilot SDK wrapper remains in use. Empty uses the bundled runtime. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot SDK client after aktif turns finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilot.toolSearch.deferT: Minimum number of alat before MCP dan external alat are deferred behind alat cari. Set to 0 to always defer external alat. Only effective when alat cari is diaktifkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilot.toolSearch.enable: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot SDK sesi defer MCP dan non-core VS Code alat behind a alat-cari alat so the model discovers them on demand instead of loading every alat definition up front.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilotSdk.logLevel: Mengontrol log level untuk the Copilot SDK runtime used oleh the local agen host. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot SDK client; aktif sesi are dimuat ulang when next used.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilotSdk.logLevel.info: Log informational messages. berjalan VS Code dengan trace logging still enables all Copilot SDK runtime diagnostics.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.copilotSdk.logLevel.trace: Log all Copilot SDK runtime diagnostics.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.customTerminalTool.enable: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot SDK sesi use the agen Host terminal alat override instead of the SDK's bawaan terminal behavior. Not supported on jendela, where sesi use the SDK's terminal dan sandbox runtime.
Aktifkan the agen Host custom terminal alat override untuk Copilot SDK sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.debugLogs.defaultExportLo: The bawaan folder untuk archives dan folder dibuat oleh the Developer: Export agen Host Debug Logs command. When empty atau unavailable, the bawaan berkas-dialog location is used.
The bawaan agen Host debug-log export location must be an absolute path (untuk example, C:\\myFolder atau /myFolder).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.opus48Prompt.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot SDK sesi berjalan a Claude Opus 4.8 model terapkan Opus 4.8-tuned system-prompt section overrides on top of the bawaan system message.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentHost.shellTool.initScript.enab: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot SDK sesi load your shell profile (`~/.bashrc` on macOS dan Linux, PowerShell profiles on jendela) dan activate the Python environment terpilih untuk the ruang kerja before each shell command. Python activation requires the Python Environments ekstensi dengan `#python-envs.terminal.autoActivationType#` set to `shellStartup`. Local jendela only.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentLocations.invalidPath: Paths must be relative atau mulai dengan '~/'. Absolute paths dan '\' separators are not supported.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agents.config.locations.description:
Specify location(s) of custom agen berkas (`*__TOK_0__`). [Learn More](__TOK_1__).

Relative paths are resolved dari the root folder(s) of your ruang kerja.

Locations dikonfigurasi here are only observed oleh the Local agen harness. Other harnesses berjalan in VS Code receive agen dari all additional locations dikonfigurasi here, in addition to their built-in locations. To use agen dengan independent agen harnesses, such as Copilot CLI, review the {2} in the agen kustomisasi editor to migrate them to supported locations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agents.config.locations.title: agen berkas Locations
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsControl.badge: Shows the agen status as a badge next to the command center.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsControl.compact: Replaces the command center cari box dengan a compact agen status indicator dan unified chat widget.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsControl.enabled: Mengontrol bagaimana the 'agen Status' indicator appears in the bilah judul command center. When set to `hidden`, the indicator is not ditampilkan. Other values tampilkan the indicator dan automatically aktifkan {0}. The unread dan in-progress sesi indicators require {1} to be diaktifkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsControl.hidden: The agen status indicator is tersembunyi dari the bilah judul.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessionProjection.enabled: Mengontrol apakah agen sesi Projection mode is diaktifkan untuk reviewing agen sesi in a focused ruang kerja.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessions.migrateLegacyCopilotC:
Mengontrol apakah legacy ekstensi host Copilot CLI chat sesi are migrated in place to the agen host when dibuka, so their riwayat becomes editable. When dinonaktifkan, legacy sesi buka as before.

Changing this pengaturan requires a mulai ulang to take effect.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessions.showExternal: Mengontrol which external agen sesi are ditampilkan. External sesi are sesi that were dibuat in a different application dan have not received a message dari this application yet.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessions.showExternal.last24Ho: tampilkan external sesi diperbarui in the last 24 hours.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessions.showExternal.last30Da: tampilkan external sesi diperbarui in the last 30 days.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessions.showExternal.last7Day: tampilkan external sesi diperbarui in the last 7 days.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSessions.showExternal.recent: tampilkan up to the 2 most terkini external sesi diperbarui in the last 7 days. At startup, external sesi older than the second-most-recently diperbarui local sesi are tersembunyi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsHandoffTip.mode: Mengontrol tip ditampilkan above the chat input offering to continue eligible agen sesi in the agen jendela.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsHandoffTip.mode.custom: tampilkan the handoff tip dengan an alternate description.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentsHandoffTip.mode.default: tampilkan the handoff tip dengan the bawaan description.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSkillsLocations.description:
Specify location(s) of agen keahlian (`__TOK_0__`) that can be used in Chat sesi. [Learn More](__TOK_1__).

Each path should contain keahlian subfolders dengan keahlian.md berkas (e.g., add `my-skills` if you have `my-skills/skillA/SKILL.md`). Relative paths are resolved dari the root folder(s) of your ruang kerja.

Locations dikonfigurasi here are only observed oleh the Local agen harness. Other harnesses berjalan in VS Code receive keahlian dari all additional locations dikonfigurasi here, in addition to their built-in locations. To use keahlian dengan independent agen harnesses, such as Copilot CLI, review the {2} in the agen kustomisasi editor to migrate them to supported locations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSkillsLocations.invalidPath: Paths must be relative atau mulai dengan '~/'. Absolute paths dan '\' separators are not supported.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.agentSkillsLocations.title: agen keahlian Locations
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.allowAnonymousAccess: Mengontrol apakah anonymous access is allowed in chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.approvedAccountOrganizations: Daftar GitHub organization logins whose members are permitted to use AI features. When set to a non-empty list, AI features are dinonaktifkan until the user signs ke a GitHub account that belongs to one of the specified organizations dan account-level policy data has been resolved. Set to '*' to allow any authenticated GitHub atau GitHub Enterprise account.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.approvedAccountOrganizations.policy: pengaturan this policy to a non-empty list activates the Approved Account gate: all AI features are dinonaktifkan until the user signs ke a GitHub account whose organizations intersect this list dan the account-side policy data has resolved. Comparison is case-insensitive. Use '*' as a wildcard to accept any signed-in GitHub atau GHE account (use this untuk GHE deployments where the organization list is not surfaced).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.enabled: Mengontrol apakah the artifacts tampilan is available in chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byFilePath: Rules untuk extracting artifacts dari written berkas oleh berkas path pattern. Maps glob patterns to grup configuration.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byFilePath.groupNam: Display name untuk the artifact grup.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byFilePath.onlyShow: Saat true, tampilkan only the grup header instead of individual items.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byMemoryFilePath: Rules untuk extracting artifacts dari memory alat calls oleh memory berkas path pattern. Maps glob patterns to grup configuration.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byMemoryFilePath.gr: Display name untuk the artifact grup.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byMemoryFilePath.on: Saat true, tampilkan only the grup header instead of individual items.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.byMimeType: Rules untuk extracting artifacts dari alat results oleh MIME type. Maps MIME type patterns (e.g. 'image/*') to grup configuration.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.groupName: Display name untuk the artifact grup.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.artifacts.rules.onlyShowGroup: Saat true, tampilkan only the grup header instead of individual items.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.autopilot.advanced.enabled: Mengaktifkan **Advanced Autopilot**, a single switch that turns on all advanced Autopilot behaviors that delegate more of the loop to the agen. Currently, after each Autopilot turn a small, fast model evaluates whether your original request is complete; if not, Autopilot keeps working using that evaluation as guidance untuk the next turn, instead of relying on the agen to signal completion itself.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.autoReply.description: Automatically skip question carousels oleh telling the agen that the user is not available dan to use its best judgment. This is an advanced pengaturan dan can lead to unintended choices atau actions based on incomplete context.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.btwTip.enabled: Mengontrol apakah the agen jendela shows a tip about using `/btw` to ask side questions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.byokUtilityModelDefault.copilot.des: Use the bawaan GitHub Copilot utility models.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.byokUtilityModelDefault.description: Mengontrol bawaan model used oleh built-in utility flows when the terpilih main agen model is a bring your own key (BYOK) model. This pengaturan has no effect when the terpilih main agen model is provided oleh GitHub Copilot. A specific model dikonfigurasi in {0} atau {1} takes precedence.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.byokUtilityModelDefault.mainAgent.d: Use the terpilih BYOK main agen model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.byokUtilityModelDefault.none.descri: Do not use a bawaan utility model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.byokUtilityModelDefault.none.label: Tidak Ada
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.checkpoints.enabled: Mengaktifkan checkpoints in chat. Checkpoints allow you to restore the chat to a previous state.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.checkpoints.showFileChanges: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan chat checkpoint berkas changes.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.closedPromoNotification: Mengontrol apakah a live model promo is ditampilkan on the Copilot icon when Chat is ditutup. When explicitly set, this overrides the experiment tanpa an experiment lookup. Otherwise, eligible promos use the experiment treatment.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.closedPromoNotification.copilotIcon: tampilkan a promo tooltip when hovering atau clicking the Copilot status icon while Chat is ditutup. Viewing the offer clears its indicator; the offer remains available untuk the saat ini jendela sesi. Choosing Try dismisses the offer dan its chat banner.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.closedPromoNotification.none.descri: Do not tampilkan a promo on the Copilot icon when Chat is ditutup.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.closedPromoNotification.none.label: Tidak Ada
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.codeBlock.showProgressAnimation.des: Saat menerapkan edits, tampilkan a progress animation in the code block pill. If dinonaktifkan, shows the progress percentage instead.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.contextUsage.enabled: tampilkan the context jendela usage indicator in the chat input.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.autoModeTierOverride: Override Auto's "Optimize untuk" preference untuk evals dan debugging. Accepts `efficiency`, `balance`, atau `intelligence` in both Copilot Chat dan Copilot SDK sesi; `fast` is ekstensi-only. Set to `null` to bersihkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.claudeAdvisor.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot agen Host sesi using a supported Claude model can call the provider-native Advisor alat. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot SDK client after aktif turns finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.exploreAgent.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, local Copilot agen Host sesi can use the runtime's built-in Explore agen, independently of `#chat.copilot.searchSubagent.enabled#`. Applies to sesi when they launch atau resume. Does not nonaktifkan custom agen named Explore.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.hydraFusion.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, makes the HydraFusion model available to local Copilot agen Host sesi. Changing this pengaturan restarts the local Copilot runtime.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.hydraFusion.enabled.multiRo: Make HydraFusion v2 available dan ask the service to keep reusing the previous turn's root model when it fits the next turn's workflow, which improves prompt cache reuse. Also applies to HydraFusion tiers that Auto offers.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.hydraFusion.enabled.v2: Make HydraFusion v2 available, which plans dengan per-step reasoning effort dan a wider set of models.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.localModel.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, offers on-device models to download dan jalankan on this device dengan llama.cpp. Offered only on devices dengan a GPU that has about {0} GB of memory atau more. Changing this pengaturan restarts the local Copilot runtime after aktif turns finish. {1}
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.localModel.llamaServerPath: Absolute path to a `llama-server` executable untuk on-device models. VS Code doesn't pasang llama.cpp: pasang a build that supports your model, then set this to its `llama-server`.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.localModel.useInAuto: Saat diaktifkan, Auto can route turns to the aktif on-device model, dengan cloud fallback. Takes effect immediately. {0}
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.memory.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, local Copilot agen Host sesi can store dan recall [Copilot Memory](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/copilot-memory). Your [Copilot Memory settings on GitHub](https://github.com/settings/copilot/memory) dan organization policies still terapkan. Applies to sesi dibuat atau resumed after the pengaturan changes.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.memory.local.enabled: Saat diaktifkan together dengan {0}, local Copilot agen Host sesi store Copilot Memory in the repository's `.github/copilot-memories.jsonl` berkas instead of GitHub's cloud memory service. The berkas is part of the working tree, so commits made oleh the agen atau the agen jendela can include it. Requires a GitHub-hosted repository. **Note:** your Copilot Memory pengaturan dan organization policies on GitHub don't terapkan, dan user-scoped memories are unavailable. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot SDK client after aktif turns finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.searchSubagent.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, local Copilot agen Host sesi are offered the Copilot runtime's cari subagent alat untuk codebase cari. Applies to sesi when they launch atau resume.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.searchSubagent.model: CAPI model ID to use untuk the cari subagent in local Copilot agen Host sesi when `#chat.copilot.searchSubagent.enabled#` is diaktifkan. Empty uses the runtime bawaan. An unavailable model makes the cari alat unavailable. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot SDK client after aktif turns finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.skillCharBudget: Maximum number of characters available untuk keahlian descriptions in the Copilot SDK system message.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.stabilityOrderedPrompt.enab: Saat diaktifkan, Copilot SDK sesi order the system prompt oleh how often each section changes, so sesi dengan the same alat dan ruang kerja can reuse each other's prompt cache. This moves per-sesi sections, such as the environment dan sesi folder, to the end of the system prompt. Applies to new dan resumed sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilot.tgrep.enabled: Saat diaktifkan, local Copilot agen Host sesi use tgrep indexed cari untuk eligible large repositories. Requires a local Git repository on a non-virtual filesystem. Changing this pengaturan restarts the Copilot SDK client after aktif turns finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilotCliCommand.enabled: Mengontrol apakah integrated terminals include the `copilot` command that ships dengan VS Code. The command runs GitHub Copilot CLI dan offers to pasang it when it's missing. A GitHub Copilot CLI that you terpasang yourself isn't affected.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.copilotCliCommand.enabled.policy: Mengontrol apakah VS Code provides the copilot command untuk GitHub Copilot CLI. When dinonaktifkan, VS Code setup on jendela dan the Linux DEB dan RPM packages don't add the command to PATH dan hapus the entry they added, VS Code doesn't pasang GitHub Copilot CLI, dan integrated terminals don't include the command. A GitHub Copilot CLI that was terpasang separately isn't affected.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.locationsMigration.e: Mengontrol apakah the Chat kustomisasi editor offers to move agen, instruksi, dan keahlian dari dikonfigurasi locations that are not supported oleh the aktif agen-host harness. When dinonaktifkan, the migrasi card dan sidebar shortcut are tersembunyi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.mcpServerMigration.e: Mengontrol apakah VS Code shows server MCP migrasi actions, hints, compatibility badges, dan compatibility details. migrasi moves eligible ruang kerja server MCP out of .vscode/mcp.json dan ke a .mcp.json berkas at the ruang kerja root, where the aktif agen-host harness discovers them directly.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.migration.enabled: Mengontrol apakah VS Code shows kustomisasi migrasi actions, hints, compatibility badges, dan compatibility details untuk the aktif agen Host harness.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.promptMigration.enab: Mengontrol apakah the Chat kustomisasi editor offers to convert prompt berkas ke keahlian untuk agen-host harnesses, which ignore prompt berkas. When dinonaktifkan, the migrasi card dan sidebar shortcut are tersembunyi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.strictPluginOnlyCust: Blocks standalone user dan ruang kerja keahlian, agen, kait, instruksi, dan server MCP while keeping eligible plugin kustomisasi available.
Blocks standalone user dan ruang kerja keahlian, agen, kait, instruksi, dan server MCP while keeping eligible plugin kustomisasi available.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.structuredPreview.en: Mengontrol apakah the Chat kustomisasi editor shows a structured preview untuk markdown kustomisasi berkas (agen, keahlian, instruksi, prompts). When dinonaktifkan, the editor always opens the raw markdown in the embedded code editor.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.customizations.userDataMigration.en: Mengontrol apakah the Chat kustomisasi editor offers to move agen dan instruksi stored in user data to the aktif agen-host harness, which ignores the user data location. When dinonaktifkan, the migrasi card dan sidebar shortcut are tersembunyi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.approvals.allo: Allow All — runs alat calls tanpa asking.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.approvals.assi: Assisted permissions — evaluates risk before berjalan alat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.approvals.desc: The memulai approval behavior untuk new agen sesi. If enterprise policy disables auto approval, new sesi use Manual permissions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.approvals.manu: Manual permissions — asks when approval pengaturan don't terapkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.mode.autopilot: Autopilot — autonomously iterate dari mulai to finish.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.mode.descripti: The memulai mode untuk new agen sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.mode.plan: Plan — plan first, execute when ready.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.policy: Sets the bawaan configuration untuk new agen sesi, as a JSON object dengan an optional "mode" ("interactive", "plan", atau "autopilot") dan "approvals" ("manual", "assisted", atau "allowAll"). Users can still change them untuk each sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultConfiguration.settingDescrip: Mengontrol bawaan configuration untuk new agen sesi (such as Copilot). You can still change the mode dan approval behavior per sesi, dan each sesi remembers what was used.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultModel.description: The bawaan model untuk new chat conversations. Use "auto" to let Copilot pick a model, a model family name (such as "opus" atau "gemini") to use the latest available model in that family, atau a full model id. An organization-dikelola bawaan takes precedence over your tersimpan preference. You can still switch the model within a conversation; each new conversation starts at the effective bawaan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.defaultModel.policy: Sets the bawaan chat model untuk new conversations. Accepts "auto", a model family name (such as "opus" atau "gemini"), atau a full model id. Users can still switch the model within a conversation.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.detectParticipant.enabled: Mengaktifkan chat peserta autodetection untuk panel chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.disableAIFeatures: Nonaktifkan dan sembunyikan built-in AI features provided oleh GitHub Copilot, including chat dan inline suggestions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editing.autoAcceptDelay: Delay after which changes made oleh chat are automatically accepted. Values are in seconds, `0` means dinonaktifkan dan `100` seconds is the maximum.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRemoval: Apakah akan tampilkan a confirmation before menghapus a request dan its associated edits.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRetry: Apakah akan tampilkan a confirmation before retrying a request dan its associated edits.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editing.explainChanges.enabled: Mengontrol apakah the Explain button in the Chat panel dan the Explain Changes context menu in the SCM tampilan are ditampilkan. This is an experimental feature.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editing.openChangedFileInDiffEditor: Mengontrol apakah memilih a berkas in the changed berkas list of a chat response opens it in a diff editor menampilkan the changes made oleh chat, atau in a regular editor. Holding `kbstyle(Alt)` while memilih the berkas opens it dengan the opposite behavior.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editing.revealNextChangeOnResolve: Mengontrol apakah the editor automatically reveals the next change after keeping atau undoing a chat edit.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editor.codex.preferAgentHost: Saat diaktifkan, Codex sesi dibuka dari the regular workbench (sidebar chat) jalankan inside the agen host process using the Codex App Server instead of the OpenAI ekstensi. Only one Codex implementation surfaces per jendela. Requires `#chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled#`.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editor.workingSet.enabled: tampilkan agen Host sesi changes as a working set above the chat input instead of the Changes pill in the editor jendela. Use its context menu to aktifkan atau nonaktifkan Keep dan urungkan in both the working set dan the editor, atau choose tampilkan Pill to turn this pengaturan off. tampilan All Edits opens all changed berkas in a diff editor. Hosts tanpa a sesi changeset keep the Changes pill. Local dan other chat harnesses are unaffected.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editorAssociations: Konfigurasikan [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to editor untuk membuka berkas dari chat (untuk example `"*.md": "vscode.markdown.preview.editor"`).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.editRequests: Mengaktifkan editing of requests in the chat. This allows you to change the request content dan resubmit it to the model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.exitAfterDelegation: Mengontrol apakah the chat panel automatically exits after delegating a request to another sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.codexContinuation.enab: Offer to continue eligible Codex conversations dengan GitHub Copilot when nearing a ChatGPT usage limit.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.codexContinuation.thre: Minimum percentage of the five-hour atau weekly ChatGPT usage limit consumed before offering to continue eligible Codex conversations dengan GitHub Copilot.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.collectInstructionsInE: Saat diaktifkan, automatic instruksi collection (.instruksi.md, agen instruksi, kustomisasi index) is performed oleh the GitHub Copilot Chat ekstensi instead of the core workbench.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.detectParticipant.enab: Mengaktifkan chat peserta autodetection untuk panel chat.
This pengaturan is deprecated. Please use `chat.detectParticipant.enabled` instead.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.incrementalRendering.a: Mengontrol animation style untuk incremental rendering.
Content fades in dari a blurred state.
Content reveals top-to-bottom dengan a soft gradient edge.
Content fades in while rising upward.
Content scales up dari slightly smaller.
Content slides in dari the left.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.incrementalRendering.b: Mengontrol bagaimana content is buffered before rendering during incremental rendering. Lower buffering levels render faster but may tampilkan incomplete sentences atau partially formed markdown.
Renders content immediately as tokens arrive.
Buffers content until a paragraph break before rendering.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.incrementalRendering.e: Mengaktifkan incremental rendering dengan optional block-level animation when streaming chat responses.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.richLinks.enabled: Mengontrol apakah supported links in chat are rendered as rich links dengan live metadata. mengaktifkan this may make authenticated requests to services such as GitHub.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.sessionArchiveActionWo: Mengontrol wording dan icons used oleh actions that archive dan unarchive chat sesi, as well as the label of the archived sesi section.
Use Archive, Archive All, Unarchive, dan Unarchive All.
Use Mark as Done, Mark All as Done, Restore, dan Restore All.
Aktifkan state indicators around chat editor sesi that are in progress, need attention, atau have an unvisited completion. Customize the borders dengan `chat.sessionStateIndicator.inProgressBorder`, `chat.sessionStateIndicator.needsInputBorder`, dan `chat.sessionStateIndicator.unvisitedBorder` in `#workbench.colorCustomizations#`.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimental.stickyScroll.enabled: Mengontrol apakah chat requests use experimental tree-based gulir lengket instead of the sticky prompt header.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimentalModePermissionsPicker: Shows mode dan permissions in a combined picker dengan expandable permission choices untuk Copilot agen Host sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.experimentalSessionsWindowOverride: Saat true, enables sesi-jendela-specific behavior untuk ekstensi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.exploreAgent.defaultModel.descripti: pilih the bawaan language model to use untuk the Explore subagent dari the available providers.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.extensionToolsEnabled: Aktifkan using alat contributed oleh third-party ekstensi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.extensionUnification.enabled: Mengaktifkan the unification of GitHub Copilot ekstensi. When diaktifkan, all GitHub Copilot functionality is served dari the GitHub Copilot Chat ekstensi. When dinonaktifkan, the GitHub Copilot dan GitHub Copilot Chat ekstensi operate independently.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.fontFamily: Mengontrol font family in chat messages.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.fontSize: Mengontrol font size in pixels in chat messages.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.growthNotification: Mengontrol apakah to tampilkan a growth notification in the agen sesi tampilan to encourage new users to try Copilot.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.hookFilesLocations.description:
Specify paths to kait configuration berkas that define custom shell commands to execute at strategic points in an agen's workflow. [Learn More](__TOK_0__).

Relative paths are resolved dari the root folder(s) of your ruang kerja. Supports Copilot kait (`*.json`) dan Claude Code kait (`settings.json`, `settings.local.json`).

This pengaturan is only used oleh the Local agen harness.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.hookFilesLocations.invalidPath: Paths must be relative atau mulai dengan '~/'. Absolute paths dan '\' separators are not supported.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.hookFilesLocations.title: kait berkas Locations
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.hooks.allowManagedOnly: Allows kait only dari enterprise-dikelola sources dan plugin force-diaktifkan oleh policy.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.hooks.allowManagedOnly.policy: Allows kait only dari enterprise-dikelola sources dan plugin force-diaktifkan oleh policy.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.implicitContext.enabled.1: Mengaktifkan automatically using the aktif editor as chat context untuk specified chat locations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.implicitContext.includeActiveEditor:
Saat diaktifkan, the aktif editor is automatically forwarded as context, even when it would otherwise only be suggested. Selections dan explicitly attached berkas are always included regardless of this pengaturan.

Note: this pengaturan currently only applies to agen Host sesi (such as Copilot).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.implicitContext.suggestedContext: Mengontrol apakah the new implicit context flow is ditampilkan. In Ask dan Edit modes, the context will automatically be included. When using an agen, context will be suggested as an attachment. Selections are always included as context.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.implicitContext.value: The value untuk the implicit context.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.implicitContext.value.first: Implicit context is diaktifkan untuk the first interaction.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.includeApplyingInstructions.descrip: Mengontrol apakah instruksi dengan a matching 'applyTo' attribute are automatically included in chat requests. This pengaturan is only used oleh the Local agen harness.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.includeApplyingInstructions.title: Include menerapkan instruksi
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.includeReferencedInstructions.descr: Mengontrol apakah referenced instruksi are automatically included in chat requests. This pengaturan is only used oleh the Local agen harness.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.includeReferencedInstructions.title: Include Referenced instruksi
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.inlineChat.agentHost.enabled: Mengontrol apakah editor inline chat is backed oleh the agen Host instead of the ekstensi host. diterapkan on startup.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.inlineReferences.style: Mengontrol bagaimana berkas dan symbol references are displayed in chat messages.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.inlineReferences.style.box: Display berkas dan symbol references as boxed widgets dengan icons.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.inlineReferences.style.link: Display berkas dan symbol references as simple blue links tanpa icons.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.instructions.config.locations.descr:
Specify location(s) of instruksi berkas (`*__TOK_0__`) that can be attached in Chat sesi. [Learn More](__TOK_1__).

Relative paths are resolved dari the root folder(s) of your ruang kerja.

Locations dikonfigurasi here are only observed oleh the Local agen harness. Other harnesses berjalan in VS Code receive instruksi dari all additional locations dikonfigurasi here, in addition to their built-in locations. To use instruksi dengan independent agen harnesses, such as Copilot CLI, review the {2} in the agen kustomisasi editor to migrate them to supported locations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.instructions.config.locations.title: instruksi berkas Locations
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.instructionsLocations.invalidPath: Paths must be relative atau mulai dengan '~/'. Absolute paths dan '\' separators are not supported. Glob patterns are deprecated dan will be dihapus in future versions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mathEnabled.description: Aktifkan math rendering in chat responses using KaTeX.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.access: Mengontrol access to terpasang Model Context Protocol servers.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.access.any: Allow access to any terpasang server MCP.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.access.registry: Allows access to server MCP listed in the registry that VS Code is connected to.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowedServers: Enterprise-dikelola allowlist that controls which Model Context Protocol servers may be terpasang dan jalankan. Local servers must match a command entry when any command entries exist; remote servers must match a URL entry when any URL entries exist. Otherwise, servers may match a literal name entry. An empty list allows no servers; omit entirely to allow all servers, subject to the deny list. Gallery checks evaluate available installation candidates; the terpilih command atau URL is checked again after resolution. Delivered via enterprise policy untuk governance; this pengaturan is not surfaced to end users.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowedServers.policy: Allowlist of Model Context Protocol servers. When set, only servers matching an entry may be terpasang atau jalankan; omit entirely to allow all servers (subject to the deny list).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowedServers.serverCommand: Match a local server oleh its exact command followed oleh its arguments, in order. Environment variable references bentangkan on the host that runs the server.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowedServers.serverName: Match a server oleh its literal dikonfigurasi name. untuk local servers, names terapkan only when this allowlist has no command entries; untuk remote servers, only when it has no URL entries.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowedServers.serverUrl: Match a remote server oleh its URL, dengan case-insensitive scheme dan host dan a case-sensitive path. Supports `*` wildcards; a pattern dengan no path matches any path. Environment variable references bentangkan on the host that connects to the server.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowManagedServersOnly: Use only the enterprise-dikelola MCP allowlist when deciding which servers may jalankan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.allowManagedServersOnly.policy: Use only the enterprise-dikelola MCP allowlist when deciding which servers may jalankan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.assisted.nuget.enabled.descript: Mengaktifkan NuGet packages untuk AI-assisted server MCP installation. Used to pasang server MCP oleh name dari the central registry untuk .NET packages (NuGet.org).
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.autostart: Mengontrol apakah server MCP should be automatically dimulai when the chat messages are submitted.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.autostart.newAndOutdated: Automatically mulai new dan outdated server MCP that are not yet berjalan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.autostart.onlyNew: Only automatically mulai new server MCP that have never been jalankan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.collisionBehavior: Mengontrol behavior when multiple server MCP are discovered dengan the same name. 'nonaktifkan' disables lower-priority duplicates. 'suffix' appends numeric suffixes to disambiguate.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.collisionBehavior.disable: Nonaktifkan lower-priority servers dengan duplikasikan names.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.collisionBehavior.suffix: Append numeric suffixes to servers dengan duplikasikan names.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.deniedServers: Enterprise-dikelola denylist of Model Context Protocol servers. Servers matching any entry are unconditionally blocked dari being terpasang atau jalankan, even if they also match the allow list — deny rules always take precedence. Servers can be matched oleh name, remote URL pattern (dengan `*` wildcards), atau local command invocation. Delivered via enterprise policy untuk governance; this pengaturan is not surfaced to end users.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.deniedServers.policy: Denylist of Model Context Protocol servers. Servers matching any entry are blocked dari being terpasang atau jalankan, even if they also match the allow list; deny rules always take precedence.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.deniedServers.serverCommand: Match a local server oleh its exact command followed oleh its arguments, in order. Environment variable references bentangkan on the host that runs the server.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.deniedServers.serverName: Match a server oleh its dikonfigurasi name.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.deniedServers.serverUrl: Match a remote server oleh its URL, dengan case-insensitive scheme dan host dan a case-sensitive path. Supports `*` wildcards; a pattern dengan no path matches any path. Environment variable references bentangkan on the host that connects to the server.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.gallery.enabled: Mengaktifkan the bawaan Marketplace untuk Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.serverSampling: Mengonfigurasi which models are exposed to server MCP untuk sampling (making model requests in the background). This pengaturan can be edited in a graphical way under the `__TOK_0__` command.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.serverSampling.allowedDuringCha: Apakah this server is allowed to make sampling requests during its alat calls in a chat sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.serverSampling.allowedOutsideCh: Apakah this server is allowed to make sampling requests outside of a chat sesi.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.serverSampling.model: A model the server MCP has access to.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mcp.ui.enabled: Mengontrol apakah server MCP can provide custom UI untuk alat invocations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.microsoftAuthentication.enabled: Mengontrol when sign-in surfaces, such as the sign-in dialog dan the welcome screen, offer "Continue dengan Microsoft". Signing in dengan Microsoft exchanges your Microsoft account untuk the GitHub access your organization has linked to it. The resulting GitHub sign-in lasts untuk the saat ini jendela sesi only dan is not tersimpan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.microsoftAuthentication.enabled.alw: Always offer "Continue dengan Microsoft", tanpa checking untuk a linked account.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.microsoftAuthentication.enabled.aut: Offer "Continue dengan Microsoft" only when a Microsoft work atau school account on this device is linked to a GitHub account. This is checked silently in the background: Microsoft may record a sign-in, dan the GitHub access used untuk the check is revoked when possible.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.microsoftAuthentication.enabled.nev: Never offer "Continue dengan Microsoft", dan never check untuk a linked account.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mode.config.locations.deprecated: This pengaturan dan the Local agen harness will be dihapus in a future release. Chat modes are now called custom agen dan are located in `.github/agents`. Review the {0} in the agen kustomisasi editor to move them ke supported locations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mode.config.locations.description:
Specify location(s) of custom chat mode berkas (`*__TOK_0__`). [Learn More](__TOK_1__).

Relative paths are resolved dari the root folder(s) of your ruang kerja.

This pengaturan is only used oleh the Local agen harness.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.mode.config.locations.title: Mode berkas Locations
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.newSession.defaultMode: The bawaan mode untuk new chat sesi. When empty, the chat tampilan's bawaan mode is used.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnConfirmation: Mengontrol apakah a chat sesi should present the user dengan an OS notification when a confirmation atau question needs attention. This includes a jendela badge as well as notification toast.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnConfirmation.always: Always tampilkan OS notifications untuk confirmations, even when the jendela is focused.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnConfirmation.off: Never tampilkan OS notifications untuk confirmations.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnConfirmation.windowNo: tampilkan OS notifications untuk confirmations when the jendela is not focused.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnResponseReceived: Mengontrol apakah a chat sesi should present the user dengan an OS notification when a response is received. This includes a jendela badge as well as notification toast.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnResponseReceived.alwa: Always tampilkan OS notifications untuk responses, even when the jendela is focused.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnResponseReceived.off: Never tampilkan OS notifications untuk responses.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.notifyWindowOnResponseReceived.wind: tampilkan OS notifications untuk responses when the jendela is not focused.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.pasteAsAttachmentThreshold: Jumlah characters a tempel must exceed before it is added to the chat input as an attachment instead of being inserted inline. Set this to a very large number to always tempel inline.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.permissions.default.autoApprove.des: mulai new chat sesi in Bypass Approvals mode.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.permissions.default.autopilot.descr: mulai new chat sesi in Autopilot mode.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.permissions.default.autopilot.label: Autopilot (Preview)
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.permissions.default.default.descrip: mulai new chat sesi dengan bawaan Permissions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.permissions.default.default.label: bawaan Permissions
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.permissions.default.settingDescript: Mengontrol bawaan permissions picker mode untuk new local chat sesi. You can still change the permission mode per sesi, dan each sesi remembers the permission mode that was used. If enterprise policy disables auto approval, new sesi use bawaan Permissions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.planAgent.defaultModel.description: pilih the bawaan language model to use untuk the Plan agen dari the available providers.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.pluginLocations: plugin direktori to discover. Each key is a path that points directly to a plugin folder, dan the value enables (`true`) atau disables (`false`) it. Paths can be absolute, relative to the ruang kerja root, atau mulai dengan `~/` untuk the user's home direktori.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.plugins.enabled: Aktifkan agen plugin integration in chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.plugins.enabledPlugins: Mengontrol which [agent plugins](https://aka.ms/vscode-agent-plugins) are diaktifkan atau dinonaktifkan. Keys are plugin IDs in `<plugin>@<marketplace>` form (where marketplace is defined in {1}); values aktifkan (`true`) atau nonaktifkan (`false`) the plugin. Discovered alongside the path-keyed entries in {0}. When set oleh policy, entries are additive: plugin mapped to `true` are diaktifkan in addition to the user's own plugin, dan only plugin mapped to `false` are blocked dari loading.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.plugins.enabledPlugins.policy: plugin enablement. Keys are plugin IDs in `{plugin}@{marketplace}` form; values aktifkan atau nonaktifkan the plugin.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.plugins.extraMarketplaces: Enterprise-dikelola additional plugin marketplaces. Unioned dengan {0}. An entry's `autoUpdate` value overrides {1} untuk plugin dari that marketplace.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.plugins.extraMarketplaces.policy: Additional plugin marketplaces to query. Keys are marketplace names; values are GitHub shorthand (`owner/repo[#ref]`) atau Git URIs (`{url}[#ref]`), optionally dengan an enterprise-dikelola auto-perbarui override.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.plugins.marketplaces: plugin marketplaces to query. Entries may be GitHub shorthand (`owner/repo` atau `owner/repo#ref`), direct Git repository URIs (`https://...git`, `ssh://...git`, atau `git@host:path.git`, each optionally suffixed dengan `#ref`), atau local repository URIs (`file:///...`). Equivalent GitHub shorthand dan URI entries are deduplicated.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.progressBorder.enabled: tampilkan an animated gradient border around the chat input while the agen is working atau thinking. Has no effect when reduced motion is diaktifkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.promptFileLocations.invalidPath: Paths must be relative atau mulai dengan '~/'. Absolute paths dan '\' separators are not supported. Glob patterns are deprecated dan will be dihapus in future versions.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.promptFilesRecommendations.descript: Konfigurasikan which prompt berkas to recommend in the chat welcome tampilan. Each key is a prompt berkas name, dan the value can be `true` to always recommend, `false` to never recommend, atau a [when clause](https://aka.ms/vscode-when-clause) expression like `resourceExtname == .js` atau `resourceLangId == markdown`.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.promptFilesRecommendations.title: Prompt berkas Recommendations
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.requestQueuing.defaultAction.descri: Mengontrol which action is the bawaan untuk the queue button when a request is in progress.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.requestQueuing.defaultAction.queue: Queue the message to send after the saat ini request completes.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.requestQueuing.defaultAction.steer: Steer the saat ini request oleh sending the message immediately, signaling the saat ini request to yield.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.restoreLastPanelSession: Mengontrol apakah the last sesi is restored in panel after mulai ulang.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.reusablePrompts.config.locations.de: This pengaturan dan the Local agen harness will be dihapus in a future release. Review the {0} in the agen kustomisasi editor to convert prompt berkas ke keahlian.

Specify location(s) of reusable prompt berkas (`*__TOK_0__`) that can be jalankan in Chat sesi. [Learn More](__TOK_1__).

Relative paths are resolved dari the root folder(s) of your ruang kerja.

This pengaturan is only used oleh the Local agen harness.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.saveBeforeSend: Mengontrol apakah all dirty editor except untitled editor are tersimpan before sending a chat message.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.sessionSync.enabled: Aktifkan sesi sync to GitHub.com. When diaktifkan, Copilot sesi data is synced to your GitHub account untuk cross-device access dan richer insights. Requires `#github.copilot.chat.localIndex.enabled#` to also be diaktifkan.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.autoApprove.edits:
Mengontrol apakah edits made oleh the agen are automatically approved. The bawaan is to approve all edits except those made to certain berkas which have the potential to cause immediate unintended side-effects, such as `**/.vscode/*.json`.

Set to `true` to automatically approve edits to matching berkas, `false` to always require explicit approval. The last pattern matching a given berkas will determine whether the edit is automatically approved.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.compressOutput.enabled: Post-process alat keluaran (untuk example `git diff`, `ls -l`, atau `npm install`) to reduce token usage before it is sent to the model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.confirmationCarousel: Saat diaktifkan, alat confirmations are ditampilkan in a carousel above the input, including confirmations dari subagents dan earlier responses.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.eligibleForAutoApproval: Mengontrol which alat are eligible untuk automatic approval. alat set to 'false' will always present a confirmation dan will never offer the option to auto-approve. The bawaan behavior (atau pengaturan a alat to 'true') may result in the alat offering auto-approval options.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.fetchPage.approvedUrls:
Mengontrol which URLs are automatically approved when requested oleh chat alat. Keys are URL patterns dan values can be `true` to approve both requests dan responses, `false` to deny, atau an object dengan `approveRequest` dan `approveResponse` properties untuk granular control.

Examples:
- `"https://example.com": true` - Approve all requests to example.com
- `"https://*.example.com": true` - Approve all requests to any subdomain of example.com
- `"https://example.com/api/*": { "approveRequest": true, "approveResponse": false }` - Approve requests but not responses untuk example.com/api paths

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.riskAssessment.model: The language model id used to generate alat risk assessments. Should be a small, fast model.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chat.s.chat.tools.terminal.outputReflow: Mengontrol apakah terminal keluaran in chat reflows to fit the available width. Automatic language selection follows the Voice Mode language pengaturan; when that pengaturan is Automatic, dictation uses the dikonfigurasi display language when supported, then the system atau browser locale, dengan model detection as a fallback. Downloaded on first use dan cached on disk.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chatPe.chatPet.achievements.accessibilityHelp.c: Use Tab dan Shift+Tab to move through No Hat dan the achievement cards. Press Enter atau Space on No Hat atau an unlocked achievement to change what the pet wears. Newly unlocked cards are announced as New until you activate them. Locked achievements announce their hint dan reward dan cannot be terpilih.
Tekan Escape untuk tutup Customize Blobby. Unapplied custom color changes are dibuang.

Change Color in Blobby's context menu always opens the Color tab. Stable dan Insiders are available tanpa an achievement. Use /blobby in Chat to unlock True Name dan its solid dan custom colors. If the pet is off, the command turns it on; if it is already on, it opens the Color tab. Activating the True Name achievement also opens Color. Use Tab to reach a color card, then Enter atau Space to terapkan it. untuk a custom color, use the color picker atau enter an opaque hex value such as #ff8800, then activate terapkan Color atau press Enter in the hex input. The preview does not change the pet until you terapkan it.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chatPe.chatPet.achievements.accessibilityHelp.o: Customize Blobby has Achievements dan Color tabs. When the page opens, press Tab to focus the terpilih tab. Use the Left dan Right Arrow keys, Home, atau End while a tab is focused to switch tabs. Press Tab again to reach the terpilih tab's content. The Achievements tab lists agen-feature achievements dan their pet hat dan color rewards. Locked cards reveal a hint dan reward while keeping the achievement name dan exact unlock requirement tersembunyi.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chatPr.chat.experimental.persistentProgress: Keep a working progress indicator at the bottom until the response finishes, dengan a colored atau monochrome Draw animation, atau tanpa an icon. The indicator reports berjalan subagents dan background commands dari the saat ini atau earlier requests, even while the main response progresses. The bawaan is Draw in all versions of VS Code. Experiments can override the bawaan; an explicit pengaturan takes precedence. alat calls follow {0}. Except in Conversation mode, reasoning is separated ke collapsible previews that break the alat chain. Standalone alat retain their icons. Completed responses still follow {1}. This replaces inner working progress; terminal activity animations dan rich subagent pills are unchanged. Changes terapkan immediately; reduced motion keeps the indicator visible tanpa animation.
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chatPr.chat.experimental.persistentProgressVerb: Control alat call details when {0} is diaktifkan. Compact is the bawaan dan collapses alat grup in place when thinking atau response text resumes, atau the response finishes. When agen Host activity data is available, headers summarize up to three activity grup, prioritizing edits dan commands, tanpa language model requests. Remaining activity is counted as other steps. Failed, skipped, denied, dan unfinished alat invocations remain explicit, including in the other-steps count. Completed shell invocations count as commands tanpa tracking later background process status. grup dengan no recognized activity atau outcome use a step count. bentangkan a summary to inspect all its alat calls. Conversation collapses reasoning dan alat calls between response text ke one section that starts diciutkan, names the saat ini alat call, atau the heading of the saat ini reasoning summary (Thinking when the reasoning has no heading), while it runs, dan reports how long it took once it finishes. Has no effect when persistent progress is Off. Changes terapkan immediately.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/sessio.backgroundShells.accessibilityHelp: The Background Shells pill opens a picker above the chat input, including untuk a single shell. Each entry includes its elapsed time, dan is marked Detached when the shell runs independently of the agen. Use the arrow keys to choose a shell, then Enter atau Right Arrow to buka its live command details beside the picker. Left Arrow atau Escape returns to the list; Escape dari the list returns focus to the pill. Elapsed time continues memperbarui while details are buka, dan a shell disappears when it finishes. The details mulai dengan the shell's full description, unless it only repeats the command, followed oleh the command dan its status. When a shell's keluaran is available, a read-only terminal below the command streams it. A shell that can be dihentikan shows a hentikan Shell button beside its command. Press Tab to move through the details to the keluaran, then use buka Accessible View{0} to read the command, its status, dan its keluaran as text.

vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/tools/.autoApprove2.title: Aktifkan global auto approve?
vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/tools/.autoApprove3.markdown:
Global auto approve also known as "YOLO mode" disables manual approval completely untuk _all alat in all workspaces_, allowing the agen to act fully autonomously. This is extremely dangerous dan is *never* recommended, even containerized environments like [Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces) dan [Dev Containers](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-vscode-remote.remote-containers) have user keys forwarded ke the container that could be compromised.

**This feature disables [critical security protections](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agents/run/security) dan makes it much easier untuk an attacker to compromise the machine.**

Note: This pengaturan only controls alat approval dan does not prevent the agen dari asking questions. To automatically answer agen questions, use the [`chat.autoReply`](command:workbench.action.openSettings?__TOK_0____TOK_1__hat.autoReply%22__TOK_2__) pengaturan.

vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.closingDesc: Tekan Escape to tutup cari. Focus returns untuk the editor at the most terkini match, dan your cari riwayat is preserved.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.context: You are in the cari dialog untuk the aktif editor. This dialog is where you type what you want to locate. The editor is a separate surface that shows each match dan its surrounding context.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.dialogDesc: While you are in the cari dialog, your focus stays in the input. You can keep typing, edit your cari text, atau move through matches tanpa leaving the dialog. When you navigate to a match dari here, the editor updates in the background, but your focus remains in the cari dialog.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.dialogHeader: Inside the cari Dialog (What It Does):
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.focusDesc1: Saat you navigate dari inside the cari dialog, the editor updates while your focus stays in the input. This is intentional, so you can keep adjusting your cari tanpa losing your place.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.focusDesc2: If you want to move focus ke the editor to edit text atau inspect surrounding code, press Escape to tutup cari. Focus returns to the editor at the most terkini match.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.hear1: 1) The full line that contains the match is read first, so you get immediate context.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.hear2: 2) Your position among the matches is announced, so you know how far you are through the results.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.hear3: 3) The exact line dan column are announced, so you know precisely where the match is in the berkas.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.hearConclusion: This sequence happens every time you move forward atau backward.
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.hearDesc: Each navigation step gives you a complete spoken perbarui so you always know where you are. The order is consistent:
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.hearHeader: What You Hear Each Time You Move to a Match:
vs/workbench/contrib/codeEditor/browser/.find.keyEnter: - Enter: Move to the next match while staying in the cari dialog.

vs/workbench/contrib/debug/browser/replA.repl.filterDesc: Each time you change the filter text, the console instantly regenerates to tampilkan only matching messages. Your screen reader announces how many messages are now visible. This is live feedback: text searches console keluaran, variable values, dan log messages.
vs/workbench/contrib/debug/browser/replA.repl.focusDesc1: Your focus stays in the filter input while the console updates in the background. This is intentional, so you can keep typing tanpa losing your place.
vs/workbench/contrib/debug/browser/replA.repl.focusDesc2: If you want to review the filtered console keluaran, press Down Arrow to move focus dari the filter ke the console messages above.

vs/workbench/contrib/files/browser/files.fileNestingPatterns:
Mengontrol nesting of berkas in the Explorer. {0} must be set untuk this to take effect. Each __Item__ represents a parent pattern dan may contain a single `*` character that matches any string. Each __Value__ represents a comma separated list of the child patterns that should be ditampilkan nested under a given parent. Child patterns may contain several special tokens:
- `${capture}`: Matches the resolved value of the `*` dari the parent pattern
- `${basename}`: Matches the parent berkas's basename, the `file` in `file.ts`
- `${extname}`: Matches the parent berkas's ekstensi, the `ts` in `file.ts`
- `${dirname}`: Matches the parent berkas's direktori name, the `src` in `src/file.ts`
- `*`:  Matches any string, may only be used once per child pattern

To set the matching client secret, use the *Set Client Secret* code lens above this field — secrets are stored in the OS secret store, not in this berkas.

The IdP issuer dan client credentials are read dari the `#mcp.enterpriseManagedAuth.idp#` pengaturan; the `clientId` on this server entry is passed to the resource authorization server.

vs/workbench/contrib/output/browser/outp.output.filterDesc1: Each time you change the filter text, the panel instantly regenerates to tampilkan only matching lines. Your screen reader announces how many lines are now visible. This is live feedback: as you type atau hapus characters, the displayed lines perbarui immediately.

vs/workbench/contrib/output/browser/outp.output.focusDesc2: If you want to review the filtered keluaran, press Down Arrow to move focus dari the filter ke the keluaran content below.
vs/workbench/contrib/output/browser/outp.output.focusDesc3: If you want to bersihkan the filter dan see all keluaran, press Escape atau hapus all filter text.
vs/workbench/contrib/output/browser/outp.output.inputDesc: While you are in the filter input, your focus stays in the field. You can type, edit, atau adjust your filter tanpa leaving the input. As you type, the keluaran panel instantly updates to tampilkan only lines matching your filter.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/common/ter.terminal.integrated.shellIntegration.ena:
Menentukan apakah atau not shell integration is auto-injected to support features like enhanced command tracking dan saat ini working direktori detection. 

Shell integration works oleh injecting the shell dengan a startup script. The script gives VS Code insight ke what is happening within the terminal.

Supported shells:

- Linux/macOS: bash, fish, pwsh, zsh
 - jendela: pwsh, git bash

This pengaturan applies only when terminals are dibuat, so you will need to mulai ulang your terminals untuk it to take effect.

 Note that the script injection may not work if you have custom arguments defined in the terminal profile, have diaktifkan {1}, have a [complex bash `PROMPT_COMMAND`](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/integrated-terminal#_complex-bash-promptcommand), atau other unsupported setup. To nonaktifkan decorations, see {0}

The bawaan value {0} uses a variable wait time based on whether shell integration injection is diaktifkan dan whether it's a remote jendela. Values between 1 dan 499 are clamped to 500ms. Consider pengaturan this to a large value if your shell starts very slowly.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.enabledSetting: Mengontrol apakah agen mode uses sandboxing to restrict what alat can do. When diaktifkan, alat like the terminal are jalankan in a sandboxed environment to limit access to the system. The Local harness supports sandboxing on Linux dan macOS only. The Copilot agen Host harness uses the SDK runtime's sandbox, including on supported jendela hosts.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.enabledSetting.offDescripti: Nonaktifkan sandboxing untuk agen mode alat.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.linuxFileSystemSetting: Note: this pengaturan is applicable only when {0} is diaktifkan. Controls berkas system access in sandbox on Linux. vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.linuxFileSystemSetting.deny: Array of paths to deny read access. Leave empty to allow reading all paths.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.macFileSystemSetting: Note: this pengaturan is applicable only when {0} is diaktifkan. Controls berkas system access in sandbox on macOS. Paths also support git-style glob patterns(ex: *.ts, ./src, ./src/**/*.ts, berkas?.txt).
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.macFileSystemSetting.allowR: Array of paths to re-allow read access within denied regions. Takes precedence over denyRead.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.macFileSystemSetting.allowW: Array of additional paths to allow write access. Leave empty to disallow writes outside the ruang kerja folder, ruang kerja storage folder, dan sandbox temp direktori.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.macFileSystemSetting.denyRe: Array of paths to deny read access. Leave empty to allow reading all paths.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.agentSandbox.macFileSystemSetting.denyWr: Array of paths to deny write access within allowed paths (takes precedence over allowWrite).
