vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.defaults: Note that there's a bawaan set of rules to allow dan also deny commands. Consider pengaturan {0} to {1} to ignore all bawaan rules to ensure there are no conflicts dengan your own rules. Do this at your own risk, the bawaan denial rules are designed to protect you against berjalan dangerous commands.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.commandLine: An object can be used to match against the full command line instead of matching sub-commands dan inline commands, untuk example {0}. In order to be auto approved _both_ the sub-command dan command line must not be explicitly denied, then _either_ all sub-commands atau command line needs to be approved.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.binTest: Allow all commands that match the path {0} ({1}, {2}, etc.)
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.ps1: Require explicit approval untuk any _command line_ that contains {0} regardless of casing
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.regexAl: Allow all commands (denied commands still require approval)
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.regexCa: will allow {0} commands regardless of casing
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.regexGi: Allow {0} dan all commands memulai dengan {1}
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.rm: Require explicit approval untuk all commands memulai dengan {0}
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.examples.title: Examples:
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.intro: Daftar commands atau regular expressions that control whether the jalankan in terminal alat commands require explicit approval. These will be matched against the mulai of a command. A regular expression can be provided oleh wrapping the string in {0} characters followed oleh optional flags such as {1} untuk case-insensitivity.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.subCommands: Note that these commands dan regular expressions are evaluated untuk every _sub-command_ within the full _command line_, so {0} untuk example will need both {1} dan {2} to match a {3} entry dan must not match a {4} entry in order to auto approve. Inline commands such as {5} (process substitution) should also be detected.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.description.values: Set to {0} to automatically approve commands, {1} to always require explicit approval atau {2} to unset the value.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.false: Require explicit approval untuk the pattern.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.key: The mulai of a command to match against. A regular expression can be provided oleh wrapping the string in `/` characters.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.matchCommandLine: Apakah akan match against the full command line, as opposed to splitting oleh sub-commands dan inline commands.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.matchCommandLine.false: &&Match against sub-commands dan inline commands, eg. `foo  bar` will need both `foo` dan `bar` to match.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.matchCommandLine.true: &&Match against the full command line, eg. `foo  bar`.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApprove.null: Ignore the pattern, this is useful untuk unsetting the same pattern set at a higher scope.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApproveMode.description: Mengontrol apakah to allow auto approval in the jalankan in terminal alat.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.autoApproveWorkspaceNpmScripts.descripti: Apakah akan automatically approve npm, yarn, dan pnpm jalankan commands when the script is defined in a ruang kerja package.json berkas. Since the ruang kerja is trusted, scripts defined in package.json are considered safe to jalankan tanpa explicit approval.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.backgroundNotifications.deprecated: This pengaturan is deprecated. terminal completion dan input-needed notifications are now always diaktifkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.backgroundNotifications.description: This pengaturan is deprecated dan no longer has any effect. terminal completion dan input-needed notifications are now always diaktifkan untuk any command that continues berjalan after the alat returns.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.blockFileWrites.description:
Mengontrol apakah detected berkas write operations are blocked in the jalankan in terminal alat. When detected, this will require explicit approval regardless of whether the command would normally be auto approved. Note that this cannot detect all possible methods of writing berkas, this is what is currently detected:

- berkas redirection (detected via the bash atau PowerShell tree sitter grammar)
- `sed` in-place editing (`-i`, `-I`, `--in-place`)
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.blockFileWrites.outsideWorkspace: Block berkas writes detected outside the ruang kerja. This depends on the shell integration feature working correctly to determine the saat ini working direktori of the terminal.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.detachBackgroundProcesses.description: Apakah akan detach persistent terminal processes so they survive when VS Code exits. When diaktifkan, commands dimulai dengan `mode: "async"` (legacy: `isBackground: true`) are wrapped dengan `nohup` (POSIX) atau `Start-Process` (jendela) so the process continues berjalan after the terminal is disposed.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.enforceTimeoutFromModel.description: Apakah akan enforce the timeout value provided oleh the model in the jalankan in terminal alat. When diaktifkan, if the model provides a timeout parameter, the alat will hentikan tracking the command after that duration dan return the keluaran collected so far.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.idlePollInterval.description: Mengonfigurasi the idle poll interval in milliseconds used oleh the jalankan in terminal alat to detect when commands have finished executing. Lower values make command detection faster but may cause false positives on slow systems. This primarily affects terminals tanpa shell integration where idle detection is used instead of shell integration events.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.idleSilenceTimeoutMs.description: Number of milliseconds the jalankan in terminal alat will wait untuk new keluaran dari a synchronous command before moving it to a background terminal dan returning what was collected so far. The process is not killed — the alat returns the terminal ID so the model can poll, send input, atau kill it. Set to {0} to nonaktifkan.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.ignoreDefaultAutoApproveRules.descriptio: Apakah akan ignore the built-in bawaan auto-approve rules used oleh the jalankan in terminal alat as defined in {0}. When this pengaturan is diaktifkan, the jalankan in terminal alat will ignore any rule that comes dari the bawaan set but still follow rules defined in the user, remote dan ruang kerja pengaturan. Use this pengaturan at your own risk; the bawaan auto-approve rules are designed to protect you against berjalan dangerous commands.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.outputCompaction.description: Saat diaktifkan, the keluaran of commands jalankan oleh the jalankan in terminal alat is compacted before being returned to the model, reducing the number of tokens spent on noisy keluaran (untuk example progress bars atau repeated log lines) while preserving the important information.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.outputDeltas.description: Saat diaktifkan, repeated get terminal keluaran alat calls return only keluaran added since the previous poll untuk the same terminal execution, atau a short unchanged-keluaran message when there is no new keluaran.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.outputLocation.chat: Reveal the terminal keluaran within chat only.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.outputLocation.description: Where to tampilkan the keluaran dari the jalankan in terminal alat.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.outputLocation.terminal: Reveal the terminal in the panel atau editor in addition to chat.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.preventShellHistory.description: Apakah akan exclude commands jalankan oleh the terminal alat dari the shell riwayat. See below untuk the supported shells dan the method used untuk each:
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.preventShellHistory.description.bash: Sets `HISTCONTROL=ignorespace` dan prepends the command dengan space
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.preventShellHistory.description.fish: Sets `fish_private_mode` to prevent any command dari entering riwayat
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.preventShellHistory.description.pwsh: Sets a custom riwayat handler via PSReadLine's `AddToHistoryHandler` to prevent any command dari entering riwayat
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.preventShellHistory.description.zsh: Sets `HIST_IGNORE_SPACE` option dan prepends the command dengan space
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.shellIntegrationTimeout.description: Mengonfigurasi the duration in milliseconds to wait untuk shell integration to be detected when the jalankan in terminal alat launches a new terminal. Set to `0` to skip the wait entirely, the bawaan value `-1` uses a variable wait time based on the value of {0} dan whether it's a remote jendela. A large value can be useful if your shell starts very slowly.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/cha.terminalChatAgentProfile.osx: The terminal profile to use on macOS untuk chat agen's jalankan in terminal alat.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.closingDesc: Tekan Escape to tutup terminal cari. Focus moves untuk the terminal command line, dan your cari riwayat is available on next cari.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.context: You are in the terminal cari input. This searches the entire terminal buffer: both the saat ini keluaran dan the scrollback riwayat.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.focusDesc1: Saat you navigate dari the terminal cari input, the terminal buffer updates in the background while your focus stays in the input. This is intentional, so you can keep refining your cari tanpa losing your place.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.focusDesc2: The terminal automatically scrolls to tampilkan the match you navigate to.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.focusDesc3: If you want to tutup cari dan return focus to the terminal command line, press Escape. Focus moves to the command input at the bottom of the terminal.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hear1: 1) The full line that contains the match is read first, so you get immediate context.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hear2: 2) Your position among the matches is announced, so you know how far you are through the results.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hear3: 3) The exact line dan column are announced, so you know precisely where the match is in the buffer.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hearDesc: Each navigation step gives you a complete spoken perbarui:
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hearHeader: What You Hear Each Time You Move to a Match:
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.inputDesc: While you are in the terminal cari input, your focus stays in the field. You can type, edit your cari term, atau navigate matches tanpa leaving the input. When you navigate to a match, the terminal scrolls to tampilkan it, but your focus remains in the cari input.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.inputHeader: Inside the terminal cari Input (What It Does):
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.keyEnter: - Enter: Move to the next match while staying in the cari input.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.keyNavHeader: While focused IN the cari input:
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.keyNavNote: Note: terminal cari keeps focus in the cari input. If you need to return to the terminal command line, press Escape to tutup cari.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.keyShiftEnter: - Shift+Enter: Move to the previous match while staying in the cari input.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.optionCase: - Match Case: Only exact case matches are included.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.optionRegex: - Regular Expression: Use pattern matching untuk advanced searches.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.optionWord: - Whole Word: Only full words are matched.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.settingsDesc: terminal cari has limited configuration options. Most behavior is controlled oleh the terminal itself.

vs/workbench/contrib/welcomeViews/common.contributes.viewsWelcome: Contributed tampilan welcome content. Welcome content will be rendered in tree based tampilan whenever they have no meaningful content to display, ie. the berkas Explorer when no folder is buka. Such content is useful as in-product documentation to drive users to use certain features before they are available. A good example would be a `Clone Repository` button in the berkas Explorer welcome tampilan.
